# Agile Coach
## What Does an Agile Coach Do at SYBIT?
As an Agile Coach at SYBIT, you support project teams on their journey toward shared project success and serve as the central point of contact for all questions related to collaboration. Whether it’s Scrum, conflict management, individual concerns of team members, or optimizing collaboration—you are a coach, trainer, advisor, and facilitator all in one.
With your mindset as a Servant Leader and your extensive toolkit of methods, you create new structures and transform existing ones. Together with the team and our leaders, you contribute to the continuous development of our corporate culture.
## Who Do Agile Coaches at SYBIT Work With?
As an Agile Coach at SYBIT, you work directly with project teams, helping them implement and optimize agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban. You facilitate meetings, conduct retrospectives, and provide ongoing coaching.
You promote self-organization, a strong feedback culture, and collaboration within our project teams, as well as knowledge sharing and communication among team members. You work closely with Product Owners to ensure that the product vision is clear and requirements are prioritized effectively. You coach development teams as well as all relevant stakeholders.
As an Agile Coach at SYBIT, you also work with Team Leads to strengthen our agile corporate culture. You advise them on implementing agile principles at a strategic level and help identify and remove organizational obstacles. ## What Skills Make a Successful Agile Coach at SYBIT?
An Agile Coach at SYBIT is characterized by empathy and an extensive toolkit of methods. You understand your team’s needs and can draw on a wide range of methods to provide the right support.
- **Conflict resolution skills and a coaching mindset:** You are able to identify and resolve conflicts and support the development of your team members through targeted coaching.
- **Strong communication skills and a willingness to listen:** You communicate clearly and effectively and are always ready to listen to the concerns of the teams.
- **Quick comprehension and resourcefulness:** You are highly skilled at recognizing complex relationships, explaining them clearly to the project team, and guiding the team toward a shared solution.
- **Confidence and assertiveness:** Even in challenging situations, you remain calm and decisive. This helps you earn the trust of both teams and stakeholders.
- **A natural talent for networking:** You connect with new people quickly and know how to establish a strong foundation of trust.
What Makes Working as an Agile Coach at SYBIT So Special?
> Working with people and teams, supporting their development, and helping them become better than they were before is incredibly rewarding.

# Consulting
Consulting at SYBIT Means Making the World of Work a Little Better Every Day
Analytical thinking, a keen sense for people and situations, and assertiveness are among your strengths. With your communication skills, willingness to listen, and deep understanding of our service portfolio, you are an indispensable sparring partner. Do you thrive on the challenge of finding the right solutions and want to make your customers’ working world a little better every day? Then SYBIT is the right place for you. ## Overview of Our Consulting Areas
At SYBIT, our consulting experts work across a variety of areas. Below, we provide an overview of these areas, the responsibilities our consultants take on, and the skills they bring to the table.
Solution Consultant
As a Solution Consultant, you design, implement, and optimize customized SAP software solutions for our customers. In workshops with their specialist departments, you gather requirements and develop tailored solutions that are technologically feasible, commercially viable, and attractive to use. You have in-depth knowledge of the functions, customization options, and extension capabilities of our applications. This enables you to develop approaches that not only meet current needs but are also prepared for future developments. You always keep the product roadmap in mind to ensure that the solution you recommend remains viable in the long term. With your deep understanding of processes and sound cost-benefit analyses, you present customers with alternatives and help them make informed decisions. Digital Solution Advisor
As a Digital Solution Advisor, you combine teamwork with professional expertise. You have a comprehensive understanding of processes and technologies and identify our customers’ key requirements, goals, and challenges. Thanks to your methodological expertise and analytical skills, you are able to present even complex requirements in a clear and easy-to-understand way. In doing so, you contribute your expertise in best-practice processes. In this role, you act as a key interface between Sales and Consulting and actively support various projects and sales processes by collaborating with different teams. Business Consultant
As a Business Consultant, you work closely with our customers’ executives. Together, you define their goals and develop the corresponding strategies and roadmaps for implementing digitalization projects. You act as the link between business and IT because you understand both sides. You plan and facilitate workshops with our customers. Thanks to your deep technical understanding and expertise, you identify our customers’ business requirements and translate new digital business ideas into the necessary technologies. From this, you derive viable models, strategies, and programs. You successfully balance innovation with feasibility. You visualize customer processes and develop target architectures or project initiatives. Within consulting projects, you are the primary point of contact for our customers. You build long-term customer relationships by developing visions for our customers and laying the foundation for identifying and expanding new opportunities. Our Sales team highly values your support during presales activities and initial customer meetings.

# Corporate Functions
## Overview of Roles in Corporate Functions
Whether you’re a people person, an organizational talent, or a numbers expert, Corporate Functions at SYBIT offer a wide variety of responsibilities. Do you want to find and develop talent, safeguard our financial stability, or help us shape a culture of growth? Below, we provide an overview of the roles and responsibilities our Corporate Functions Experts take on and the skills they bring to their respective roles. HR Business Partner
As an HR Business Partner at SYBIT, you are more than just a point of contact for HR matters—you have both a strategic and individual impact across the entire company. You are responsible for creating an environment where our employees can discover and develop their talents. In doing so, you actively contribute to the growth of every individual employee and SYBIT as a whole. Whether in Recruiting, People and Organizational Development, HR Marketing, or Employer Branding, your work plays a key role in shaping a sustainable corporate culture and supporting the professional development of our colleagues.
Finance Specialist
As a Finance Specialist at SYBIT, you are responsible for the company’s financial stability and sustainable growth. Your role involves working not only with numbers, but also closely with Management and our operational business units. You prepare and review monthly and annual financial statements, ensure accurate ongoing accounting, and serve as the central point of contact for employees on all finance-related matters. Your expertise in capital planning, risk management, and investment strategies helps ensure SYBIT’s success and financial stability—both today and in the future.
Office Service Expert
As an Office Manager at SYBIT, you’re a multitasker and organizational talent—in other words, the heart and soul of our Shared Services Team. Whether it’s Office, Travel, Facility, or Workplace Management, you take care of our employees’ administrative and organizational needs. You coordinate phone and email inquiries, arrange hotel bookings and beverage orders, and organize internal events. You make sure everything runs smoothly in our offices and that our employees feel comfortable. Your ability to create a positive working environment makes an important contribution to employee satisfaction and productivity.
IT Service Expert
Our experts for digital infrastructure tend to work behind the scenes. They keep everything running by providing a modern working environment, a high-performance system landscape, and robust IT security. As an interface with HR, they work closely with our Office Experts and HR teams during employee onboarding and offboarding. By providing the right technologies, they create workplaces where people can work creatively, productively, and collaboratively. IT Service Experts at SYBIT play a key role in enabling our employees to work efficiently.

# Markets Functions
## Overview of Roles in Markets
Do you have a talent for winning new customers for SYBIT? Or are you more of a copywriter and creative thinker? Whether Sales, Business Development, or Marketing, you are a driving force behind SYBIT’s revenue. Markets Functions at SYBIT cover a wide range of areas—and that’s exactly what makes them so exciting. Below, we provide an overview of the roles and responsibilities our Markets Experts take on at SYBIT and the skills they bring to the table. Marketing Manager
As a Marketing Manager at SYBIT, you are responsible for how our service portfolio and core competencies are perceived in the market, both online and offline. Short decision-making processes and an open-door culture give you the freedom to bring your creative ideas to life. Together with your team, you plan, develop, and refine concepts and strategies—for events, communications, and new ways of engaging with customers. You develop and execute a variety of campaigns to raise awareness of SYBIT’s first-class CX solutions and services and strengthen our brand awareness. Your enthusiasm and expertise help position SYBIT as an innovative company and Europe’s No. 1 for Customer Experience. Sales Manager
As a Sales Manager at SYBIT, you are responsible for actively acquiring new customers, maintaining existing customer relationships, and achieving revenue targets. You identify potential business opportunities, conduct sales meetings, and prepare proposals.
Your goal is to build long-term partnerships and drive revenue growth. You work closely with Business Development, Marketing, and Consulting to develop tailored CX solutions for our customers. Your sales strategies—and how you execute them—play a key role in SYBIT’s sustainable growth and success.
What Makes Working in Markets So Special?
> I really enjoy interacting with customers. You get to visit well-known companies, introduce them to SYBIT, and talk to highly knowledgeable people.

Managing Digital Projects That Create Real Value
As a Project Manager at SYBIT, you initiate, plan, organize, and manage projects from start to finish. You are present and involved throughout every process. But you’re not just a specialist in managing digital projects—you’re also a people person, coach, and mediator. Your strong communication and organizational skills help you identify risks early and resolve conflicts effectively. Do you want to be the driving force behind projects that create real value for our customers? We’re still missing your expertise. Join Team SYBIT. What Does a Project Manager Do at SYBIT?
As a Project Manager at SYBIT, you are responsible for the successful delivery of a project, both internally and externally. Internally, success is measured against the KPIs defined by Project Management, while externally, the project objectives agreed with the customer are the key measure of success.
When planning and managing projects, you use the agile project methodology established at SYBIT and decide which methods and tools are best suited to each individual project. You create schedules that serve as a roadmap throughout the project and ensure that sprint goals and deadlines are met. You also manage the project budget and monitor compliance using SYBIT’s project controlling tools.
Together with SYBIT’s Staffing Team, you assemble the project team and coordinate with team members regularly to make adjustments where necessary. On the customer side, you also ensure that all required project roles are filled and that the respective responsibilities are fulfilled.
As a Project Manager, you often support various areas of the project and take a hands-on approach when needed. You monitor the quality of the work and ensure that project objectives are achieved. You prioritize tasks, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and remain calm under pressure. Your decisions are always objective, well-founded, and structured.
Who Do Project Managers at SYBIT Work With?
You work in interdisciplinary teams. Because Project Managers coordinate all processes and maintain an overview of project activities, you interact with a variety of disciplines depending on the project and its requirements—including UX Designers, Consulting Experts, and Frontend and Backend Developers.
As the central point of contact, you keep everyone involved in the project up to date, lead meetings, and communicate regularly with customers. You ensure transparency regarding project status, identify risks, and define appropriate countermeasures. You escalate critical issues in a timely manner and are able to resolve conflicts effectively.
What Tools and Methods Do Project Managers at SYBIT Use?
To ensure efficient ways of working, we rely on modern tools. In Project Management, you should ideally be familiar with collaboration tools such as Atlassian Confluence and JIRA. Dedicated software is also used for resource administration and budget controlling, and you will receive training on these tools. If you’re not yet an expert in everything, don’t worry—your new colleagues will be there to support you, and you’ll learn many things on the job. 
## What Skills Make a Successful Project Manager at SYBIT?
In addition to clearly measurable hard skills such as budget controlling and resource administration, several interpersonal skills are essential to succeeding as a Project Manager at SYBIT and achieving both internal and external project objectives. You are able to:
- focus on the most important tasks to ensure that project objectives are achieved efficiently.
- understand complex relationships and explain them clearly to our customers.
- motivate and lead a team while fostering collaboration and team spirit.
- understand customer needs and expectations and provide solutions that benefit both the customer and the company.
- use your crisis management skills to respond quickly to technical challenges, make well-founded decisions, and resolve issues within the project.
- create a positive and productive working environment in which your team feels comfortable and motivated. What Makes Working as a Project Manager at SYBIT So Special?
> My job is incredibly varied. Every customer, industry, and project comes with its own unique requirements.
**Thomas Loos** Project Manager

# Software Engineer
Delivering the Best CX Applications Through Technical Expertise
Whether you’re enhancing a CRM or e-commerce system or transitioning to cloud-based solutions, you know how to bridge the gap between digital technologies and customer-centric processes. You’re not just a specialist in software implementation—you create a stable digital architecture. What makes product navigation intuitive? How are automated processes created to simplify digital order management? These are the kinds of questions our Software Architects and Engineers at SYBIT tackle every day. With your technical expertise, you bring the core of every CX application to life. Backend Application Engineer
As a Backend Application Engineer, you develop digital experiences such as webshops and sales platforms and integrate them into our customers’ existing infrastructure. You are also responsible for the continuous development of these systems based on functional and non-functional requirements. You implement new features that, for example, digitalize sales processes or make customer service more efficient. At the same time, you focus on non-functional aspects such as quality, maintainability, efficiency, and error resilience to continuously improve the systems. You oversee and manage long-term projects, such as migrating an e-commerce platform to a new system that brings together all customer processes—from the webshop and service portal to product configuration. Frontend Application Engineer
In this role, you work closely with our Design and UX Experts to bring their creations and content to life. As a Frontend Expert, you design sophisticated web solutions and implement them using test-driven and component-based approaches. Together with our Backend Experts, you work as one team to give processes a visual form. You develop web-based user interfaces, pattern libraries, and style guides in close collaboration with the UX teams, helping increase user engagement on our customers’ websites. Solution Architect
As an expert in system architecture, you develop customized concepts and technical solution scenarios. You support our customers throughout every phase of a project, gathering and structuring their business requirements and translating them into solutions by applying your technical expertise in areas such as infrastructure, interfaces, data modeling, and system architecture. Internally, you act as the link between the Project Manager and the Software Engineers. You make key architectural decisions and actively shape the development process. Together with other Software Architects, you develop future-proof solutions that form the foundation of our state-of-the-art CX applications. You share responsibility for architectural decisions, software delivery, and compliance with quality standards.

## How Do Software Engineers Work at SYBIT?
As a Software Engineer at SYBIT, you work with your team to define the first steps for developing and implementing new functionalities. During your daily stand-ups, you coordinate with one another, support each other, and regularly present the latest progress on their solution to our customers.
At SYBIT, we use modern technologies and a broad range of tools. Our approach is highly **team-oriented**, with a strong emphasis on **continuous improvement and knowledge sharing**.
Our day-to-day work is structured around **agile methodologies** such as Scrum and Kanban. Tools such as Atlassian Confluence and JIRA help us plan and manage our projects efficiently. Pair programming and regular code reviews are integral parts of our development process and help us continuously improve the quality of our software solutions.
A key aspect of our work is **close collaboration with our customers**. Our goal is not only to deliver functional software, but high-quality solutions that meet the highest standards. ## What Skills Are We Looking for in Software Engineering at SYBIT?
As a Software Engineer at SYBIT, you need a combination of methodological, technical, and interpersonal skills to succeed. Key competencies include technical expertise, an understanding of software architecture, and experience with agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban. Because your role involves frequent interaction with customers and working in a dynamic environment, you should be able to: - communicate technical information clearly and understandably and respond to customer questions.
- provide solutions that meet customer needs.
- quickly identify problems and develop effective solutions.
- respond to change and quickly adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
- work as a team player, understand different perspectives, and respond to them constructively. What Makes Working as a Software Engineer at SYBIT So Special?
> Our industry is evolving so quickly. That means I have to—and want to—keep up with the latest developments.

We have an exciting opportunity for Cyber Defence Analysts to join our global Information Security team, based in the A&O Shearman’s Belfast office.
This is a hands-on role for someone looking to build their career in Cyber Defence, working with a global team to investigate security alerts, respond to cyber incidents and help protect an international organisation from evolving cyber threats. You’ll gain exposure across a broad range of Cyber Defence activities while continuing to develop your technical expertise in areas such as incident response, threat detection, security tooling, and process improvement.
Please note that weekend working is a requirement for this role, with exact shift patterns discussed at interview. All weekend hours are eligible for a premium payment in addition to base salary.
What you will do
Investigate escalations• Investigate and prioritise escalated cyber security events and alerts, identifying potential incidents and escalating where appropriate.
• Investigate potential cyber security and data loss incidents raised by employees or third parties, following established Cyber Defence playbooks.
• Respond to information security queries, working with colleagues across the team to provide appropriate guidance.
Incident Response• Support incident response activities, including the initial triage, investigation, containment, mitigation and remediation of confirmed incidents.
• Gather and document relevant forensic evidence to support investigations.
• Participate in security incident response exercises and contribute to post-incident and post-exercise reviews.
• Work with Cyber Defence teams across different time zones as part of our 24/7 follow-the-sun global model, ensuring effective handover of ongoing incidents.
• Maintain awareness of emerging cyber threats, techniques and procedures, applying threat intelligence insights to day-to-day investigations.
• Participate in the Cyber Defence on-call rota, including out-of-hours support where required.
Tooling and Process Improvement• Support the implementation, enhancement and effective use of Cyber Defence tools and technologies.
• Help continuously improve Cyber Defence processes, playbooks and documentation.
• Identify opportunities to improve detection, investigation and response capabilities across the team.
Collaboration and Advisory• Work closely with Information Security, IT and other teams to strengthen the firm’s overall security posture.
• Provide practical Cyber Defence guidance to stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into clear, business-friendly language.
What you will have • 1+ years’ experience in Security Operations, Cyber Defence, a SOC, or a similar technical security environment.
• Practical experience across at least two areas such as alert triage, incident response, security engineering, detection/rule writing, DFIR, threat intelligence, vulnerability management or security control testing.
• Working knowledge of key Cyber Defence technologies, including SIEM, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection/EDR, firewalls and threat or vulnerability management tooling.
• Strong networking fundamentals, particularly TCP/IP, DNS and SMTP.
• An analytical and investigative mindset, with the ability to assess alerts and data, identify potential security incidents and determine appropriate next steps.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical cyber security issues clearly to different audiences.
You will stand out if you have• Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR), including relevant incident response or forensic training/certification.
• Penetration testing or web application security/testing.
• Scripting or automation using Python and/or PowerShell.
• Security experience across Azure, AWS or GCP.
• Relevant cyber security qualifications or certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP or CISM.

We have an exciting opportunity for an HR Operations Manager to join our HR Advice team, based in A&O Shearman’s Belfast Office. This role is available as a 12-month fixed-term contract.
HR Advice team – Belfast
The HR Advice Team provides consistent, high-quality and efficient HR operational support across the business. Working with Global HR colleagues, specialist teams and HRSSC colleagues, the team delivers responsive services, maintains reliable processes and data, and supports a positive employee and stakeholder experience.
What you will do
The HR Operations Manager oversees the delivery of HR operational services within HR Advice, providing day-to-day global operational oversight and ensuring HR policies and processes are applied consistently. The role drives continuous improvement, supports accurate and compliant HR data, systems and documentation, and works closely with HR SSC teams and global HR colleagues to resolve issues, improve ways of working and support HR projects and change initiatives.• Oversee and manage HR operational processes within HR Advice, ensuring services are delivered accurately, efficiently and to agreed standards.
• Manage and support HR Advice team members, promoting a collaborative, service-focused and high-performing team culture.
• Provide operational guidance to HR colleagues, resolving queries, removing blockers and escalating complex or sensitive matters where needed.
• Maintain and improve HR process documentation, guidance notes and knowledge materials to support consistent delivery.
• Act as a subject matter expert for HR processes, serving as a trusted escalation point and supporting better ways of working across the department.
• Support HR operational project workstreams, including the transition of HR administration processes from the firm’s global network into HR Advice.
• Assist the Senior HR Operations Manager with digital, AI, improvement and automation initiatives, helping shape practical, controlled and user-focused solutions
• Deputise and act as an escalation point for the Senior HR Operations manager in their absence.
• Ensure HR Advice activities comply with organisational policies, employment legislation, internal controls and data protection requirements.
• Aid with governance of the Global Policy Portal and Secondment Investment Group.
• Contribute to forums and working groups, sharing operational insight and capturing feedback from local HR teams and HRSSC colleagues.
• Identify recurring HR Advice themes and operational issues, escalating trends and supporting practical, sustainable improvements using data.
What you will have• Minimum of five years’ experience in HR operations, HR administration, shared services or a similar service delivery environment.
• Experience managing administrators, including recruitment, training and performance monitoring.
• Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, compliance requirements and the importance of confidentiality.
• Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately with HR data, systems and documentation.
• Confident user of HR systems and reporting tools, with the ability and willingness to develop deeper technical knowledge.
• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a busy operational environment.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad variety of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. “Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO
As a team:
As one of SAP’s Tier 1 global partners we understand the importance of data in our client’s transformation journeys. Whether in the context of a S/4HANA transformation or of a data roadmap we strive to bring leading thinking and delivery of innovative solutions to our clients. You will work on full lifecycle data journeys with clients from roadmap through to execution, delivering value through the latest features and benefits within SAP solution set.
In our team you will:
Advising clients on their data architecture and platform strategies, driving value creation through the positioning of BDC alongside platforms from other vendors, shaping this into holistic data architecture strategies to support our clients AI and Analytics journeys.
Leading the modernisation of clients BW landscapes, including shaping advice on BW PCE journeys and unlocking value through adoption of new BDC features.
Lead end to end BDC solution delivery in either S/4HANA transformations or in standalone data initiatives.
Work with a wide range of clients across many industries on their transformational journeys, ranging from smaller single function, in country projects to S/4HANA enabled global business transformations.
As a SAP BDC Architect you will: Be an integral part of our team supporting our clients SAP transformation projects through acting as a data and solutions architect. You will work closely with clients, translating their business and functional requirements into SAP functional designs and overseeing solution delivery. Your strong business data and platform knowledge, combined with your in-depth expertise will be key to designing effective and efficient solutions for our clients
We are looking for experience in the following skills:
At least two client delivery lifecycles on a solution stack that includes modern SAP data components including SAP Analytics Cloud and Datasphere.
Deep experience gained in the delivery of SAP BW based solutions; ability to rapidly assess clients BW existings investments as part of modernisation solutioning.
Extensive hands on delivery experience of SAP Analytics Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere and ideally some Databricks delivery experience.
Proven enterprise data and analytics architecture skills that include experience of other non SAP data platforms and approaches for the integration of these with SAP solutions.
Experience of integrating SAP with other modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake.
Proven experience of the delivery of data strategies on large complex S/4HANA transformation programs.
Proven capabilities in leading a distributed delivery team, working with colleagues in offshore delivery centres for solution delivery.
Strong communication skills and demonstrated experience of working with senior client stakeholders acting as a trusted advisor.
What’s in it for you
At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!
Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

- Design, build and maintain data pipelines, lakehouses, warehouses and related solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
- Develop reliable data ingestion, transformation and modelling processes aligned with business and financial reporting outcomes.

- Evaluate emerging Microsoft Fabric and data capabilities and recommend where they could deliver measurable value within appropriate controls.

About the Role
As Head of Design, you will lead Blackboard’s global User Experience and Design (UXD) organization and own the vision and strategy for how people experience our products, from Blackboard LMS and Blackboard Illuminate to Ally and our institutional effectiveness solutions. Your multidisciplinary team spans design, research, documentation, and accessibility, and works across web and mobile platforms in multiple countries and time zones.
This is a strategic leadership role. You will refine and evolve Blackboard’s design strategy, so it anticipates how teaching and learning are changing and drives measurable outcomes for our customers and our business. As a peer to leaders in Product Management and Product Development, you will make sure design shapes decisions from early discovery through delivery, and you will champion the value of design with executives, customers, and the wider design community.
You will also lead how design works in an AI-first era. We build the industry’s most AI-advanced LMS, and we expect our Head of Design to work hands-on with generative AI every day. That means using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Design, and other large language model (LLM)-based technologies to explore ideas, prototype, and test faster, and guiding the team to adopt them thoughtfully and responsibly.
Our design team is spread across multiple geographies including the UK, US, Colombia and Europe. You will lead it with flexibility and inclusion, building connection across locations and adjusting your own working hours when the business or the team needs you, so every colleague, in every time zone, has the access and support they need.
What does success look like? Products that solve complex problems with simplicity and elegance, a design culture of rapid iteration and continuous learning, and a team that is proud of both the work and the way it gets done.
What You Will Do
- Refine and evolve the design vision and strategy for Blackboard’s products, aligned with company strategy, product roadmaps, and business outcomes
- Lead, grow, and inspire a high-performing, diverse UXD organization across multiple countries and time zones, developing strong leaders at every level
- Partner with Product Management and Product Development leadership so design is integral to product planning, prioritization, and execution
- Champion the user across the product lifecycle through research, customer feedback sessions, and usability testing that inform decisions and validate solutions
- Lead the adoption of generative AI across the design practice, using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code and other LLM-based technologies in your own daily work and setting clear standards for responsible use
- Own design operations, including design systems, tooling, workflows, and quality standards that help teams deliver consistent, accessible experiences at scale
- Hold accessibility and inclusive design as the standard for every experience we ship
- Build an agile culture that iterates quickly and refines solutions based on data, user insight, and cross-functional collaboration
- Define clear roles, responsibilities, and ways of working between design, product management, and development teams
- Present design strategy, research insights, and solutions to executive, customer, and industry audiences, making the value of design clear
- Manage budget, resourcing, and priorities so work is delivered on time and aligned with product and organizational goals
- Flex your working hours as needed to support business priorities and a team distributed across time zones
- Travel up to 20% to support teams, customers, and company events
Required Skills and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
- At least 15 years of experience in user experience, product design, or a related field, including significant experience leading design leaders as well as individual contributors
- Proven experience building and scaling design organizations of 10+ professionals across disciplines such as Product Design, research, documentation, and accessibility
- Proven experience leading diverse, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions, and time zones
- A track record of defining and refining design strategy at an executive level and connecting design to measurable user and business outcomes
- Hands-on, everyday fluency with generative AI design technologies such as Figma Make, Claude Design, Claude Code and other LLM-based tools, with a clear point of view on how AI is reshaping design practice
- Deep expertise in modern design tools, including Figma, prototyping, and design systems, plus working knowledge of web standards (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, usability, and accessibility)
- Strong expertise in engaging customers and users through design research, testing, and iterative feedback loops
- A record of delivering simple, elegant solutions to complex problems in highly agile environments
- Strong leadership skills and the ability to create a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
- Flexibility to work outside standard hours when needed to collaborate with colleagues, partners, and customers in other time zones
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex design concepts clear to any audience
- Experience with accessibility standards such as the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
- Fluency in written and spoken English

About Allica Bank
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
Department Description
Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.
Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.
In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.
Role Description
All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this. Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team). We expect our Relationship Managers to be recognised as valued partners and experts in business finance by their clients and in the communities they serve.
Principal Accountabilities
- Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks
- Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.
- Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.
- Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.
- Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.
- Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values
- Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.
Personal Attributes & Experience
- Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships.
- You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending.
- You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.
- You will be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work.
- You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.
- You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.
- You’ll have a proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.
- You’ll demonstrate an ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

job_description:
We are seeking a Senior Product Leader to build agentic shopping experiences on
Amazon. Alexa for Shopping (AFS), formerly Rufus, is Amazon's Shopping AI, a
high-visibility generative AI investment within the Stores business built on
large language models (LLMs). Our vision is for AFS to be an always-on personal
shopping agent that learns what matters to each customer, anticipates their
needs, and acts on their behalf. Beyond responding to requests, AFS will
proactively recognize opportunities to help, suggest timely next steps, and
follow through on goals that unfold over days, weeks, or months.
If you are passionate about reinventing e-commerce, helping customers offload
tedious shopping tasks to smart, autonomous AI, and building a team that does
the same, this is a rare opportunity to define the future of agentic commerce at
Amazon.
In this role, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AFS's agentic
portfolio. The portfolio spans customer-initiated automations such as price and
deal alerts and replenishment, proactive experiences where AFS recognizes
opportunities to help, long-running goals that AFS follows through over weeks or
months, and the platform capabilities that let teams across Amazon Stores build
agentic experiences. You will lead a team of PM-Ts, each owning a set of
features. You will set the portfolio's goals, decide where to invest, and hold
the team to a high bar on customer outcomes. Success means customers save time,
money, and effort, trust AFS to act within their instructions, and engage more,
with progress measured in customer value per action.
To get there, you will shape the priorities of AFS Engineering and Science
teams, pairing a clear product vision with rigorous technical execution. You
will partner with multiple Applied Science and Engineering organizations to push
new frontiers and build experiences that state-of-the-art models only now make
possible. You will make data-driven portfolio decisions: which bets to scale,
which to iterate, and which to retire, grounded in experiment results and
customer signals. You will also hire, coach, and develop product leaders who
invent novel LLM-driven interactions that balance technical feasibility with
customer delight.
Key job responsibilities
Build
- Build and prototype hands-on. Use AI-native tools to turn ideas into working
agentic prototypes in days, test them with customers and leaders, and to set
engineering and science priorities.
- Dogfood the portfolio and competitive landscape and make it a team habit.
- Set the bar for agent quality, trust, and safety with Science and Responsible
AI partners.
- Partner with platform teams to define the shared agentic primitives (triggers,
mission state, actions, scheduling) that let builders across Amazon Stores
launch experiences independently.
Think Big
- Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for the agentic portfolio,
and write the narratives (OP1, PRFAQs, strategy docs) that align senior
leadership on where agentic commerce goes next.
- Define portfolio goals and metrics that tie agentic features to incremental
customer and business value. Decide which bets to scale, iterate, or retire
based on experiment results and customer signals.
- Invent new interaction models for agentic shopping, and set the direction for
capabilities that state-of-the-art models only now make possible.
Lead
- Hire, coach, and develop a team of PM-Ts who are builders and strategic
thinkers. Set clear ownership boundaries, raise the bar on product judgment,
technical depth, and writing, and expect every PM to prototype and dogfood.
- Set priorities across Engineering, Science, UX, and partner teams, including
Notifications, Personalization, Pricing, Search, and Ads, and resolve trade-offs
across team boundaries.
- Run the review mechanisms (WBRs, goal reviews, launch readiness) that drive
delivery, experimentation, and international expansion of the portfolio. Basic
Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience managing teams
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and
strategy related to a product
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product Preferred
Qualifications: - Experience delivering consumer software products and services
in a high growth environment

THE OPPORTUNITY
Join our new AGI safety product team and help transform AI control research into practical tools that directly reduce risks from AI. As an Research Scientist (Control), you’ll work closely with Marius (CEO & currently leads the monitoring efforts), other control researchers and product engineers.
We are currently building Watcher, a monitoring tool for coding agents. Our monitoring research agenda attempts to translate compute into safety at scale. You will join a small team and will have significant ability to shape the team & tech, and have the ability to earn responsibility quickly.
You will like this opportunity if you're passionate about using empirical research to make AI systems safer in practice. You enjoy the challenge of translating theoretical AI risks into concrete detection mechanisms. You thrive on rapid iteration and learning from data. You want your research to directly impact real-world AI safety.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
TLDR: you will design & implement control protocols (see e.g. [Greenblatt et al, 2023]) and test them on real-world production systems at scale.
Research & Development
- Design and conduct experiments to test monitor effectiveness across different failure modes and agent behaviors
- Build and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure progress on monitoring capabilities
- Build and maintain high-quality datasets to train and test monitors on
- Iterate on monitoring approaches based on empirical results, balancing detection accuracy with computational efficiency
- Contribute newly discovered coding agent failure modes to Apollo's shared failure mode library (owned by the AI Security & Control Researcher/Engineer) as they surface during monitor design, evaluation, and iteration
- Stay current with research on AI safety, agent failures, and detection methodologies
- Stay current with research into coding security and safety vulnerabilities
Fine-tuning & Monitor Development
- Fine-tune open-source models to create efficient monitors for high-volume production environments
- Design and build agentic monitoring systems that autonomously investigate logs to identify both known and novel failure modes
- Incorporate adversarial findings from red-teaming campaigns into monitor design and evaluation, closing the loop between attack and defense
JOB REQUIREMENTS
Must-haves
- 2+ years of experience conducting empirical research with large language models or AI systems
- Strong experience with AI coding agents. For example, having extensively used and compared frontier coding agents, or having designed / developed coding agents
- Experience with LLM-as-a-judge setups or AI monitoring more broadly
- Experience designing and running experiments, analyzing results, and iterating based on empirical findings e.g. prompting, scaffolding, agent design, fine-tuning, or RL
- Strong Python programming skills

Good-to-haves
- Familiarity with AI safety concepts, particularly agent-related risks
- Familiarity with computer security, e.g. security testing and secure system design

- Previous work building developer tools or monitoring systems

We want to emphasize that people who feel they don't fulfill all of these characteristics but think they would be a good fit for the position nonetheless are strongly encouraged to apply.
REPRESENTATIVE PROJECTS
- Hierarchical monitoring for coding agent security: Design a multi-layer monitoring system for detecting security vulnerabilities introduced by coding agents. Start by cataloging common security failure modes (e.g., hardcoded credentials, SQL injection vulnerabilities, insecure API calls). Build specialized monitors for each category, then create a hierarchical system where fast, efficient first-pass monitors flag potentially problematic code for deeper investigation by more sophisticated monitors.
- Design a backtesting strategy for Watcher: Validate the system on synthetic test cases and real agent outputs, iterating to optimize the tradeoff between detection rates and false positives while maintaining low latency for most monitoring decisions.
- Fine-tune an open-source model to be a great monitor: Take an open-source model and fine-tune it on our large dataset of coding agent failures with high-quality ground truth labels. Test different fine-tuning techniques and measure generalization to our held-out data. Compare against prompted baselines on accuracy, cost and latency. The goal is to fine-tune models to lift the pareto frontier of monitors.

Summary
Purpose: As a Production Planning Administrator, you will be focusing primarily on the latter stages of the question paper printing process, ensuring that the correct question paper documents are progressed and printed, ready for dispatch to centres for examinations. This role is key in upholding AQA’s high standards for reliability and fairness and making sure they never let a learner down.
Your main responsibilities will primarily revolve around the administration of the final stages of the production process. This will include approving documents and hard copies of exams, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to deal with queries and handling data regarding stock levels and production progress. You will also be required to support in making the correct versions of each exam paper available for day of download by centres, as well as filing hard copies of question papers into our archive for reference during the exam series.Landscape: Each year, there are consistently over 10,000,000 question papers printed for over 500 separate components. These are not only standard question papers, but also modified versions for candidates who require larger font papers as well as braille and tactile versions. Your role within Secure Print Operations will act as a link between the Assessment Management team who create the question paper files to the external suppliers who produce the hard copy printed versions. Our main job is to ensure the question paper files get to the external printers in time for them to print the papers to get them ready for dispatch to centres. This role is critical in getting question papers ready in time for centres to be ready for exams.
Secure Print Operations works as a small team. As an administrator, you will be led by two leads as well as the department manager. You will need to be able to communicate with internal colleagues within Assessment Delivery, Assessment Design and Outbound Logistics primarily. Externally, we have printer companies, braille suppliers, CD duplicators and material suppliers that we also communicate with.
Activities:
Checking final ‘passed for press’ versions of question paper files
Sending checked files to the external printers as well as any other internal colleagues who require them in a secure and prompt fashion
Dealing with queries from internal teams regarding question papers
Checking hard copy versions of question papers
Archiving hard copy versions of question papers
Keeping on top of all administrative requirements in relation to question paper production, including updating all data in our spreadsheets, moving files securely between locations, saving backups of files to name a few
Acquiring data from external suppliers to help monitor stock levels of materials and delivery information and act on the insight required
Creating and updating documents required by internal and external parties which stem from the data we receive through our processes
Supporting in the creation of spreadsheets required by the team to aid our processes
Involved in the management of issues regarding question papers and resolving
Supporting with invoicing where appropriate
Making final versions of all question paper and supplementary files available for day of exam download
To be successful in this role, you will need to know:
Attention To Detail – to spot any possible issues with the material you will be checking
Initiative – to be able to take on tasks that emerge and may not have been part of any previous plans
Effective Communication – you will need to be happy talking to stakeholders inside and outside the company in a positive and professional manner to deal with queries
Problem Solving/decision making – queries can arise which may require you to find out who needs to solve them or potentially find ways of solving them yourself with support from others
Team working – Working alongside others in a co-operative and friendly manner with the collective purpose of achieving the team’s goals. Making plans together with the other administrators to understand who will do what tasks within the team to help fulfil our purpose
Working under pressure – Our team handle a lot of documents and it’s possible there maybe multiple queries occurring at the same time as well as different tasks that need juggling. You will need to remain calm so as to better fulfil your tasks in a timely, positive and professional manner
Planning and prioritising – There may be multiple tasks that you need to look at. You will need to be able to understand what tasks require prioritising and plan to carry out those tasks in an order that makes sense

About Atom Learning
Our mission is to help every child reach their potential. We combine teacher-made content with technology, data science and machine learning to make personalised education accessible to every child.
Nearly half a million children have learned on Atom, answering more than 750 million questions. Around 1,900 schools use Atom, and Quest, our standardised assessment platform, has delivered more than 1.1 million assessments since September 2024. We’re 100+ people across 10 countries, remote-first, with an office in London.
The role
Data at Atom isn’t a reporting function. It powers products that families and teachers act on: predicted grades, adaptive learning, and the probability of exam outcomes. On our busiest days, more than a million new question responses flow through the platform.
You’ll own how that data is modelled and made available. The hard part is getting it right:
• the right grain;
• point-in-time correctness, so we can reconstruct a pupil’s score as it stood last term;
• builds that give the same answer every time they run;
• catching data quality problems before they reach a teacher’s dashboard.
You won’t be one of 30 data engineers. You’ll be our go-to data specialist in a small, cross-functional engineering team, setting the direction of how we model and move data. You’ll own problems end to end, often starting from a loosely defined product request. We expect you to make the call and explain your reasoning.
Our stack: CockroachDB for the application, then BigQuery, dbt, Airflow and pub/sub. Data flows both ways, into analytics and back into the product.
What you’ll do
• Design and build the data models behind customer-facing features
• Build and own reliable pipelines between our application, warehouse and product
• Shape the technical direction of our data platform and data modelling standards
• Improve testing, data quality and observability so others can trust the data
• Review other engineers’ code and designs critically, and push back when something won’t hold up
• Mentor engineers and raise data capability across the wider team
• Make data easier for engineers and teams to use safely
• Use AI tools throughout your work, with the judgement to know when they’re wrong
What you’ll need
• Significant experience designing, building and scaling production data pipelines and models in Python and SQL, including owning design decisions others build on
• Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (ideally BigQuery) and dbt
• Strong data modelling instincts: you think about grain, history and idempotency by default
• A habit of looking for data quality issues rather than assuming the data is clean
• Experience leading technical decisions and reviewing others’ work: you’re comfortable challenging a design, not just spotting bugs
• Experience owning work end to end with a high degree of autonomy
• Fluent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain data problems to non-technical colleagues
• Confidence with AI tools, and the ability to explain and defend everything you ship
Nice to have
Airflow, CDC or event-driven pipelines (CockroachDB or Postgres), Tableau or Metabase, experience building data-powered product features.
If you have the core skills but not every tool on the list, apply. We care more about how you model data than which orchestrator you’ve used.
How we hire
1. An intro call with our People team
2. A take-home task: a small modelling problem in BigQuery. 3. A technical interview with members of the data team.
4. A final interview with our Engineering Director

As the newly created EMEA Regional Information Security Officer (RISO), you will serve as the senior Global Information Security (GIS) leader for the region, setting strategic direction, leading regulatory engagement and owning oversight of information security risk across a diverse, complex and highly regulated footprint.
Reporting to the International Information Security Executive, you will lead the EMEA team of Country Information Security Officers and act as a trusted partner to business executives and senior leaders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Audit and Legal, ensuring cyber and information security risks are clearly understood, robustly governed and decisively addressed.
This is a highly visible, enterprise-critical role. You will shape regional regulatory engagement, advise country management teams and legal entity boards, and represent GIS with regulators and external stakeholders. Above all, you will translate global security strategy into regional action, ensuring the organisation stays ahead of evolving threats, regulatory expectations and business priorities.
Responsibilities:
Regional Leadership and Strategy
• Own the execution of GIS strategy, priorities and operating plans across EMEA, with full accountability for regional outcomes.
• Provide visible leadership and clear direction to Country Information Security Officers across the region.
• Translate global information security objectives into regionally effective programmes and operating routines.
• Act as the senior voice of GIS within regional leadership forums and governance structures.
Regulatory Engagement and Country Oversight
• Lead and oversee regulatory engagement across EMEA on information security matters.
• Ensure the region is fully prepared for regulatory reviews, examinations and information requests.
• Anticipate regional regulatory developments and emerging supervisory expectations, positioning the bank ahead of change.

• Set the standard for consistent regulatory responses, governance practices and risk reporting across jurisdictions.
• Escalate significant regulatory concerns and thematic issues to the International RISO and GIS leadership, with clear recommendations.
Information Security Risk Management
• Own oversight of regional information security risk management across EMEA.
• Ensure key cyber risks, vulnerabilities and control weaknesses are identified, tracked and remediated with appropriate urgency.
• Partner with Technology, Business, Risk and Compliance leaders to drive meaningful risk reduction and remediation.
• Maintain a clear line of sight on material regional cyber threats and emerging risks.
• Provide senior oversight and steady leadership during significant cybersecurity incidents affecting EMEA entities or operations.
Country Information Security Management
• Lead and coordinate the network of Country Information Security Officers across EMEA.
• Provide governance, direction and constructive challenge to country information security activities.
• Ensure Country ISOs have the capability, guidance and support needed to meet local regulatory obligations.
• Promote consistent, high-quality execution of information security oversight across countries and legal entities.
• Align country-level information security priorities with broader GIS objectives.
Stakeholder Management and Influence
• Build trusted relationships with regional executives, legal entity boards and control partners.
• Serve as the senior information security adviser to regional management teams, influencing decisions at the highest level.
• Partner with Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Audit and Legal leadership to address regulatory and risk management priorities.
• Contribute to the bank's engagement with industry, government and public-private sector partnerships focused on cyber resilience and information security.
Leadership and People Development
• Lead, mentor and develop a geographically distributed team across multiple jurisdictions.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Build a diverse, high-performing team aligned with GIS leadership principles.
• Strengthen the GIS talent pipeline across EMEA, developing the next generation of security leaders.
What we are looking for:
• A senior leader with extensive experience in information security, cyber risk management, technology risk, operational risk or a related field.
• Significant experience operating at a senior level within highly regulated financial services environments.
• Deep understanding of information security governance, regulatory frameworks and cyber risk management practices.
• A proven track record of engaging with and influencing regulators, board members and senior executives.
• Proven leadership of geographically distributed teams, with the ability to set direction and drive accountability at scale.
• Strong command of regional and global cybersecurity threats and associated control environments.
• The ability to influence across complex, matrixed organisations and deliver outcomes through partnership and collaboration.
• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management and board-level presentation skills.
• Strong strategic thinking, sound judgement and decisive problem-solving capabilities.
Skills that will help:
• CISSP, CISM or equivalent industry certifications.
• Experience supporting multinational financial institutions.
• Knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, including DORA, NIS2, ECB expectations and country-specific requirements.
• Experience managing regulatory examinations and remediation programmes.
• Expertise in enterprise risk management, regulatory relations and information security governance.
• Strong executive presence and credibility at board level.
• Expertise in cyber resilience and operational resilience.
Managerial Responsibilities
The EMEA RISO will have direct management responsibility for Country Information Security Officers and will be accountable for:
• Building and sustaining a high-performing regional team.

• Managing regional resourcing and organisational priorities.

job_title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
job_description:
ABOUT US
Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.
Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.
In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.
At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.
THE ROLE
You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer.
We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards.
You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include:
- Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise.
- Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk.
- Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail.
- Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work.
We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community.
You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and experimental teams across the company.
ABOUT YOU
You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed.
You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You understand modern machine learning and can write the code, run the experiments, and analyse the results needed to test your ideas.
You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work.
You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim.
You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them.
You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project. You care about enabling useful scientific and medical applications of AI and are motivated to make them safer.
NICE TO HAVE
- Research experience in AI safety or biosecurity, including evaluations, red-teaming, or threat modelling.
- Experience with protein design, genomic models, structure prediction, or other biological AI systems.
- Experimental biology experience, or computational research validated in collaboration with an experimental team.
- Experience implementing and evaluating safeguards in deployed systems.
- Collaboration with biosecurity organisations, synthesis screening initiatives, or AI safety institutes.
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
WHAT WE OFFER IN RETURN
- Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..
- Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.
- High Growth: We truly believe in investing our people we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.
- Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

Job Description

This role is advertised as part of our [BBC Extend programme](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/extend/) for disabled people. To apply for this role you should identify as deaf, disabled or neurodivergent and must meet either: [the definition of disability in the Equality Act (2010)](https://www.gov.uk/definition-of-disability-under-equality-act-2010), or the definition of disability in the [Disability Discrimination Act (1995)](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1995/50/section/1) if applying in Northern Ireland. You’re broadly defined as disabled under both acts if you have a physical or mental impairment that has a substantial and long-term negative or adverse effect on your ability to do normal daily activities. This definition includes both apparent and non-apparent conditions and impairments, and medical conditions such as Cancer, HIV or Multiple Sclerosis.  
We are committed to making the process of applying for this role as accessible as possible. If you need to discuss adjustments or access requirements for the application process, or have any questions about our Extend programme, please contact us via the [Early Careers Recruitment contact form](https://app.smartsheet.com/b/form/fb9285d0c9bb4ebaa7dc7d22615d8305) and choose the ‘Reasonable Adjustments’ option. 
The BBC are fully committed to providing workplace adjustments to help eliminate barriers in the workface that disabled people face. To do this, we have our own dedicated BBC Access and Disability Service that provides assessments and support throughout employment with us. If you are successful in applying for this role and require workplace adjustments, we will work with you to get your adjustments in place. 
If you’d like more information on BBC Extend, please visit the [BBC Extend webpage](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/extend/).
## **WE ARE BBC STUDIOS**
A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought-after TV, audio and digital content. Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.
## **COULD A BBC APPRENTICESHIP BE THE NEXT ROLE FOR YOU?**
Join us as an apprentice at the BBC Studios to give yourself the opportunity to kick-start your career in a job you'll love. We’re committed to your skills and talent development. You’ll learn on-the-job, developing your knowledge and skills in an area that interests you, while working towards your apprenticeship qualification with one of our learning providers. 
## **WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?**
The Content Creator apprenticeship is designed to equip you with the skills to create engaging, impactful content across a range of platforms. You’ll learn how to plan and develop creative ideas, research target audiences, and produce audio, visual and written content suitable for different channels. 
This hands-on, immersive programme combines practical workshops, interactive sessions, assignments and collaborative group projects. You’ll gain experience in creating, recording and editing video and audio content, while developing your planning, presentation and pitching skills. The scheme also provides a foundation in photography and imaging, social media and search engine optimisation (SEO), and website creation, giving you a broad understanding of modern digital content production.
**Want to find out more?** Watch recordings from our webinar series on our [Life at the BBC YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQirbxfWHEPimmLiTI-yrGoMNMV1FRfWK&si=eCgNZuWfnZICtWz1) to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.
## **WHY JOIN THE TEAM?**
BBC Studios Digital are a content creation and publishing team, who manage the digital accounts of some of the world’s best loved entertainment brands including Bluey, Top Gear, Doctor Who and BBC Earth. This role would sit within the Digital Content team, who are responsible for content development and production across all digital platforms. We commission original pieces, respond to commercial branded briefs, and produce over 12,000 pieces of written, graphic, and video content per year.
## **YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT**
As a Content Creator apprentice, this is brilliant opportunity to learn, grow, and contribute – you could expect to:  
- Play a part in creating trusted, high-quality content for BBC audiences.
- Grow your storytelling skills through hands-on experience researching, writing, producing and editing content on a range of subjects.
- Develop your digital content skills by monitoring audience trends and creating content for social media platforms, including selecting and editing clips from programmes for use on social media platforms.  
- Spot opportunities for digital content, including short clips, behind-the-scenes moments, interviews and talent‑led extras.
- Learn from experienced professionals, collaborate with expert teams and develop your career at the world's largest public service broadcaster. 
You’ll study for your industry recognised apprenticeship qualification, learning both on and off the job. This means that as well as learning on your placement at the BBC, you’ll also attend learning blocks (up to a week at a time) with our learning provider, working towards an industry recognised apprenticeship qualification - Level 3 Content Creator.
Learning blocks will be a mixture of in-person and virtual delivery, including attending instructor-led workships, tutorial sessions, presentations and group work.
For more information on what you will study during the scheme, please see the [Content Creator apprenticeship standard.](https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/apprenticeships/st0105-v2-0)
## **YOUR SKILLS AND ELIGIBILITY**
We’re interested in your passion for working at the BBC and your enthusiasm for delivering world-class content and operational excellence to our audiences. We’re not focused on your qualifications; instead, we look for potential and offer you the opportunity to apply your transferable strengths and experience to work in different ways. 
If you can bring some of these skills and experiences, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply:  
- Bring fresh, creative ideas for engaging and reaching new audiences.  
- A genuine consumer of content who follows what is happening across platforms like TikTok, YouTube and Instagram.
- Adaptable and versatile, able to switch between serious, issue‑based content and fun, high-energy entertainment.
- A collaborative team player who is organised, motivated, adaptable and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- Passionate about your own self-development, showing the discipline and commitment required to complete the apprenticeship. 
This scheme is aimed at **non-graduates.** If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the [BBC careers site](https://careers.bbc.co.uk/) or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes. 
## **ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA**
To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must:
- Identify as disabled under the Equality Act (2010).
- Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027.
- Have lived in the UK continuously for the last three years prior to the start of the apprenticeship.
- Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship.
- Not currently be enrolled in another apprenticeship programme, whether with the BBC or another organisation.
- No prior learning is required to apply.
