## **AI UN O BRENTISIAETHAU’R BBC YW’R SWYDD NESAF I CHI?**
Ymunwch â ni fel prentis yn y BBC i roi hwb i’ch gyrfa mewn swydd y byddwch wrth eich bodd â hi. Rydym ni wedi ymrwymo i’ch helpu chi i ddatblygu eich sgiliau a’ch talent. Byddwch yn dysgu yn y gwaith ac yn cael cyfle i ddatblygu eich gwybodaeth a’ch sgiliau mewn maes y mae gennych chi ddiddordeb mawr ynddo, a hynny wrth weithio tuag at eich cymhwyster prentisiaeth gydag un o’n darparwyr dysgu. 
## **PAM YMUNO Â’R CYNLLUN?**
Dyma gyfle i chi lansio gyrfa yng nghanol y byd darlledu ym Mhrydain. Rydym ni'n chwilio am unigolion sy'n frwd dros ganfod sut rydym ni'n creu cynnwys ac yn dod â syniadau'n fyw. Yn dibynnu ar ardal eich lleoliad, gallech chi fod yn gweithio y tu ôl i'r llenni ar gynyrchiadau cyffrous, megis dramâu gafaelgar neu wefr radio byw, ac ennill cymhwyster cydnabyddedig wrth ddysgu yn y gwaith. Dyma gyfle i chi ehangu eich gwybodaeth am gynhyrchu wrth weithio ar gynnwys sy'n bwysig i filiynau. 
**Eisiau gwybod mwy?** Gwyliwch recordiadau o’n cyfres o weminarau ar ein [rhestr chwarae YouTube Bywyd yn y BBC](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQirbxfWHEPimmLiTI-yrGoMNMV1FRfWK)  i ddysgu mwy am y cynllun hwn a’r cyfleoedd eraill rydym ni’n eu cynnig, ac i glywed gan ein prentisiaid presennol am eu profiadau nhw.
Mae lleoedd ar y Brentisiaeth Cynorthwyydd Cynhyrchu ar gael ar draws amrywiaeth o dimau yn y lleoliad hwn, yn ogystal â lleoliadau eraill. Mae manylion lleoliadau gwaith eraill sydd ar gael yn y lleoliad hwn [ar wefan Gyrfaoedd Cynnar y BBC.](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/work/early-careers/production/#productionassistantlevel3)
## **PAM YMUNO Â’R TÎM?**
**BBC Radio Cymru** yw gorsaf radio Gymraeg genedlaethol Cymru ac mae’n darlledu ers 1977. Cafodd Radio Cymru 2 yn cael ei lansio yn 2018. Ar gyfartaledd, rydym yn darlledu dros 22 awr o raglenni bob dydd i dros 100,000 o wrandawyr ledled Cymru a’r tu hwnt. Mae Radio Cymru yn gwasanaethu siaradwyr Cymraeg o bob oed a diddordeb drwy ddarparu rhaglenni cerddoriaeth, rhaglenni dogfen, sioeau trafod, materion cyfoes a gwleidyddiaeth, crefydd, y celfyddydau, a llawer mwy. Rydym hefyd yn darlledu o ddigwyddiadau o bob math, megis Eisteddfod yr Urdd, Tafwyl, y Sioe Frenhinol, a'r Eisteddfod Genedlaethol. Cerddoriaeth gyfoes yw ffocws Radio Cymru 2. 
Fel Prentis Cynorthwyydd Cynhyrchu yn y BBC, byddwch chi’n cael profiad ymarferol ar draws amrywiaeth o brosiectau – o gefnogi cynyrchiadau uchel eu proffil i gyfrannu at gynnwys y mae cynulleidfaoedd ledled y DU yn ei fwynhau. Byddwch chi’n gweithio ochr yn ochr â gweithwyr proffesiynol profiadol, yn datblygu sgiliau ymarferol ac yn chwarae rhan weithredol yn y gwaith o ddod â syniadau creadigol yn fyw. Gallai’r brentisiaeth hon arwain at gyfleoedd i weithio fel:
•    Is-ymchwilydd •    Rhedwr •    Cynorthwyydd Cynnwys neu Olygu
## **EICH PRIF GYFRIFOLDEBAU A’CH DYLANWAD**
Fel Prentis Cynorthwyydd Cynhyrchu gyda Chwaraeon BBC Radio Cymru, mae hwn yn gyfle gwych i ddysgu, tyfu a chyfrannu. Fe allech chi fod yn:
- Helpu i ddatblygu syniadau a straeon drwy ymchwilio i gynnwys a dod o hyd i westeion a chyfranogwyr.
- Ennill profiad bywyd go iawn drwy gynorthwyo eich tîm ar leoliad, yn y stiwdio, neu mewn oriel deledu, a helpu ar lawr y stiwdio.
- Dysgu sut mae defnyddio offer technegol a meddalwedd arbenigol drwy gefnogi timau gyda chamerâu, sain, goleuadau a golygu.
- Creu cynnwys ar gyfer sawl llwyfan, gan gynnwys cyfryngau cymdeithasol, o dan arweiniad gweithwyr proffesiynol profiadol. Byddwch yn astudio ar gyfer eich cymhwyster prentisiaeth sy’n cael ei gydnabod gan y diwydiant, gan ddysgu yn y gwaith a’r tu allan i'r gwaith.  Mae hyn yn golygu y byddwch chi, yn ogystal â dysgu ar eich lleoliad yn y BBC, yn mynychu blociau dysgu (hyd at wythnos ar y tro) gyda'n darparwr dysgu, gan weithio tuag at gymhwyster prentisiaeth a gydnabyddir gan y diwydiant – Lefel 3 y Cyfryngau Creadigol. Bydd y blociau dysgu yn gyfuniad o ddarpariaeth wyneb yn wyneb a rhithwir, gan gynnwys:
- Cyflwyniadau
- Gwaith grŵp
Fel rhan o’r rhaglen, bydd gofyn i chi deithio i fynd i flociau dysgu wyneb yn wyneb a gweithgareddau eraill sy’n gysylltiedig â’r brentisiaeth lle bo angen. I gael rhagor o wybodaeth am safon y brentisiaeth y byddwch yn ei hastudio, darllenwch y manylion yn [Fframwaith Lefel 3 Cyfryngau Creadigol.](https://acwcerts.co.uk/web/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ACW-Creative-Media-FR05018.pdf)
## **EICH SGILIAU A’CH CYMHWYSEDD**
Rydym ni eisiau gwybod pam eich bod chi’n awyddus i weithio yn y BBC, ac mae gennym ddiddordeb yn eich brwdfrydedd i ddarparu cynnwys o’r radd flaenaf a rhagoriaeth weithredol i’n cynulleidfaoedd. Eich potensial sy’n bwysig i ni, nid eich cymwysterau, a byddwn ni’n rhoi cyfle i chi roi eich profiad a’ch cryfderau trosglwyddadwy ar waith mewn gwahanol ffyrdd.  Os oes gennych chi rai o’r sgiliau a’r profiadau hyn, ynghyd â chryfderau trosglwyddadwy, byddem yn falch o glywed gennych chi ac rydym yn eich annog i wneud cais:
- Rhywun sy’n angerddol a chwilfrydig am gynnwys, y broses gynhyrchu a’r BBC  
- Rhywun sy’n llawn syniadau newydd a safbwyntiau ffres am gynnwys y BBC
- Rhywun sy’n aelod gwych o dîm ac yn gallu delio â heriau annisgwyl  
- Rhywun sy’n hyblyg ac yn gallu addasu i’r gwaith er mwyn helpu i ddarparu ein cynnwys.
Mae'r cynllun hwn wedi'i anelu at **bobl heb raddio.** Os oes gennych chi radd a bod gennych chi ddiddordeb mewn rolau tebyg yn y BBC, rydym yn argymell eich bod yn gwneud cais am swyddi ar [wefan gyrfaoedd y BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/)  neu’n edrych ar ein cynlluniau prentisiaeth eraill. 
## **MEINI PRAWF CYMHWYSEDD**
Mae’n rhaid i chi fodloni’r gofynion canlynol i fod yn gymwys ar gyfer prentisiaeth yn y BBC:
- Bod yn 18 oed neu’n hŷn erbyn y bydd y brentisiaeth yn dechrau ym mis Medi 2027
- Bod wedi byw yn y DU yn ddi-dor am y tair blynedd cyn dechrau’r brentisiaeth
- Bod yn gymwys yn gyfreithiol i weithio’n llawn-amser yn y Deyrnas Unedig am holl gyfnod y brentisiaeth
- Bod heb gofrestru ar gynllun prentisiaeth arall sy’n cael ei gefnogi gan y BBC neu sefydliad arall ar hyn o bryd
I gwblhau'r brentisiaeth, rhaid i chi fod â TGAU Gradd 4/C neu uwch mewn Mathemateg a Saesneg, neu National 5 (Yr Alban) Gradd C, neu Sgiliau Gweithredol Lefel 2 neu gymhwyster cyfatebol. Os nad ydych chi wedi ennill y cymwysterau hyn erbyn dechrau eich prentisiaeth, bydd gofyn i chi gyflawni Sgiliau Swyddogaethol Lefel 2 cyn diwedd cyfnod asesu'r brentisiaeth pan fyddwch chi’n cwblhau eich asesiad terfynol.  
## **BAROD I YMGEISIO?**
Peidiwch â cholli'r cyfle i fod yn rhan o rywbeth cyffrous. Ydych chi'n eich gweld eich hun yn ffynnu yn y rôl hon? Cliciwch ‘Ymgeisio Nawr’!  Bydd angen i chi greu proffil ymgeisydd ac ateb ambell gwestiwn – does dim angen CV na llythyr cais.  Os ydych chi’n gymwys, byddwn ni’n eich tywys drwy’r camau nesaf gan roi syniad i chi o beth i’w ddisgwyl.  Bydd angen i chi fyw o fewn pellter teithio i leoliad y swydd hon. Eisiau gweithio o leoliad gwahanol? Edrychwch ar ein hysbysebion eraill – ond cofiwch mai dim ond am un swydd y dylech wneud cais.  Mae hon yn brentisiaeth am gyfnod penodol – bydd eich contract yn para hyd ddiwedd y cynllun. Ar ôl i chi gwblhau eich prentisiaeth, byddwch yn gallu gwneud cais am unrhyw swyddi gwag addas yn y BBC neu yn y sector creadigol ehangach. Byddwch yn cael cymorth gyda datblygiad gyrfa, hyfforddiant cyflogadwyedd, a chyfleoedd rhwydweithio i’ch helpu i gymryd y cam nesaf. Ar gyfer cyfleoedd prentisiaeth, bydd ymgeiswyr anabl sy’n dewis gwneud cais o dan y Cynllun Hyderus o ran Anabledd ac sy’n bodloni’r meini prawf sylfaenol ar gyfer y rôl yn symud ymlaen i gam nesaf y broses recriwtio fel arfer. Ar gyfer y rhan fwyaf o’n hymgyrchoedd, byddai hyn yn golygu asesiad ar-lein sydd wedi’i gynllunio i asesu eich sgiliau, eich cymhellion a’ch addasrwydd ar gyfer y swydd.  Mae rhagor o fanylion ar gael yn yr [adran Cwestiynau Cyffredin ar ein gwefan gyrfaoedd.](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/work/early-careers/faqs/#applicationguidance)

Mae’r disgrifiad swydd hwn yn ddatganiad ysgrifenedig o nodweddion hanfodol y swydd, gyda'i phrif gyfrifoldebau, ac mae’n cynnwys cofnod o'r sgiliau, yr wybodaeth a'r profiad sy’n ofynnol ar gyfer ei chyflawni i lefel foddhaol. Nid rhoi cofnod cyflawn a manwl o bob agwedd ar y dyletswyddau sy’n rhan o'r swydd yw’r bwriad.
Mae ein swyddi prentisiaeth hefyd yn amodol arnoch yn cael y cymwysterau rydyn ni o'r farn eu bod yn angenrheidiol ar gyfer eich swydd a gofynion darparwr hyfforddiant eich cynllun.  Mae’r cynnig yn amodol ar eich bod yn mynd drwy broses sganio sgiliau gyda darparwr hyfforddiant enwebedig y BBC i bennu eich cymhwysedd.

Cyn eich dyddiad dechrau, mae’n bosibl y bydd angen i chi ddatgelu unrhyw gyhuddiadau gan yr heddlu neu euogfarnau sydd heb ddod i ben, yn unol â’n polisi Recriwtio. Fel prentisiaid, byddwch hefyd yn cael y canlynol:

Rydyn ni eisiau denu’r amrywiaeth ehangaf o bobl dalentog i ymuno â ni. Po fwyaf amrywiol yw ein gweithlu, y mwyaf y bydd modd i ni ymateb i’n cynulleidfaoedd a’u hadlewyrchu yn eu holl amrywiaeth.
Rydyn ni’n croesawu ceisiadau gan unigolion, beth bynnag fo’u hoedran, rhywedd, ethnigrwydd, anabledd, cyfeiriadedd rhywiol, hunaniaeth rhywedd, cefndir economaidd-gymdeithasol, crefydd a/neu gred.

job_title: Summer Internship – Corporate & Investment Banking (Industry Coverage)
job_description:
Excited to grow your career?
BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.
The Corporate & Investment Banking – Industry Coverage area acts as the strategic partner and primary point of contact for large corporations and institutions regarding their most critical financial decisions. Specialized in key sectors of the global economy—such as TMT, Energy, Industrials, Consumer & Retail, and Infrastructure—the team combines deep market analysis and sector trends to identify high-impact business opportunities, originate corporate transactions, and coordinate tailor-made solutions in close collaboration with product teams (M&A, Capital Markets, and Structured Finance).
About the job:
Summer Internship 2027
• Location: London, UK.
• Period: June – August 2027 (2 months, full-time)
• Division: Corporate & Investment Banking – Industry Coverage
• Scope: International (Spain, UK, France, Germany, and Italy)
• Application Deadline: 08/11/2026 at 23:59PM
• Candidates must have a valid right to work in the UK. Proof of eligibility will be required during the recruitment process.
Experience an immersive summer in Investment Banking
Are you passionate about the financial world and want to discover from the inside how large corporations are advised on their most strategic decisions? Do you have analytical curiosity, market vision, and a desire to learn from leading professionals in the sector?
We invite you to join our Summer Internship in Investment Banking Coverage, part of the Global Junior Talent Program at SIX. Over two months, you will immerse yourself in a formative experience designed to accelerate your development in corporate and investment banking, gaining a comprehensive view of the business, financial modeling, and strategic analysis.
You will be part of an international community of students coordinated from London, participate in multidisciplinary dynamics across different countries, and have the constant guidance of a mentor from day one to support your learning curve.
How will you collaborate and what will you learn?
During your internship, you will integrate into the team and actively collaborate in the day-to-day operations of the five strategic sectors of Coverage: TMT · Industrials · Energy · Consumer & Retail · Construction & Infrastructure
Your role will focus on supporting the team and learning through practice in:
📊 Strategic Analysis & Market Research
• Collaborate in the preparation of market research, sector analyses, and peer comparisons to extract valuable insights.
• Assist in tracking industry trends and gathering data on companies across various geographies.
• Provide support in identifying and conducting preliminary mapping of business opportunities and potential clients.
📈 Financial Modeling & Analysis
• Learn and assist in preparing basic financial models (DCF, trading comparables, multiples, and precedent transactions).
• Help collect and structure quantitative data to support the team's proposals and recommendations.
📑 Client & Committee Materials
• Assist analysts and bankers in drafting corporate presentations, pitch books, and market notes.
• Support the gathering and synthesis of internal information for decision-making committees and management teams.
• Collaborate in document tracking of client relationships and preparing briefs ahead of meetings.
🤝 Support in Transaction Execution
• Collaborate in preparing support materials for ongoing transactions (M&A, DCM, structured finance) alongside product teams.
• Assist in gathering and organizing necessary materials for processing internal approvals and risk committees.
• Accompany the team in the operational tracking of project timelines.
Formative experiences designed for you
• International Network & Perspective You will connect with a European cohort of students in Spain, the UK, France, Germany, and Italy. You will participate in joint training sessions coordinated centrally, understanding how corporate banking operates on a pan-European scale and building your professional network from university.
• Job Shadowing You will experience direct observation days (job shadowing) alongside bankers and analysts from the team. You will be able to attend meetings as an observer, understand how strategic priorities are debated in real-time, and get firsthand knowledge of the daily dynamics of CIB.
• Personalized Mentoring Program You will have an assigned mentor who will guide your learning process, orient you about the industry, and resolve your technical and career-related questions.
The profile we are looking for
• Penultimate year students pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, related Dual Degrees, or Engineering with a strong analytical profile.
• Fluent in English, as you will work in an international and local environment.
• Genuine motivation for investment banking, corporate finance, and market dynamics.
• Rigor, logical reasoning, and attention to detail in data management.
• Intellectual curiosity, personal initiative, and the ability to integrate and collaborate within a team.
• Candidates must have a valid right to work in the UK. Proof of eligibility will be required during the recruitment process.
What will this opportunity bring you?
• Top-tier practical training: Acquisition of real analytical and financial tools applied to the corporate market.
• International exposure: Direct collaboration with cross-border teams and shared sessions with European headquarters.
• Continuous technical training: Access to learning platforms and specialized training resources.
• Continuous guidance: Ongoing tracking and regular formative feedback to maximize your evolution during the two months.
Selection Process Stages
• Initial Application • Profile and availability questionnaire
• Online assessment tests
• Interview with the Talent & Culture team
• Technical and motivational fit interview with the SIX team
Skills:

The role & why it matters 
We are looking for someone to take ownership of Transaction Monitoring at BCB and shape its next stage. You will run the function day to day, leading a globally dispersed team of over 10 analysts and senior analysts, set the standard for what good looks like, and deliver it: refine rules so they focus on real risk, extend coverage as our products grow, automate manual, low-judgement work, and build a team that investigates well and escalates with confidence. You report to the Head of Financial Crime Operations and you will have real authority over how transaction monitoring works across fiat and crypto, as the first line of defence for the Group.
This is a role for someone who sees a process that could work better and improves it without waiting to be asked.
BCB moves fiat and digital assets 24/7 for some of the largest crypto businesses in the world, through our Client Console, API and BLINC instant settlement network. Monitoring has to keep pace with that volume and speed. We have solid foundations, and we want a leader who will build on them to create a function that is data-led, well documented, measurable and increasingly automated, and that keeps alert and case volumes under control as the business grows.
What you will own
• The transaction monitoring framework for fiat and crypto across the Group, including rules, scenarios, thresholds, typologies and the documented rationale behind each.
• Confirm every product, entity and payment flow feeds the monitoring system completely and accurately, including new products before launch.
• Alert handling end to end: triage, investigation, escalation, case management and closure, with clear SLAs and quality standards, covering transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions and PEP screening hits on customers and counterparties.
• Backlog and capacity: keep alert and case queues within tolerance, plan rotas and capacity against volume growth, and step in quickly when backlogs build.
• Oversight of any outsourced or third-party review capacity, including SLA performance, quality and escalation standards.
• Decisions to escalate internal suspicious activity reports (ISARs) to the MLRO, and the quality of those reports: well reasoned, evidenced and on time, and support to the MLRO in preparing external SARs/STRs, including to the NCA, TRACFIN and FINTRAC. 
• Rule calibration tuning and effectiveness testing, using data to cut false positives and find the activity current rules miss. Document rationale behind each, with changes approved through BCB’s governance process in partnership with Compliance (2LOD) and the MLRO.
• Automation of manual, low-judgement, work, whether through vendor tooling, workflow automation, scripting or AI-assisted review.
• Blockchain analytics as part of monitoring, not a separate step.
• A quality assurance and quality control framework for the team, with sampling, feedback loops and results reported to governance.
• Management information for senior leadership and governance forums: volumes, backlog, ageing, conversion rates, quality results, emerging risk.
• Procedures (SOPs) for the function, kept current and usable by the people doing the work.
• Leadership of the TM team of over 10 people, working through senior analysts: team structure, hiring, coaching, and performance, and building senior analysts who can make day-to-day decisions without you. Building a robust operating model that increasingly relies upon efficiency, automated workflows and AI over increased headcount.
• Working relationships with Compliance, Onboarding, Fraud, Product, Engineering and Data, and with regulators and auditors when they review the function. Represent transaction monitoring at governance forums and deputise for the Head of Financial Crime Operations on monitoring matters. 
What success looks like
First 30 days. Review the current rules, alert volumes, backlog, team structure and procedures. Meet the team and key stakeholders. Present a written assessment of what works, what does not and what you will change first, with a sequenced plan and a view on capacity and resourcing .
First 90 days. Any backlog is cleared or on a committed recovery plan. Alerts are consistently worked within SLA. Rules have been reviewed and tuned, with documented rationale for each change and governance approval for each change. At least two manual processes are automated. MI is produced to a regular cadence for senior leadership to review. Every team member has clear objectives and a development plan.
First 3-6 months. Monitoring coverage maps to BCB's risk assessment and product set, including new products before launch. False positive rates are measurably lower with no loss of detection, and investigations are faster. QC and QA results consistently meet targets. The function would pass an internal audit or regulatory review without material findings, and the team runs well without you in every decision, senior analysts own day-to-day case decisions and you have a credible deputy in your absence.
What you bring
• Five or more years in transaction monitoring or financial crime investigations, with at least two in a lead or management role.
• Experience in payments, e-money, banking or crypto. Experience across both fiat and crypto is a strong advantage.
• A track record of improving a monitoring function: you can describe a rule set you rebuilt, a backlog you cleared or a process you automated, and the numbers before and after.
• Experience of workforce and capacity planning, QA/QC frameworks and managing operational SLAs, including oversight of outsourced review capacity. 
• Hands-on knowledge of rule design, threshold calibration and effectiveness testing.
• Sound judgement on suspicion and SAR decisions, and the ability to teach that judgement to others.
• Working knowledge of UK AML requirements, including the MLRs and JMLSG guidance, and of sanctions regimes (UK, EU, OFAC, UN) and PEP screening. Some exposure to EU requirements. Experience of France’s ACPR or AMF and reporting to TRACFIN, reporting to FINTRAC in Canada and an understanding of the FIU reporting regimes in UAE and Switzerland is an advantage.
• Comfort with data. You can query it, interpret it and make decisions from it. SQL or Python is a plus.
• Experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, Elliptic or TRM.
• A clear view on where automation and AI help in monitoring, and where they need human oversight.
• Clear and precise written English. Your case notes, SOPs and MI are easy to follow and hard to misread.
How you work
You are direct and decisive. You make a call, explain it and own the outcome. You question rules and processes that exist only because they always have. You prefer fixing root causes over adding headcount. Can produce MI such as cost per alert and capacity forecasting against volume growth. You build trust with the team by being in the detail with them, and with senior stakeholders by telling them plainly what the risk is. You develop your senior analysts so decisions do not all route through you.

BCB Group provides regulated payment and trading services in crypto and fiat for the digital asset economy. Our clients include crypto exchanges, liquidity providers, market makers, investment firms, custodians, payment processors and wallet providers. We offer more than 40 fiat and cryptocurrencies, trading liquidity, 24/7 instant payments through BLINC, and crypto services, all through our Client Console and API. We are regulated in the UK, France, hold VQF status in Switzerland and registered with FINTRAC in Canada, and compliance sits at the centre of how we operate.
Our mission is to create the trusted platform to pay, store, trade and earn fiat and digital assets, globally, 24/7.

The Customer Success Executive is responsible for the operational client relationship: mobilising new and materially changing accounts once a deal is signed, and providing day-to-day relationship management and first-line support once the account reaches steady state. Education and qualifications
• Relevant training in customer success, account management or project coordination is an advantage.
• Educated to A-level standard or equivalent, or able to demonstrate equivalent experience gained in a client-facing or administrative environment.
Experience
• Experience in client onboarding, implementation, account management or client/customer success, ideally within a membership, assessment or subscription-based organisation.
• Experience coordinating multiple projects or client commitments concurrently to tight timescales.
• Experience with assessment, accreditation or qualification-based products or platforms (desirable).
• Experience contributing to process improvement or automation initiatives (desirable).
• Experience supporting renewal or account expansion processes (desirable).
Competencies and skills
• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple onboarding projects and ongoing service commitments concurrently to tight timescales.
• Confident, professional communicator, comfortable liaising with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels, and able to manage client relationships and expectations.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical, service or process detail clearly to non-technical client stakeholders.
• Confident facilitating onboarding calls, kick-off meetings, training sessions, and client review calls and meetings, comfortable presenting service data and reports.
• Composure and diplomacy when managing client concerns, delays, complaints or escalations, whether during mobilisation or steady state.
• Working knowledge of CRM/service systems (e.g. Salesforce) and reporting tools, and the ability to learn new platforms quickly.
• High attention to detail and strong administrative accuracy, particularly around contract, entitlement, renewal and reporting configuration
• Ability to triage and prioritise effectively across multiple concurrent client accounts.

Privately-owned companies play a vital role in the UK's economic growth, both locally and nationally. We're already the trusted data provider to central government, universities and local authorities, and public sector demand for high-quality private company intelligence is growing fast. We're looking for a Lead Account Manager to own our most strategic public sector relationships and set how we retain and grow them.
About Beauhurst
We're building the leading provider of private company data and analysis in Europe.
Private companies represent 80% of private sector employment and over 90% of revenues across Europe. They are the engine of innovation and the source of most of the jobs and tax receipts in the economy. Yet for anyone trying to find, track or understand them, the data is a mess: outdated, inconsistent, scattered across thousands of sources, and impossible to verify by hand at any meaningful scale.
We've spent 15 years fixing this. We use custom-built data extraction tools and pipelines, proprietary AI, and a team of 60+ in-house analysts to identify, extract, and verify data from thousands of sources, covering 20 million companies, 24 million people, 232,000 transactions, and 1,000+ new news articles a day. Our platform, API, and consultancy services are trusted by our clients to enable them to make better decisions, drive impact, set policy, reduce risk, and save time.
Founded in 2010, we now cover every company in the UK, Germany and Ireland, and work with over 500 organisations across venture capital, major financial institutions, corporates, leading universities, and the Government. And we're not stopping here: we're continuing to scale across Europe.
The Role
This is a senior role that combines strategy and execution. You'll own our largest and most complex public sector accounts: government departments, combined authorities, Catapults and leading universities, with contracts worth £100k+ a year.
These accounts work differently from the rest of our book. Contracts often run over several years and involve dozens of stakeholders. Budgets are set on the financial year, value for money has to be proven internally, and contracts usually go back out to procurement when they end. You'll build relationships well ahead of renewal, help clients show the impact Beauhurst has had, and know when a renewal needs a business case, a direct award or a tender response.
Your job is to win those renewals, grow each account across departments and use cases, and turn what you learn into a playbook the rest of the team can use. You'll work closely with our Lead AE for Public Sector and senior leadership on pricing, product direction and how we approach re-procurement.
Your day-to-day will include:
• Owning our most strategic accounts: retaining and growing a book of our highest-value public sector clients, and negotiating multi-year agreements
• Proving impact: helping clients evidence the value of Beauhurst to their senior leadership and procurement
• Leading re-procurement: planning renewals a year or more ahead, and leading tender and framework responses (for example G-Cloud) when contracts come back to market
• Building senior relationships: engaging directors, heads of service and policy leads to understand their priorities, build realistic account plans around them, and help them make the case for Beauhurst internally
• Expanding our footprint: finding new departments, programmes and use cases to grow into, including positioning our API, MCP and consultancy services
• Contributing to strategy: working with senior leadership on pricing, territory prioritisation and what public sector clients need from the product next
• Working with Client Experience: partnering with our Client Experience team to ensure every user is trained, active, and getting value
• Mentorship: taking on Lead responsibilities will include owning team development projects. You'll be in charge of setting objectives with leadership, tracking progress, and holding the team accountable for delivering against retention and growth targets.
About you
As a minimum, you'll have:
• 4+ years account managing large public sector organisations, ideally central government and universities, in a SaaS, data or consultancy-led business
• A consistent track record of renewing and growing accounts worth £100k+ a year
• Proven experience leading re-procurements, tenders or framework renewals to protect existing revenue
• Experience mentoring or coaching other account managers, formally or informally
• Clear evidence of being a self-starter: you've built or improved an account management approach rather than just followed one
The traits that matter most:
• Strategic and entrepreneurial: you see the bigger picture, build the plan and execute against it. You choose the pain of hard work now over the pain of failure later.
• Deep public sector knowledge: you understand how government bodies operate across the local-to-central spectrum and you're credible with their senior leaders
• A natural relationship-builder: you take time to truly understand client strategy, build trust across large, complex organisations and know who really makes the decision
• Coachable and resilient: you actively seek out feedback, bounce back fast from setbacks and help others do the same

About the Role:
The Global CDD Manager leads CDD and EDD standards across all FIAT and banking partner relationships globally. The role ensures the company meets AML/CFT, sanctions and licensing obligations for retail and corporate customers, and for the financial institutions, payment providers and FIAT rails through which those customers transact. Beyond customer due diligence, the role owns the end-to-end risk management of the FIAT partner lifecycle: how partners are assessed before onboarding, how their risk is rated and re-reviewed on an ongoing basis, how information requests and escalations are handled between us and the partner, and how partner-driven events are contained without disrupting customer service or the wider payment network. The hire will work with local MLROs and compliance teams to align global standards with local requirements, maintains oversight of CDD controls, and acts as the primary point of contact for banking partners, auditors, regulators and internal stakeholders on compliance matters.
What You’ll Do:
Banking and fiat partner relationship management. 
• Serve as the firm's compliance point of contact and escalation channel for banking and fiat partners across all jurisdictions, covering on-ramp and off-ramp, payment rails and settlement arrangements. 
• Lead partner onboarding, periodic reviews, incident management and exit decisions, review contractual compliance obligations (CDD, data sharing, transaction monitoring, travel rule and audit rights), and maintain a current inventory of channels and relationships with concentration exposure by partner, corridor and currency.
Fiat partner lifecycle risk framework.
• Design and own a unified global framework for assessing fiat partner risk across the full lifecycle: onboarding due diligence, launch, ongoing monitoring and exit or migration. 
• Standardise the onboarding due diligence methodology, define the risk drivers with a named accountable owner for each, calibrate the tiered risk rating matrix — including post-launch operational and settlement performance — and set review frequency by risk tier with defined triggers for ad hoc review.
Regulatory and stakeholder alignment. 
• Ensure the framework satisfies material outsourcing requirements under the ADGM rulebook and equivalent local regimes, and align review cadence and escalation channels with Finance, Risk, Security and the Third Party Due Diligence function so that a single periodic review meets all stakeholder requirements. 
Partner RFI and cooperation framework. 
• Design and own the framework governing how banking and fiat partners raise requests for information and how the firm responds, in partnership with Customer Service, Bank Relations and Compliance. 
• Establish onboarding service levels and communication protocols, define reason-code standards with a process to return incomplete or incorrectly coded requests, agree expected RFI ratios with partners in advance, negotiate reciprocal cooperation terms, and maintain continuity arrangements so response capability does not depend on individual availability.
Global CDD and EDD standards, assurance and remediation. 
• Ensure global CDD and KYB standards are met across all entities, products and jurisdictions, aligned with local requirements through the MLRO community.  Oversee the design and operation of customer risk rating and enhanced due diligence frameworks, including fiat-specific factors such as payment corridors, cross-border flows and counterparty banks, and provide guidance and challenge to the first line of defence. 
• Manage relationships with external auditors and assurance providers, support regulatory and partner inspections, and own the global remediation tracker as the single source of truth for status, ownership, due dates and evidence, driving items to validated closure.
Product, automation and reporting. 
• Partner with Product and Technology leadership to design and deliver global and local CDD, EDD and partner-risk enhancements with automation and scalability built in from design. 
• Manage multiple cross-jurisdiction projects and vendor or platform solutions for partner monitoring and RFI handling, and report progress, risk position and remediation status to senior management and governance forums with clear KPIs, risk appetite thresholds and escalation triggers.
What We’re Looking For:
• 7+ years of CDD, KYC/KYB or financial crime compliance experience, including at least 3 years in FIAT, payments or banking.
• Hands-on experience managing third-party relationships with banks, payment providers or other regulated partners, including onboarding due diligence, periodic review and exit.
• Experience designing or operating a partner/counterparty risk framework, including risk rating matrices, risk drivers and periodic review cycles.
• Experience tracking and remediating audit, regulatory or programme findings across multiple teams and jurisdictions.
• Experience with external audits and regulatory examinations, including managing findings to closure.
• Deep knowledge of global AML/CFT, sanctions and CDD requirements, and of customer risk scoring frameworks.
• Knowledge of licensing requirements for financial services and crypto-related business across relevant jurisdictions, including outsourcing and third-party requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to align multiple stakeholder groups (Compliance, Finance, Risk, Security, Operations) on a single governance cadence.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, and ability to make difficult decisions independently.
• ACAMS, ACFCS or equivalent industry certification.
Nice to Haves:
• Experience with correspondent banking, nested or sponsor-bank arrangements, or payment rails (for example SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, local rails such as PIX).
• Experience with FIAT on- and off-ramp flows, card or payment processing, or P2P and B-Pay style channels.
• Experience with RFI handling, reason-code standards or information-sharing frameworks with banks and law enforcement.
• Experience building risk or monitoring processes on an AI-first, automated basis, including data pipelines and exception scoring.
• Knowledge of ADGM (or equivalent) material outsourcing and third-party risk requirements.
• Experience across multiple regions, with working knowledge of local banking and AML regimes.
• Familiarity with travel rule, sanctions screening of payment flows, and transaction monitoring for FIAT activity.

Ready to take ownership of finance in a growing international organisation?
BioPhorum is looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our expanding organisation and play a key role in supporting our international operations.
Following our continued growth and the acquisition of PharmaX Solutions, we're looking for a commercially minded, hands-on finance professional who can bring strong accounting expertise, operational finance experience and a good understanding of the German market.
This is much more than a reporting role. You'll work closely with project, delivery and commercial teams, taking ownership of financial processes, strengthening financial control and helping the business make better-informed decisions.
You'll have the opportunity to influence how finance operates across our international group, improve processes and support the continued development of a growing and evolving organisation.
What you'll be doing
You'll take responsibility for a portfolio of project accounts and provide financial oversight across our international businesses. This will include:
• Partnering with project, delivery and commercial teams to improve project margins, strengthen cost control and drive financial performance.
• Managing project accounting and revenue recognition, ensuring accounting policies are consistently and accurately applied.
• Monitoring WIP and POA, including monthly reconciliations, reporting and variance analysis.
• Preparing and overseeing monthly management accounts, balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules for international entities.
• Challenging forecasts, reviewing project costs and identifying financial risks and opportunities.
• Providing practical financial guidance to operational teams and supporting the application of project accounting best practice.
• Driving continuous improvement across financial reporting, planning, cost models and systems.
• Coordinating year-end activities with outsourced accountants across multiple countries.
• Supporting monthly payroll reviews and reconciliations.
• Supporting the financial integration of acquisitions and helping develop scalable processes as the group continues to grow.
What we're looking for
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical accounting knowledge with the practical experience to take ownership of day-to-day finance operations.
You'll be confident working independently, comfortable getting into the detail and able to build effective relationships with colleagues across the business.
The following are essential:
• An internationally recognised accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA, or equivalent.
• At least five years' post-qualification experience.
• Strong accounting expertise, including management accounts, financial reporting, balance sheet reconciliations and revenue recognition.
• Hands-on operational finance experience, with the ability to manage day-to-day financial activities and take ownership of accounting processes.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the German market, including familiarity with the local financial and business environment.
• Fluent written and spoken German and English.
• Strong project accounting, revenue recognition and management accounting experience.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• Experience working with an ERP system. NetSuite experience would be particularly advantageous.
• Experience working within an international or multi-entity environment.
• Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with and challenge senior stakeholders.
• Spanish language skills would be an additional advantage.
The person we'd love to meet
You're proactive, commercially curious and enjoy being close to the business. You won't be someone who simply produces reports and waits to be asked questions; you'll want to understand what's happening, identify opportunities for improvement and help teams make better financial decisions.
You'll be comfortable balancing the detail of accounting with the wider commercial picture, managing competing priorities and working with colleagues across different countries and functions.
Most importantly, you'll enjoy taking ownership, finding solutions and making a tangible contribution to the way finance supports the business.
Why BioPhorum?
BioPhorum brings together more than 150 life sciences organisations, including 18 of the world's 20 largest global biopharmaceutical companies, creating an environment where the industry can collaborate, share expertise and accelerate progress.
Our business is evolving rapidly. Alongside our established membership organisation, we've expanded into training and implementation services, creating an increasingly international group.
The acquisition of PharmaX Solutions has further strengthened our implementation capability, bringing specialist expertise in digital transformation, manufacturing execution systems, automation and quality systems across GxP-regulated environments.
Joining us at this stage of our growth offers the opportunity to help shape our financial operations, influence how we work and contribute to the development of an expanding international organisation.
Location and travel
The role is based in Düsseldorf, Germany, with an expectation of working from the Düsseldorf office 2–3 days per week.
Occasional international travel will be required, typically 3–4 trips per year within Europe and the UK.
Interested?
If you're an experienced finance professional with strong accounting knowledge, hands-on operational experience and a good understanding of the German market, we'd love to hear from you.
This is an opportunity to take ownership, work closely with the business and help shape finance within a growing international organisation.

Job Summary
Sector: Energy
Location: Glasgow, Scotland (Hybrid working, 2 days per week from home)
Contract: Permanent, Full-time
Reports to: Engineering & Development Services Lead EMEA
About Black & Veatch
Black & Veatch is a global engineering, procurement, consulting and construction company, building critical human infrastructure in energy, water, telecommunications and government services. Our energy teams deliver projects that power communities and support the transition to net zero, with safety at the heart of everything we design and build.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced CDM expert to lead all UK & Ireland CDM related work from our Glasgow or London office. In this role you will ensure Black & Veatch, our clients and our supply chain meet their duties under the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 across the full project lifecycle – from early design and feasibility through construction, commissioning and handover – on projects including substations, overhead lines, grid connections, battery storage, solar, wind and thermal generation.
You’ll have the opportunity to actively grow our CDM advisory capability through both hiring and the development and mentorship of engineers.
What We Offer in return
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Full support and funding for professional development, including APS or IOSH chartership.
• Flexible and hybrid working from our Glasgow office where projects allow.
• Pension scheme, private medical cover and life assurance.
• Professional membership fees paid.
• The chance to work on major energy projects shaping the UK's future.
Key Responsibilities
• Provide leadership and subject matter expertise to our clients and internal stakeholders
• Develop and continuously improve our CDM procedures
• Lead, develop and grow a small team of professionals
• Advise project teams, clients and designers on their duties under CDM 2015, including Principal Designer and Principal Contractor roles.
• Carry out the Principal Designer role, coordinating health and safety during the pre-construction phase.
• Lead and facilitate design risk management, including design risk reviews, HAZID workshops and designer risk assessments.
• Ensure designers eliminate, reduce or control foreseeable risks in construction, maintenance, operation and decommissioning.
• Prepare, review and manage Pre-Construction Information (PCI) packs.
• Review Construction Phase Plans for suitability before work starts.
• Develop, compile and hand over the Health and Safety File.
• Assess duty holder competence and resourcing, including during supply chain selection.
• Carry out site visits, inspections and audits to check compliance and drive improvement.
• Prepare F10 notifications and ensure they are submitted to the HSE where required.
• Deliver CDM briefings, toolbox talks and training to engineering and project staff.
• Support incident investigations and share lessons learned across projects.
• Keep up to date with legislation, HSE guidance and best practice
• Build strong relationships with clients, contractors, designers and internal stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
• Working towards Certified Membership of the Association for Project Safety (CMaPS) – strongly preferred.
• Alternatively, working towards Chartered Membership of IOSH (CMIOSH).
• Some experience of supervising direct reports
• NEBOSH Diploma or a degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience on high-voltage electrical, substation or renewable energy projects.
• Experience of the Principal Designer role on complex, multi-discipline projects.
• Knowledge of related regulations such as the Electricity at Work Regulations, COMAH or DSEAR.
Minimum Qualifications
• Significant depth of experience within CDM compliance, construction health and safety, and design risk management.
• Thorough working knowledge of CDM 2015 and related UK health and safety legislation.
• NEBOSH Construction Certificate or NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent).
• Ability to read and challenge design documents.
• Strong communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams.
• Ability to supervise, develop and mentor staff
• Excellent report writing and organisational skills.
• Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel to project sites across Scotland and the UK.
Certifications
• Thorough working knowledge of CDM 2015 and related UK health and safety legislation.
• NEBOSH Construction Certificate or NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent).

job_description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Description
The goal of our team is to develop novel AI-powered audio processing algorithms. The twist is that our algorithms must run in real time, on physical devices for applications such as context understanding, dynamic awareness, augmented hearing and ones we haven’t yet imagined. You will work with experts in ML, DSP, software engineering, and psychoacoustics to prototype and implement new algorithms.
You will develop audio understanding algorithms that enable devices to recognize what is happening in the world around them. Areas of interest include sound event detection and localization (SELD), acoustic scene understanding, unusual or anomalous sound detection, and multimodal context understanding from audio, video, and motion sensors.
Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting-edge audio technology. We are looking for people passionate about machine learning and audio to help shape what comes next.
Responsibilities
· Research, prototype, train, and evaluate novel audio understanding models, from early experiments through real-time deployment on devices.
· Develop robust methods for sound event detection/localization, acoustic anomaly detection, and context-aware audio interpretation.
· Explore multimodal approaches that combine microphone signals with video, IMU, or other sensor data when useful.
· Build and curate datasets and data piplines, evaluation protocols, and demonstrations that measure accuracy, robustness, latency, and compute cost.
· Work with DSP and software engineers to integrate models into proof-of-concept systems and product platforms; communicate results and contribute to patents or conference papers.
Education
Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in machine learning, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.
Skills
· Strong hands-on experience with modern audio understanding models, including sound event detection, SELD, acoustic scene analysis, or anomaly detection.
· Comfortable tackling complex, open-ended problems where you have to experiment with and discard many ideas before finding the right solution.
· Experience developing and evaluating deep learning models in PyTorch; strong Python skills.
· Understanding of audio representations, DSP, and evaluation metrics for detection, localization, and generalization.
· Experience with multimodal fusion (video, IMU, or other sensors) for context understanding is a plus.
· Experience with efficient inference, causal ML, ONNX/TFLite, embedded ML, or C/C++ is a plus.
· Strong communication skills; publications at conferences such as ICASSP, Interspeech, NeurIPS, or similar are welcome but not required.

KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
TEAM OVERVIEW
The Global Client Solutions Group (“KCS”) is KKR’s dedicated investor solutions team. KCS was first formed in 2009 to invest in and focus on KKR’s relationships with current and potential investors. Today, KCS consists of over 200 executives located in 13 offices across four continents. The KCS platform is primarily organized around two focus areas: Sales/Relationship Management and Product/Strategy Management. KCS seeks to “connect the dots” across all businesses at KKR, from our Real Estate investing teams to Private Equity, Infrastructure, Credit and Capital Markets, to deliver all of KKR’s intellectual capital and solutions to our investing partners. The group’s long-term objective is to further diversify KKR’s client base, across all regions and institution types, and to raise capital for the firm’s expanding product platform through developing, structuring and maintaining collaborative partnerships with our investors.
POSITION SUMMARY
KKR's Global Client Solutions team is seeking an Analyst to join its Real Assets Product Specialist team in London, to support capital formation and product management and development across KKR’s Real Assets platform, with a focus on International Real Estate and Asia Infrastructure. The role offers broad exposure to KKR’s International Real Estate and Asia Infrastructure strategies, with responsibilities spanning fundraising and product development, ongoing fund management, investor reporting, marketing and investor engagement through client servicing and event planning. The successful candidate will support both existing funds and new fundraising initiatives, gaining experience across the full investment lifecycle.
Working closely with investment professionals, asset management, finance, operations and global relationship management teams, the Analyst will play an integral role in coordinating investor deliverables, preparing financial and marketing materials, and supporting broader product initiatives.
A key focus will be driving efficiencies across reporting and data management processes, while providing analytical and execution support to the wider team. The position offers an opportunity to develop a strong understanding of International Real Estate and Asia Infrastructure investment strategies, fund performance and the broader capital formation process.

job_description:
At Clarion, our people are at the absolute heart of what we do.  We’re proud that our core values of PASSION, CARE, IMAGINATION, and TRUST define the way we carry out our work across all of our teams.
If you share our values and want to be a part of a successful, dynamic, and creative global business then we want to hear from you.  
The Opportunity:  
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a German speaker to join the VIP Engagement team supporting the delivery of DSEI Germany 2027, Germany’s major new defence and security event.
We are recruiting a VIP Engagement Assistant to support the delivery of DSEI Germany’s inaugural VIP engagement programme. Working as part of a dedicated team, successful candidates will engage with exhibitors to help them succeed in meeting senior government and military VIPs, ensuring exhibiting clients receive a high-quality and productive event experience at DSEI Germany.
This role sits within our Programming function and will play a key role in coordinating exhibitors’ VIP engagement activity, managing stakeholder communications, and facilitating valuable introductions.
The position offers a unique opportunity to develop experience within the international events industry and defence sector whilst working with senior decision-makers from across government, military, and industry communities.
Key Responsibilities:  
• Support the operational delivery of VIP engagement activity for DSEI Germany 2027.
• Pro-active communication with exhibitor and internal stakeholders, building and maintaining strong working relationships.
• Supporting exhibitor onboarding onto the delegation management system, including personalised outreach to exhibitor contacts.
• Respond to stakeholder enquiries in a professional, timely, and client-focused manner.
• Maintain accurate records within the delegate management system.
• Monitor programme progress and provide updates to the wider team.
• Represent Clarion and the DSEI Germany brand professionally at all times.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, processes and customer experience as part of project continuous development.
• Operate confidently during busy pre-event and onsite periods, managing competing priorities while maintaining high standards of accuracy and service.
• Escalate issues appropriately and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.
• Ensure all stakeholder and customer data is handled in accordance with relevant data protection requirements.
The Candidate
The successful candidate will be highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working within a fast-paced environment. You will possess excellent interpersonal skills and enjoy building relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
You will be confident communicating with senior individuals, capable of managing multiple priorities, and committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
Experience within events, customer service, stakeholder engagement, coordination, hospitality, or administration would be advantageous, although candidates from other professional backgrounds with transferable skills are encouraged to apply.
Knowledge, Skills & Behaviours
Essential
• Excellent organisational and planning skills
• Exceptional attention to detail
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Professional and confident stakeholder engagement skills
• Ability to build rapport and establish trusted working relationships
• Strong customer service mindset
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously with prioritisation
• Calm, composed, and reliable under pressure, able to adapt to changing circumstances
• Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to work
• Ability to work independently whilst contributing positively to a team environment
• Resilient, adaptable, and solution-focused
• A positive, enthusiastic and professional attitude
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and database management systems
• Being able to communicate professionally in both German and English
Desirable
• Previous experience in event delivery, exhibitions, hospitality, customer engagement or stakeholder management
• Experience working with senior-level stakeholders
• Knowledge of the defence and security sector
• Understanding of military or government organisational structures
About Clarion Events   
Clarion Events is one of the world’s leading event organisers, producing and delivering innovative and market-leading events since 1947. (https://clarionevents.com/welcome)   
  
Clarion Events embrace diversity and equal opportunities in all that we do. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.  
  
Clarion is private equity backed and owned by Blackstone. Blackstone is one of the world’s leading global investment funds, investing capital for the long term in order to build successful, resilient businesses. (https://www.blackstone.com/)    
  
Our purpose is to deliver exceptional customer outcomes and experiences, by making every connection count.   
  
Our vision is we want every one of our products to be a market leader in customer satisfaction and delight. 
Benefits
• 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
• End of year wellbeing shutdown (closed for the last week of the year)
• Employees on a permanent or fixed-term contract are gifted an extra day of leave that can be used for a celebration of your choosing, e.g. birthday, Eid, Diwali, etc.
• Summer Hours in August (3pm finish on Fridays)
• Helping Our World (HOW) Days – one paid day per quarter to carry out charity work
• Pension Scheme
• Private Medical Insurance
• Health Cash Plan
• Wellbeing Library (MYNDUP)
• Mentoring Programme
• Season Ticket Loan
• Cycle to Work Schemes
• Free on-site gym and shower facilities
• Free eyesight tests
• Free flu vaccination – offered on site once a year for all employees
Our Values
PASSION
We deliver all our events with passion for people, the environment and businesses. We form connections with those who are just as passionate about what they do as we are. We always strive to exceed expectations and celebrate success. We love what we do, and it shows.
CARE
We care about our people and our products and work tirelessly to achieve lasting connections and satisfaction for ourselves, our customers and the businesses they support. We really get people - everyone is welcome.
IMAGINATION
Everything is possible. We constantly challenge the status quo and create amazing experiences and opportunities. We take huge satisfaction in solving problems. As open-minded and fun-loving people, the sky is our limit.
TRUST
We trust our skills, people and partners to deliver extraordinary events our customers have come to rely on. We support everyone around us and always learn through our experiences. We are honest and straight forward. You can always rely on us.
Equal Opportunities
We encourage employees to be open and confident and recognise that every member of the team makes a vital contribution.
Clarion embraces equality, diversity and inclusion and seeks to promote these principles in all of our business activities.
When recruiting new employees or providing opportunities for promotion, we will:
• Recruit, develop and retain the most talented people, regardless of background, and make the best use of their talents;
• Ensure that no person is unlawfully discriminated against;
• Select the best person for the role based on their skills, qualifications and abilities.
This statement sets out our commitment to equal opportunities and to preventing discrimination in the workplace.

ClarusONE Sourcing Services, LLP, is a joint venture created in 2016 by McKesson Corporation and Walmart Stores Inc to provide strategic sourcing services in generic medicines for both companies (“Members”).
We’re headquartered in London, and pride ourselves on our can-do attitude that ensures we deliver our mission to enable access to affordable medicines for US patients.
Walmart and McKesson, two of the top 10 biggest corporations in the USA (Fortune 500) have more than two decades of history working together to improve the quality and lower the cost of pharmaceutical care to patients by leveraging McKesson’s strength and expertise in global pharmaceutical sourcing and Walmart’s strength and commitment to delivering leading health and wellness services to their customers.
The environment in which ClarusONE operates requires the organisation to constantly adapt, seeking greater efficiency in how we work through improved processes, data and insight led decision-making, technology innovation and new ways of working.
About the Role: Reporting to the Senior FP&A Manager, you will be responsible for the dynamic planning of and providing actionable insight through reporting of our financial performance. You will be responsible for partnering ClarusONE member focused teams and relevant teams and stakeholders in our member organisations.
You will exhibit creativity and commercial acumen when valuing and prioritising potential innovations. As your work will support change and initiatives, you will be comfortable finding the data and designing the reports to measure their success. You will have an integral role delivering our strategy, working closely with our sourcing specialists to ensure that value opportunities are maximised and we meet our goals. You are a leader in the business and will be a role model to the team, demonstrating ClarusONE values and supporting others where needed.

• Regular forecasting of in year performance vs. targets, previous versions, and over time.
• Ownership of ClarusONE planning timetables in line with member requirements, communicating with clarity the requirements of all stakeholders and maintaining deadlines.
• Generating stakeholder fed, insight driven plans which enable effective in year actionable management reporting.
• Monthly, quarterly and annual insight driven and actionable reporting of ClarusONE’s value performance for the member.
• Identification and management of business and performance risks & opportunities including managing action and stakeholder involvement required to close.
• Ongoing development and improvement of forecasting, budgeting and reporting processes to maintain best practice and use of advancing technologies
Value Generation
• Scenario modelling of commercial scenarios with multiple impacting factors identifying various scenarios of value contribution supporting commercial and member team proposals.
• Development of value insight & analysis across all areas of member value & spend, understanding and monitoring value triggers, levers and detractors, and market insights.
• Identification & delivery of commercial & strategic value opportunities for our members (with clarity on member and market economics).
Strategic Business Partnering
• Business partnering ClarusONE member focused teams and member financial and operational teams.
• Investigation and resolution of value-based queries from across ClarusONE and member teams.
• Maintaining insight and alignment to ClarusONE strategic goals and initiatives. Supporting with analysis and modelling where necessary.

• Qualified accountant (e.g. CIMA, ACCA, ACA) or equivalent qualification/experience.
• 4+ years commercial experience including business planning and analysis and business partnering.
• Ability to communicate complex financial issues to non-financial stakeholders and influence decision making
• Experience of analysing complex business information and communicating it to management.
• Highly motivated self-starter: ability to initiate and manage work autonomously with minimal supervision.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and experience.
• Time management, including ability to organise and prioritise work to consistently meet critical and/or conflicting daily deadlines while ensuring the highest level of accuracy. • Demonstrate commercial awareness and acumen.
• Comfortable in the detail whilst being able to stand back and appreciate the bigger picture.
• Ability to develop working relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
• Advanced Excel & PowerPoint skills required

• Prior experience with sourcing or procurement related finance functions an advantage

- Consultative, outcomes-oriented judgment that balances technical depth with commercial urgency.

Job Description
Role Purpose
The Data Protection Analyst role is intended to support Collinson Insurance’s Privacy Compliance programme across the end-to-end insurance lifecycle including distribution, underwriting, policy administration, claims handling, medical assistance, fraud prevention and customer service. The objective is to ensure a compliant, secure and transparent use of personal data.
Key Responsibilities
Advice & Triage: provide first line practical guidance on day-to-day privacy queries across commercial, operations, medical assistance and customer support teams. Escalate complex, high risk or strategic matters with a clear summary and recommendation.
Data subject rights & complaints: support the handling of data subject requests and data protection complaints
DPIAs: support DPIAs for change initiatives by assisting with advice, wording, identification and documentation of risks, mitigations and track actions through to completion.
AI and Automated Decision Making: support privacy assessments for AI enabled tools and automated decision making, including data mapping, DPIA input, transparency requirements, human oversight measures and escalation of potential high risk use cases.
RoPA & Data Mapping: maintain RoPA entries and data maps for core insurance processes documenting data flows and supporting periodic governance reviews.
Incident and breach management: Manage personal data incident logging, triage and assist with risk assessment and documentation, and track remediation.
Retention & Deletion: support the implementation and monitoring of data retention requirements, including retention schedules, deletion actions, exceptions, and evidence of compliance.
Supplier & Contract Assurance: support third party privacy due diligence and the review of data processing clauses, maintaining trackers and evidence for processor compliance. Escalate higher risk arrangements, international transfers and non-standard contractual positions.
Training & Awareness: support role-based privacy training and development of guidance materials tailored to operational claims and customer service scenarios.
Reporting & Governance Support: maintain Privacy Dashboards and support audit and regulator readiness by ensuring decisions and evidence are properly documented.
Privacy Notice & Transparency: support reviews of privacy notices, customer communications and operational documentation to ensure processing is explained clearly and accurately.
You’re the right person if
You’re good with building relationships across with internal and external stakeholders.
You communicate in a clear, straightforward way. You can explain privacy requirements in plain English, tailor your message to the audience, and write things down so they are easy to follow and stand up to scrutiny.
You can tell what is routine and what feels higher risk, and when something needs to be escalated you can summarise the issue and your recommendation clearly.
You can juggle several priorities at once, stay on top of deadlines and keep stakeholders updated.
You are calm and constructive when things get busy. You can handle pushback, ask the right questions, and land a practical outcome without becoming a blocker.
You pay attention to detail, and you keep good records. You are comfortable maintaining trackers and logs, and you follow actions through to completion.
You handle sensitive information with care. You understand the importance of confidentiality, especially when dealing with claims information and special category data.
You look for ways to improve how things are done. You notice and you suggest practical changes that make the process smoother and reduce risk.
You enjoy working in a diverse and multi-national environment.
You work well as part of a team, sharing updates early, supporting colleagues when priorities shift, and contributing to a positive, collaborative way of working.
Essential Experience
Demonstrates relevant experience in data protection, privacy, compliance, audit, risk, governance, legal operations or a paralegal role. Equivalent experience in a regulated operational environment with substantial data protection exposure will also be considered.
Experience supporting data subject rights requests, data protection complaints, DPIAs, maintenance of records of processing activities, privacy notice updates and reviews.
Working knowledge of the UK and EU data protection regulatory framework, including the practical application of lawful basis, transparency, data subject rights, personal data breach management, data protection impact assessments and international data transfers.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and confidence maintaining trackers, dashboards and supporting evidence.
Desirable Experience
Experience in insurance, claims, medical assistance, financial services or another regulated environment with complex customer journeys and third-party arrangements.
Experience supporting data protection complaints, data retention, privacy training, supplier due diligence or processor assurance, contract reviews and assessments.
Familiarity with multi-entity and cross-border processing environments, including data sharing within a group and with external parties.
Awareness of privacy considerations arising from AI-enabled processing and automated decision making.
A law degree or legal background, particularly where this has involved interpreting data protection requirements, applying exemptions and producing clear, defensible documentation.

Why we need this role
The Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, automates, tests and operates secure Linux-based infrastructure supporting critical telecommunications network services. Working from agreed architectural and engineering standards, the role deploys and maintains platforms supporting DNS, routing, identity, authentication, monitoring, observability and network-management capabilities.
The Engineer is responsible for reliable implementation, infrastructure automation, lifecycle maintenance, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous improvement. The role works across Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations and progressively develops ownership of defined platforms and services.
The role supports a distributed estate of hundreds of Linux systems across critical network, security, operational and business services.
Platforms and Services
The team designs, deploys, automates and maintains Linux infrastructure supporting:
• Authoritative, recursive and caching DNS services.
• Route reflectors and other routing control-plane services.
• Authentication, authorisation and accounting services.
• Identity management, directory and privileged-access integrations.
• Network observability, telemetry, logging and monitoring platforms.
• Network-management and automation services.
• Virtualised and, where appropriate, containerised infrastructure.
• Supporting services such as NTP, PKI, certificate management, secure repositories and configuration services.
What you will do
Platform Engineering and Delivery
• Build, configure, test and maintain Linux platforms using distributions such as RHEL and Ubuntu.

Network-Critical Services

Automation and Efficiency

Operations, Reliability and Lifecycle

Job Description
Duration: 4 years
Salary: £27,400
Locations: Leeds
Qualifications: A BSc (Hons) Degree Apprenticeship in Digital User Experience (UX) from Manchester Metropolitan University
Design the difference. Build your expertise
When it comes to shaping how one of the UK’s largest organisations works, traditional HR can only take us so far. We need data that leaves no room for guesswork. Technology that keeps people and processes connected. And strategy that’s born out of insight. Exactly what our People & Places teams do every single day.
The People Experience & Platform team takes that further – bringing data, design and technology all under one roof to deliver an experience that touches 80,000 colleagues. And as a UX Designer Apprentice, you’ll be right where this magic happens. You’ll get to decide how work works…

A Freelance Motion Designer / Video Editor is needed to join [REDACTED], a modern flat fee recruitment partner helping startups and growing businesses hire properly without expensive agency fees or clunky DIY hiring tech.
Based remotely, this is a project based engagement to produce a premium 60 second explainer video for our own brand. We already have the script, storyboard direction and brand assets in place. What we need is someone who can translate that into a sharp, modern, SaaS quality visual story.
[REDACTED] combines real recruiters, automation and clean hiring tech. We work with founders and scaling teams who want clarity, pace and quality in their hiring process. Our brand reflects that. It is minimal, confident and considered. This video needs to feel the same.
This is not a cartoon explainer.
It is not a template driven slideshow.
And it is not a whiteboard style animation.
We are looking for a clean, modern SaaS aesthetic. Strong typography. Controlled motion. Abstract UI elements rather than literal screenshots. Smart pacing. Subtle detail. Premium execution throughout.
The finished output will sit at the front of our brand and marketing, so design judgement matters as much as animation skill.
Deliverables include a 60 second explainer video, British English voiceover, music with subtle sound design, 1080p export, subtitles with SRT file and fully editable source files.
To qualify: You should be a Motion Designer, Motion Graphics Designer, Video Editor or similar with a portfolio that demonstrates
• Clear experience producing modern SaaS or startup explainer content
• Strong typography and layout capability
• Confidence animating abstract UI and clean motion systems
• A restrained, premium visual style
• The ability to manage a defined project and deliver to deadline
We are not looking for whiteboard videos, clip art animation, heavy cartoon styles or generic template explainers.
In return, you'll work directly with our founders on a clearly defined brief with strong creative direction, flexible remote working and genuine potential for ongoing collaboration across future brand and product campaigns.
To apply, please send relevant portfolio examples, one or two projects closest to this style, your fixed price quote and estimated turnaround time.
