About [REDACTED]
Help shape the future of specialty insurance
At [REDACTED], we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.
We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.
You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.
We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor [REDACTED], new investor [REDACTED], as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that [REDACTED] remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.
Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.
About the role
Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins.
On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions.
On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers.
Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most.
The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.”
Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution.
This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at [REDACTED], hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly.
Responsibilities
You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means:
• Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch.
• Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join.
• Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed.
• Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into:
• the user behaviour driving the request
• two or three platform-valid approaches
• a recommendation, with trade-offs explained
• Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts.
• Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem.
• Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure.
• Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread.
• Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations.
About you
You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery.
You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where:
• the design system already exists
• the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders
• solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints
You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary.
You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow.
Insurance or [REDACTED] experience is a plus, but is not a requirement. We care more about how you think about complex platforms and stakeholders than about prior domain knowledge, which you can learn here.
We especially want to hear from you if you have
• Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.
• Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.
• Strong problem-solving skills.
• Experience in a distributed work environment.
Benefits
• Private medical insurance
• Income protection insurance
• Life insurance of 4 * base salary
• On-site gym and shower facilities
• Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
• Team social events and company parties
• Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees
• Access to [REDACTED], the financial wellbeing platform
• Company stock options managed through [REDACTED]
• Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy
• Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays
• Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook
• Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams
• [REDACTED] employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines
• For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with [REDACTED]
• The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!
We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.
Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.
As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

Job Description

Product Analyst, AgentSource, Travel Experience & Commerce (Remote)
Full time, United States, United Kingdom, Canada
The Product Analyst evaluates and improves the user experience across digital products by researching user behaviors, needs, and pain points. Through data analysis and usability testing, they generate insights and collaborate with design, development, and product teams to deliver actionable recommendations that enhance usability, accessibility, and overall customer satisfaction.
What You'll Do
• Conduct user research, usability studies, and data analysis to identify trends and opportunities for improvement
• Analyze user interaction data and feedback to inform design decisions
• Collaborate with UX designers to review concepts and provide input for mock-ups, wireframes, user flows, and prototypes
• Ensure compliance with accessibility standards and best practices
• Provide actionable insights to stakeholders to improve product functionality and user engagement
• Monitor and report on UX metrics and KPIs to measure success and impact
• Gather requirements and write clear, actionable user stories
• Facilitate and participate in activities with internal business partners to gather business needs and requirements
• Assume and perform other duties and responsibilities, not specifically outlined herein, as is proper and inherent to the position
What You'll Bring
• Prior experience as a Product Analyst supporting User Experience (UX) initiatives
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Skilled in UX research, usability testing, and data visualization
• Familiar with design tools (Figma, Sketch) and analytics platforms
• Knowledge of accessibility standards and UX best practices
• Strong presentation skills for sharing findings with stakeholders
• You are an excellent communicator and team collaborator
• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English
• Experience with advanced User Experience research techniques (e.g., eye-tracking, A/B testing) is a plus
Why you’ll love working here
Join a global industry leader where curiosity drives innovation, growth is continuous, and every voice matters. At [REDACTED], you'll have the freedom to make an impact, the support to develop your potential, and the opportunity to help shape the future of travel.
Meet [REDACTED]
[REDACTED] creates connections that move people and ideas forward. Through open technology and trusted human expertise, we help companies and people navigate change, simplify complexity and make confident decisions about how and when they travel. Our intuitive digital experiences for every stakeholder power journeys that fuel success and drive progress. With 15,000+ dedicated team members serving clients in 170+ countries, [REDACTED] is shaping a more sustainable future for business travel. Industry-leading meetings and events management and a global consultancy complete our suite of solutions and services. In 2025, [REDACTED] achieved $24.4 billion in sales. Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with [REDACTED]. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
How you'll help us achieve it
We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers!
In this role, you’ll:
• Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature.
• Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project ([REDACTED] uses Figma).
• Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.
• Contribute to [REDACTED]’s design system and component library.
• Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.
• Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs.
• Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution ([REDACTED] uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks).
Key details
This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.
You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team ([REDACTED] covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you’ll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You’re highly encouraged to visit market counties more often! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year.
Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package.
Major benefits:
• Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
• 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
• Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays
• $10,000 annual charitable donation matching
Requirements
• Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps
• Fluency in English. French language skills are a plus.
• At least 6 years of end-to-end in-house experience, with a consumer focus on product design with mobile apps.
• Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with an eye at removing friction from flows
• Attention to detail and high level of visual craft
• Strong illustration and animation skills. We use After Effects and Lottie at [REDACTED] but anything that can be converted to a Lottie file works
• Ability to deliver high-quality designs with speed and polish
• Bias towards action. Identify UX improvements without waiting for the perfect conditions
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to think through complex interaction design as well as thinking about tradeoffs of each solution
• Curiosity for understanding and unpacking customer behaviors and needs
• Experience balancing business goals, customer needs, and technical tradeoffs, while explaining your point of view to the team
You might be a good fit if you
• Are detail-oriented and able to balance multiple projects
• Can iterate separate concepts quickly to user test design bets. The ability to move fast and update designs based on customer feedback is an important quality we’re looking for
• Think carefully about in-the-weeds details and their role within the design system
• Feel comfortable anticipating and designing for edge cases
• Enjoy pairing with designers, engineers, and product managers
• Are excited to learn about how all our products work together
• Can speak, read, and write in French. This is nice to have but not a strong requirement - we have large markets in West Africa where French will come in handy.
Our team
• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include [REDACTED], [REDACTED], [REDACTED], [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED].
• We are on [REDACTED]'s top companies by revenue.
How to apply
Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in [REDACTED] and the role.
We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Job Description
Programme Eligibility
To join one of our 12-month Internships you must meet one of the following criteria:
• You’re currently an undergraduate studying at university and returning to full-time education in Autumn 2028 and returning to full time education in Autumn 2028
• You’re looking to gain work experience after completing your A-Levels, an equivalent course or an Apprenticeship
Additionally, you must also:
• Be eligible to work in the UK without restriction for the duration of the internship from Monday 5th July 2027 – Friday 21st July 2028
• Be able to work in [REDACTED]'s Central London office on-site four days per week
We recommend applying to just one internship role, this helps ensure your application is considered for the opportunity that best matches your interests and skills. Choosing one allows us to focus on what excites you most and where you’ll shine brightest.
What will I be doing?

Are you an experienced SENCo ready to take the next step in your leadership career? Coundon Primary School is looking for an exceptional, knowledgeable and nurturing Inclusion Lead to join our team for a one-year maternity cover.
This is much more than a SENCo role.
We are looking for an experienced and highly effective practitioner who can take strategic responsibility for Inclusion across the whole school, championing the needs of our most vulnerable pupils and ensuring that every child is able to access, participate in and thrive within our school community.
We want someone who combines warmth and nurture with organisation, professional challenge and high expectations. You will understand that excellent inclusion is not about lowering expectations or creating dependency; it is about removing barriers, strengthening classroom practice and ensuring that the right provision enables every pupil to succeed. The opportunity
Working closely with the Headteacher and Senior Leadership Team, you will lead our whole-school approach to SEND and Inclusion, ensuring that provision is ambitious, responsive and firmly rooted in high-quality teaching.
You will have the opportunity to:
- provide strategic leadership for SEND and Inclusion across the school;
- lead and develop our Inclusion team, ensuring that expertise and resources are deployed effectively;
- work alongside teachers to strengthen adaptive teaching and inclusive classroom practice;
- oversee high-quality SEND identification, assessment, provision, intervention and review;
- lead statutory SEND processes, including EHCP provision, reviews and liaison with external professionals;
- use data, pupil progress information, provision monitoring and pupil voice to evaluate impact;
- work sensitively and constructively with parents and carers, including when situations are complex;
- build effective relationships with external agencies and professionals;
- contribute fully to whole-school leadership, improvement planning and evaluation;
- keep abreast of national SEND reform and evolving expectations for mainstream schools, translating these into effective practice at Coundon; and ensure that Inclusion is everyone’s responsibility and remains central to our culture, curriculum and decision-making. ### Who are we looking for?
We are particularly interested in hearing from an experienced SENCo who is ready to broaden their leadership experience and take the next step towards a more senior leadership role.
You will be someone who:
knows SEND – with strong knowledge of the SEND Code of Practice, statutory responsibilities, EHCP processes and effective provision;
understands excellent teaching – and can support and challenge colleagues to ensure adaptive teaching begins in the classroom;
is exceptionally organised – able to manage competing priorities, statutory deadlines, documentation and complex caseloads with confidence;
can lead people – building the capacity of teachers, teaching assistants and the wider Inclusion team rather than simply managing provision;
is nurturing and child-centred – developing trusting relationships with pupils and families while maintaining ambitious expectations;
can think strategically – identifying patterns, evaluating impact and contributing to wider school improvement;
understands the changing SEND landscape – and is able to respond confidently to emerging national reforms and expectations; and
makes things happen – bringing energy, accountability and a determination to secure meaningful improvements for children. Why Coundon?
Coundon is a large, vibrant primary school where Respect, Kindness, Responsibility and Resilience underpin everything we do.
Inclusion is a significant and valued area of our work. You will join a supportive leadership team that understands the complexity of SEND and is committed to investing in high-quality inclusive practice.
We are not looking for somebody simply to maintain existing systems for a year.
We are looking for somebody who will lead.
Someone who will bring experience, ideas and professional expertise; who will ask the right questions; who will support and challenge us; and who will leave our Inclusion provision even stronger than they found it.
In return, this role offers an experienced SENCo an exciting opportunity to demonstrate whole-school strategic leadership, work closely with senior leaders and make a tangible difference to children and families. If you are passionate about Inclusion, ambitious for children with SEND and ready to make the next step in your leadership journey, we would love to hear from you.
Come and lead Inclusion at Coundon – and help us ensure that every child has the opportunity to belong, achieve and thrive.

Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.
DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.
The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.
Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

Purpose of Job
Part of a wider Design and Transformation team in CTO, the Associate – Design & Transformation (D&T) works with business stakeholders to design and implement change with a focus on requirements elicitation and business case formulation (using a range of Agile techniques). 
The Associate – D&T will work in a range of settings including smaller scale Project Management or Business Analysis on varied-sized enhancements/projects. The team member will work closely with business teams, IT teams like architecture and application teams as well as specialist consultants, as applicable. Where required, they will work in proximity with the Bank’s technology Capability teams to ensure services are technically enabled. _The successful candidate will start as the dedicated Business Analyst on Phase 2 of the Payment Ecosystem project. This is a priority MYIP initiative, delivered with Operations & Service Management (OSM) and the Treasury, Risk & Operations IT capability._
_Phase 2 builds on the MVP, which covered loans and bonds. It extends the central Payment Repository and straight-through processing to Equities, Guarantees, Treasury and PPAD. It also introduces a central Payment Service to route payment flows across channels, and improves integrations with SWIFT and integrity screening. Controls and reporting will be strengthened as well._
_In this role you will own business analysis across the delivery lifecycle. You will work closely with the Product Owner, business subject matter experts and the engineering team. You will turn business needs into clear, development-ready requirements, maintain a well-refined backlog and help ensure work meets the agreed Definition of Ready before it is built. You will also support target process design, testing and business readiness. Over time, the role is expected to move from project delivery into wider support for the capability area._
Background
The D&T team collaborates with the business to design effective and efficient operating models and advise on their planning and execution enablement, handing off to appropriate teams for the actual execution of the change. Through strong relationships and consultative approach, the team shapes and defines transformational projects aligning functional designs to the strategic objectives and vision of the Bank.
The Associate - D&T will be assigned to 1-2 change projects or initiatives in either a project manager/BA capacity, or as a BA required to work with the project team. In doing so, they will need to interact with specialist consultants and a broad group of Bank staff professionals. The role requires good internal/external stakeholder management at varied levels and must build credible working relationships.
Accountabilities & Responsibilities The role will be responsible for engaging with business stakeholders as part of a project or as part of the demand management process (early assessment of IT initiatives).
Core D&T responsibilities:
- Work as assigned on 1-2 projects, either as PM/BA on a small project, or as BA working closely with product owners, SME, business stakeholders and other IT disciplines to transpose valued needs into requirements captured by appropriate methods and artefacts.
- Carry out investigation, capture and prioritisation of business requirements using a variety of Agile techniques.
- Capture new technology request outlines from the Business and help to formulate the supporting business cases for funding.

EXL's FRAC practice helps clients across sectors strengthen governance, meet regulatory obligations and put controls into everyday operation. We offer AI governance, AI risk management and AI audit across traditional machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI, built around a Govern, Map, Measure, Manage approach at enterprise, portfolio, use-case and runtime level. You will work across all three areas, lead client engagements with limited supervision from scoping to final report, and move between advisory work and independent assurance as client needs require.
As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:
• Deliver AI governance engagements: maturity assessments, AI risk appetite, taxonomy and policy, operating models (roles across the three lines, forums, decision rights, escalation), integration with enterprise risk, model risk, data, cyber and privacy, and ISO/IEC 42001 readiness.
• Run AI estate discovery (including shadow AI), use-case classification and risk tiering, regulatory mapping and a portfolio view, ending in a prioritised roadmap.
• Assess AI risk at use-case level, inherent and residual, covering customer and conduct harm, data and privacy, model and output, security and operational risk, across machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI.
• Design proportionate controls and guardrails, human oversight and approval workflows, and give a clear recommendation (go, conditional go, redesign or stop).
• Set up monitoring for live AI, with key risk indicators, incident handling and reassessment on material change, and support clients running it day to day.
• Plan and carry out independent AI audits, either a governance audit across the organisation and its AI portfolio or a deep audit of selected use cases, including support to internal audit teams.
• Test controls over models, data and technology, including model performance and validation, data quality, lineage and privacy; coordinate specialist testing such as red teaming, where needed.
• Track AI regulation and standards (FCA and PRA expectations, EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, UK GDPR) and turn them into practical client requirements.

• Experience assessing data governance, data quality, lineage and privacy controls, with working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, UK GDPR and UK regulatory expectations for AI.
• Experience scoping AI audits and assessments, designing and testing controls, and writing audit-quality findings and reports.

• Degree in a relevant subject, and the right to work in the UK.

• Exposure to third-party AI risk; experience in a regulated sector; insurance strongly preferred.
• Data literacy (for example Python, SQL or Power BI) and familiarity with leading GRC and AI governance tools.

Agentic AI architecture and engineering
• Lead the end-to-end technical design of enterprise generative AI and agentic AI solutions using Microsoft technologies.

• Mentor AI engineers, software engineers and architects, helping develop the wider Microsoft AI & Data capability.

Job Description
The main purpose of the role is to support the Finance Director, Deputy Finance Director and the wider Finance, Procurement and Operations (FP&O) team by providing high-quality administrative, operational and coordination support. The post holder will act as a central point of organisation across finance and operations activity, helping to prioritise work, track actions, and support effective communication across the directorate.
The role requires good judgement, discretion and a reliable, organised approach to managing competing priorities. It operates with regular interaction with senior leaders and supports effective decision-making by ensuring information, actions and processes are well organised, followed through and delivered to agreed timescales.
The post holder will be responsible for:
• Support the Deputy/Finance Director by preparing briefings, coordinating information and following up agreed actions.
• Providing diary management support to the Deputy/Finance Director, including prioritisation of meetings and preparation ahead of key engagements.
• Coordinating meetings and agendas with internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring appropriate preparation, accurate information and timely follow-up.
• Act as a coordination point for FP&O activity, maintaining action logs, delivery trackers and forward plans.
• Provide light-touch support to priority pieces of work, including tracking actions, milestones and dependencies.
• Maintaining FP&O intranet and SharePoint pages, ensuring information is accurate, current and easy to access.
• Providing administrative and logistical support for FP&O training events and team activities.
• Coordinate onboarding and people-related processes within FP&O, ensuring a well-organised and positive experience for new starters.
• Act as an effective interface between FP&O and other stakeholders, supporting clear communication and practical issue resolution.
• Support continuous improvement activity across the directorate, contributing to clearer processes and more effective ways of working.
• Supporting finance processing tasks as required, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
• Support procurement activity as required, including maintaining records and supporting compliance with governance processes.
Skills & Knowledge
• High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities calmly and effectively.
• Ability to prioritise work, maintain momentum and ensure actions are followed through.
• Ability to work with reports and information to support team activity.
• Experience supporting onboarding and people-related processes.
• Understanding of procurement and contract management processes, or willingness to develop this knowledge.
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
• Experience using SharePoint and maintaining digital information repositories.
• Experience providing administrative and operational support to senior leaders (Desirable).
• Communicates clearly, professionally and confidently with colleagues and stakeholders in person, via MS Teams, by telephone and email.
• Builds positive and effective working relationships across FP&O and the wider organisation.
• Liaises appropriately and professionally with external stakeholders and suppliers.
• Works independently with appropriate supervision, using initiative to progress work.
• Uses judgement to prioritise tasks and identify when issues need to be escalated.
• Maintains awareness of FP&O priorities and supports senior leaders by providing clear, well-organised information.
• A reliable self-starter who organises their workload effectively to support team priorities.
• Takes responsibility for completing tasks and ensuring actions are followed up.
• Supports collaborative and inclusive ways of working across the team.
• Supports effective use of senior leaders’ time through dependable coordination and administrative support.
• Contributes to effective delivery across FP&O by ensuring actions and information are well managed.
• Supports the effective functioning of FP&O through a professional, organised and responsive approach.

Central Data owns Finom's central data model, the certified metrics and the rails through which the company and its AI agents use data. As our Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll keep developing that model and build the tooling that connects it to the AI tools used across the company, so people and agents can get more out of the data. You'll work directly with business functions on their processes. You'll also use LLMs where they do the job better than code, such as classification, extraction and translation, evaluated like any other pipeline step.
This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll work with stakeholders on how their processes run, suggest improvements and connect data work to business cost and value. You'll report to the Head of Central Data.
What You Will Be Doing
- Design and evolve entities, metrics and data products in the central model, with tests, lineage and documentation, so that their consumers can reuse and extend them
- Build and maintain pipelines, onboard new data sources on your own, keep CI/CD and data quality checks running, and take part in migrations
- Interview stakeholders, understand how their processes work and scope what they need. Connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value
- Take part in recurring reporting, including regulatory and audit cycles, reconciliations and data requests from business functions
- Build LLM steps into reporting and metric pipelines, such as translation, classification, basic aggregation and preparing unstructured data. Evaluating output quality is part of delivery
- Expose the semantic layer to internal tools and agents through MCP and APIs, working with engineering on shared standards
- Prepare data for agentic tools, company-wide AI harnesses and external recipients from the same certified definitions, so it is reproducible and traceable back to the model
How We Work
You'll have high autonomy. You choose the tools and the approach, including trialling new vendors and open-source solutions. Sign-off is needed in two cases. Priorities are set by final business impact.
Who You Are
- You write expert SQL and have strong dimensional or semantic data modelling skills
- You write working Python, with tests and version control
- You've built metrics and semantic layers
- You have ETL and data warehouse or lakehouse experience, including onboarding sources end to end
- You've used LLMs hands-on in production data work, for example classification, extraction, translation, or agents that other people use
- You work like a consultant to the business: you understand how a process works, propose solutions and frame them in terms of business value
Nice to Have
- Databricks and Unity Catalog
- Hands-on experience with, or a solid understanding of, MCP, tool calling, tracing and evals for LLM applications and agents
- Workflow automation tools such as n8n
- CI/CD, orchestration and infrastructure-as-code
- Background in fintech or banking (transaction monitoring, treasury, reconciliation, regulatory data) or another business with a high-volume operational flow
How You'll Grow
In your first months you get to know the model, the stack and your stakeholders. By six months you're self-sufficient and make judgement calls on scope and design without escalating. From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
 
About the Role
Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
Fivetran's SAP connectors move enterprise data out of SAP and into modern data platforms. We're looking for an all-round SAP specialist who combines strong ABAP skills with deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing. You'll work on the interfaces and data extraction mechanisms that let Fivetran reliably pull data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems, and you'll help customers and internal teams get the most out of them.
You will be the SAP specialist within a team of Java developers. Your knowledge and input is crucial to the success of this team. 
 
Technologies You’ll Use
• ABAP programming using traditional SAPGUI as well as Eclipse (or other IDE).
• Databases (HANA/Oracle/etc)
• Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/MS)
• AI tools Claude/Codex/
What You’ll Do
• Design, build, and maintain high-performance ABAP components (function modules, classes, CDS views, and enhancements) to drive scalable outbound data extraction from SAP systems.
• Own and modernize internal SAP test environments to accelerate feature development for current connectors and upcoming public cloud / BTP integrations.
• Architect robust outbound interfaces leveraging OData, standard and generic DataSources, ODP/ODQ delta frameworks, and RFC connections.
• Optimize data throughput and reliability across ECC and S/4HANA landscapes by diagnosing and resolving extraction performance bottlenecks and delta synchronization issues.
• Analyze underlying SAP database structures (HANA and traditional DBs) to unlock efficiency gains and streamline data pipeline performance.
• Partner closely with engineering, support, and customers to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical architectures.
• Deliver end-to-end support for enterprise clients by troubleshooting complex connectivity, authorization, and configuration challenges in customer SAP environments.
• Establish technical design standards, interface specifications, and best practice documentation for internal and external knowledge sharing.
• Evaluate and integrate emerging SAP technologies—including SAP Datasphere and BTP—to keep Fivetran’s connectors at the forefront of modern data integration.
Skills We’re Looking For
• 10+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with strong ABAP skills (classic and modern ABAP, ABAP OO, ABAP for HANA)
• Deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing:
• OData (v2 and v4): service design, SEGW, performance, and security
• SAP extractors: standard and generic DataSources, delta handling, ODP/ODQ, CDS-based extraction
• RFC: function modules, BAPIs, destinations, and tRFC/qRFC
• Solid working knowledge of both SAP ECC and S/4HANA, including the differences in data models and extraction options between them
• Good knowledge of databases: SQL, query performance and tuning, SAP HANA, and relational database concepts
• Understanding of SAP data models and key modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD)
• Experience with SAP authorizations and technical user/role setup for interfaces
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
• Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
• Fluent in English
• Experience in code reviews, design, troubleshooting and testing
• Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals
Bonus Skills​
• Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including connecting SAP to cloud data platforms
• Java development experience
• Familiarity with data integration/ELT tools and data warehousing concepts
• Knowledge of SLT, SAP Datasphere, BW and SAP BTP.

Who We Are
Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.
We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.
Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.
Why This Role Exists
We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.
This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.
What You’ll Build
High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale
Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.
Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements
5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.
Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)
Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.
The Kind of Person We’re Looking For
Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:
Missionary, Not Mercenary
You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.
Builder, Not a Bystander
You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.
Craftsperson Under Pressure
Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.
Direct Communicator
You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.
This Is a Long-Term Commitment
Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.
This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.
If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.
What We Offer
Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

Role summary/purpose of job
There are three key towers within the IT organisation: Technology, Data and Product.
The Data Tower is responsible for maximising the value of the firm's data assets, enabling consistent, trusted and strategically governed data products across the firm.

The Business Systems Analyst combines business process analysis, data analysis and stakeholder engagement skills to ensure business needs are translated into clear, actionable and deliverable requirements. The Pricing Operations team ensures accurate pricing across Gamma’s complex network of products, suppliers, customers and channel partners.

• The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
• Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
• Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
• Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
• Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk
Summary The Core Engineering Shared Services AI team operates as an internal forward-deployed AI engineering function, embedding with The Core business teams to identify priority workflows, prototype agentic AI solutions, and productionize cloud-native applications that deliver measurable business impact. This hands-on role combines client-facing problem discovery, rapid engineering execution, production AI architecture, and structured transition to receiving teams that will operate and extend the solutions over time.
As an AI Application Engineer, you will work directly with internal business and engineering partners to convert ambiguous operating problems into secure, reliable AI products. You will define where agents should act, where they should assist, and where human approval or control gates are required, then design and deliver solutions that are adopted in real workflows and can be supported in production.
Key Responsibilities
• Rapid Prototyping & Application Delivery: Lead the design, build, deployment, and operationalization of cloud-native AI applications, using modern software engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing to accelerate reliable delivery.
• Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Partner with business and engineering teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities, translate requirements into cloud-optimized architectures, and define scalable data models and technical specifications.
• Forward-Deployed AI Engineering: Embed with The Core business teams to map workflows, identify pain points, assess agentic automation opportunities, define control and approval boundaries, iterate with users, and drive adoption through pilots, feedback loops, and measurable outcomes.
• Production AI/ML Integration: Build AI applications using LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt and context management, structured outputs, response validation, and evaluation harnesses required for production use.
• Cloud, DevOps & MLOps Execution: Apply cloud-native services, secure deployment patterns, observability, lifecycle management, and MLOps practices to ensure applications are scalable, resilient, cost-aware, and supportable.
• Knowledge Transfer & Enablement: Document solutions, mentor receiving teams, and support clean transition of application code, integration patterns, data models, and operational practices into long-term engineering ownership.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• 9+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting robust production applications.
• Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Go, with demonstrated ability to apply sound software engineering, testing, data modelling, and system design practices.
• Proven experience translating complex business requirements into cloud-optimized application architectures, scalable data models, and technical specifications for production delivery.
• Experience operating in a forward-deployed or internal client-facing engineering model, including workflow discovery, stakeholder engagement, rapid prototyping, solution shaping, pilot execution, adoption measurement, and production handoff to receiving teams.
• Extensive experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including serverless, containerization, managed services, automated deployment, monitoring, and cloud security standards.
• Experience designing cloud-based AI solution architectures that integrate managed AI services, LLM providers, retrieval and vector search, secure data access, API gateways, event-driven workflows, identity and entitlement controls, observability, deployment automation, and cost and resilience trade-offs across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Demonstrated experience integrating LLM or AI/ML capabilities into production applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases or search indexes, prompt templates, context assembly, structured outputs, response validation, evaluation datasets, and model performance monitoring.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, lead cross-functional delivery, and enable receiving teams through documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer.
Preferred Experience • Experience building agentic AI systems that decompose tasks, plan multi-step workflows, call approved tools or APIs, maintain state, enforce permission and policy checks, handle failure paths, and produce auditable action trails.
• Experience implementing agent observability and controls, including trace capture, prompt and tool-call logging, hallucination and policy-violation checks, human-in-the-loop approvals, incident handoff, and post-action summarization.
• Preferred: Experience optimizing production AI systems through model selection and routing, prompt compression, retrieval tuning, caching, batching, streaming responses, asynchronous execution, parallel tool calls, latency budgets, cost controls, and quality regression testing.

The role supports the transformation of product and process data from R&D through CMC into commercial by shaping how that data is modelled, integrated and exposed for use in downstream systems and analytics.
The job holder works with product teams, R&D partners and manufacturing technology teams to define practical strategies for connecting data and systems (including the use of ontologies, knowledge graphs, integrations and AI where appropriate), enabling more seamless reuse of product and process knowledge across platforms. They also help define and operate the technical foundations (data pipelines, integrations, environments and deployments) needed to run these digital and AI-enabled capabilities safely and at scale, and to demonstrate that product and process data is being reused across R&D, CMC and commercial systems with improved data quality and time-to-access.
In this role you will
• Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and integration flows that move digital product profile and related data between PDLM and other systems, using agreed branching strategies and automated checks.
• Ensure pipeline, integration and mapping code is kept under version control, automatically tested and peer-reviewed before release, so changes remain traceable, repeatable and supportable.
• Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
• Own the design of data and integration services within enterprise architecture guardrails, documenting decisions, trade-offs and rationale in decision records and technical documentation.
• Define environment promotion flows (e.g. DEV, TEST, VAL, PROD) for data and integration services supporting R&D, CMC and commercial use of product and process data.
• Support releases and integrations end-to-end: maintain pipelines, automate deployments, manage repositories and environments and ensure changes follow validation and change-control requirements.
• Work with R&D and central ontology / knowledge-graph teams to implement and operate data and metadata structures (for example applying agreed ontologies, reference data and mappings) so digital product profile data can be linked and reused across platforms, without owning the ontology roadmap itself.
• Collaborate with AI and analytics teams to provision data pipelines, integrations, environments and access patterns that enable safe AI proofs of concept and AI-assisted mapping of data models and ontologies.
• Design and support integration patterns between PDLM and key downstream systems (such as MES, LES/LIMS, ERP, control and regulatory/CMC platforms) so product and process data can flow reliably from source to execution and submissions.
• Make practical use of AI-assisted development, agent-based workflows and prompt templates for engineering, testing, documentation and support, validating every AI output for accuracy, security, GxP/data integrity and maintainability before it is committed or released, and applying Responsible AI, data privacy and cyber security controls.
• Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, integrations, environments and related services, including performance and data quality, and drive sustainable remediation for recurring issues.
• Document data flows, integration contracts, deployment patterns and runbooks and keep this documentation aligned with evolving product and system changes, including decision records and standards.
• Coach engineers and analysts working on digital product profile, data and integration work and help turn lessons learned into reusable patterns, templates and knowledge.
• Define and maintain data and integration engineering standards, review engineering practice, and establish reusable models and patterns
• Drive continuous improvement in reliability, observability, performance and security for data and integration services supporting the digital product profile and transformation use cases, using measures such as data reuse, data quality and time-to-access.
Why you?

• Experience designing and delivering data and integration solutions that span R&D, CMC and/or manufacturing domains, including PDLM or similar digital product profile platforms.
• Experience working with ontologies, controlled vocabularies or knowledge-graph technologies to link data across systems, in partnership with central ontology and data standards teams.

• Experience integrating or working with manufacturing, lab or quality systems (e.g. MES, LES/LIMS, ERP, control or regulatory/CMC platforms).
• Experience working with DevOps or platform teams to deploy and operate data and integration services, including pipelines, environments, monitoring and incident response.

• Experience of working effectively as part of a cross-functional team.

* Establish and govern Group-wide resilience standards, methodologies and control requirements aligned to HSBC risk frameworks
* Govern identification, assessment, management and escalation of Third Party Operational Resilience Vulnerabilities across Global Businesses and Functions

Job Title: Head of Customer Success
Salary: Up to £60,000
About IMP
At IMP we help Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) take control of their finances. Our MAT-first software is built by people who know the sector inside out. Former trust professionals, finance experts and product specialists are all part of our team. More than half of all MATs in the UK already use IMP to plan with confidence, simplify complex processes and make smarter decisions.
We’re proud to be independent, founder-led and growing fast. Alongside our award-winning products, we’ve built a culture we’re equally proud of. We are ranked as one of the UK’s Top 25 Great Places to Work for mid-sized companies. Respect, collaboration and personal growth sit at the heart of how we work. You’ll find flexibility, support and opportunities to develop here, alongside regular team socials and funded CPD.
Role Description:
The Head of Customer Success leads the team that makes sure our customers get the value they bought. Once a trust is live on an IMP product, your team is the one thinking about them: whether they are using what they have, whether they are getting results from it, what they will need next, and what might get in the way.
The job in one line: make sure our customers have what they need before they have to ask for it.
As IMP scales, Customer Success becomes its own department with its own Head, separate from Support. This role shapes how it works: what the team does, how it works with Account Management, Support, Implementations and our R&D team, and what good looks like for our customers. You will not inherit a fully formed process. You will take what exists today and build it into one that works as we grow.
You work closely with R&D to know what is coming for each product and what customers will need from it, and you decide what customers should hear, learn and do ahead of a launch, then make it happen. You build the retention plan with the Head of Account Management. This is not a commercial role: renewal and expansion sit with Account Management, and you own the customer health and adoption work behind them.
This is a leadership role. You are accountable for customer outcomes and for the team, and you report to the Chief Customer Officer.
What the role is accountable for:
• Successful customers: every live customer getting the value they bought, with the Customer Success team in front of the ones who need it before they have to ask.
• The health of every live customer: a current read across the whole customer base, so the trusts that need attention are found early and acted on before they tell us.
• Adoption: customers using what they have bought, with depth measured and worked on, not assumed.
• Escalations prevented: problems headed off by a named intervention, not just escalations handled well.
• The go-live handover: the named receiver of each customer handed over from Implementations, with the right to accept it or send it back.
• The retention plan, built jointly with the Head of Account Management: Customer Success owns the health and adoption actions in it; Account Management owns the commercial outcome.
• Customers knowing what is coming: a customer-facing view of each product's direction, kept current with R&D, and a regular rhythm of sessions that keeps live customers engaged and informed.
• Customers staying successful through every product launch: what they need to hear, learn and do, planned and delivered before the launch lands on them.
• A well-led team: clear portfolios, clear priorities, every person managed and developed.
Key responsibilities:
• Have a view of every live customer: what they bought, how they are using it, who at IMP they deal with, and where they are heading.
• Build and run the customer health framework using the data the business already holds: usage, support contact, engagement, renewal timing. Keep the read current across the whole customer base and act on what it shows.
• Set priorities across the Customer Success team's portfolios and move effort to the customers who need it.
• Receive every go-live handover from Implementations: agree the criteria, accept the customer or send the handover back with what is missing.
• Build and run the retention plan with the Head of Account Management, and design how the two teams work together: who contacts which customer, when, and about what.
• Give early warning to Support when a customer pattern shows a product or knowledge problem, and to Account Management when it shows a commercial one.
• Work directly with R&D to understand what is coming for each product, and turn it into something customers can plan around.
• Decide, for each launch and release, what customers need before it reaches them, and get the right people in to deliver it, from Customer Success, Support, Implementations or R&D.
• Run a regular customer-facing rhythm of sessions on product direction and adoption, and own their content and attendance.
• Give Support the customer demand signal ahead of a launch: what customers will ask, when, and in what volume.
• Lead, manage and develop the Customer Success team: portfolios, objectives, one-to-ones, development plans.
• Report monthly to the Chief Customer Officer on customer risk, health, adoption and launches supported, and feed the senior leadership team's view of customer risk.
• Work through tooling rather than by hand: our CRM, our work management tools and AI, so the health picture stays current and the admin stays out of the job.
Skills, experience, and attributes:
• You are customer obsessed. You have either led a customer success team in a B2B software business, or you have been an outstanding customer success lead and are ready and hungry to lead a team. Either way, you can show what changed for customers because you were there.
• You think ahead of the customer. You can show where you spotted what customers would need, built it, and delivered it before they asked.
• You are comfortable in a non-commercial seat: you can work alongside a commercial team, build a shared plan with them, and not need to own the number to care about it.
• You have run customer-facing sessions at scale, such as webinars, user groups or product briefings, and you know what makes people turn up and come back.
• You can hold a picture across a whole customer base, spot the ones drifting before they tell you, and act early.
• You can build a process with a peer, agree the boundaries, and hold both teams to them.
• You have worked closely enough with a product team to translate a roadmap into what it means for a customer, and to carry the customer's voice back without losing it.
• You work through tooling and AI by default; a CRM such as HubSpot is an advantage, and appetite matters more than the track record.
• You can lead a small team: set direction, give honest feedback, develop people.
• Experience in education, MAT finance or a comparably regulated sector is welcome, but not essential.

About Improvado
Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.
What we sell: extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.
Who buys it:
Economic buyers: CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
Technical evaluators: VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
Segments: enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
Verticals: pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies
Why this role, now
Our messaging is not aligned. Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
The category is crowded and moving fast. Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
Analyst firms are a silent blocker. When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.
You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.
What you'll own
Positioning and messaging. Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
Competitive intelligence and win/loss. A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
Sales enablement. The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
Market and analyst relations. The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.
What we're looking for
4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards reps actually opened, a win/loss program that survived past its second quarter.
Writing that survives contact with a skeptical technical buyer — claim and evidence, not adjective stacking.
Comfort operating close to Sales: weekly cadence, deal reviews, live calls, direct feedback.
Nice to have: hands-on SQL, dbt or BI, enough to validate a claim yourself. Experience marketing AI capabilities without hype. Analyst-relations experience. Agency-side or enterprise-brand background. Vertical depth in pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, or gaming.
Not a fit if: your product marketing has been mostly launch logistics and content calendars; you need a fully staffed team and a finished brand system to be effective; you are uncomfortable being told in a deal review that your messaging did not work.
How we measure success Win rate in competitive deals against our top 3 named competitors, baseline set in month 1.
Stage-to-stage conversion on open opportunities, particularly discovery to demo to proposal.
Time-to-first-deal for new reps.
Field adoption of enablement assets — measured, not assumed.
Win/loss program running on cadence, with themes that visibly change product and GTM decisions.
Message consistency: a quarterly audit across web, deck, product UI and content.
