job_title: Senior Research Investigator / Research Leader (Translational Pharmacology), London
job_description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 
 
About Iso
Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
 
Your impact
We are seeking an accomplished and visionary translational biologist to join our Translational Pharmacology team in London, working at the forefront of multidisciplinary, AI-first drug discovery. 
In this role, you will shape and advance our exploratory research portfolio, with an initial core focus on neurodegenerative diseases as well as adjacent high unmet need indications. Operating at the interface of disease biology, translational science, and AI-driven molecular design, you will translate deep mechanistic insights of human disease into robust therapeutic hypotheses, target validation packages, and decision-critical experimental workflows to progress programs from target identification to portfolio entry.
Working shoulder-to-shoulder with world-leading machine learning researchers, computational biologists, and drug designers, you will bridge the gap between dry-lab predictive models and experimental biology—ensuring our AI platforms are grounded in disease-relevant biology and guiding next-generation medicines towards clinical reality.
 
What you will do
Therapeutic Area Strategy & Target Discovery:
• Partner with therapeutic area leadership to define and evolve our neurodegeneration research strategy, identifying priority indications, emerging biological mechanisms, and high-value therapeutic opportunities.
• Integrate insights across human genetics, disease pathology, clinical datasets, and advanced cellular models to critically evaluate target tractability, translational relevance, and competitive differentiation.
• Drive early portfolio progression decisions by establishing rigorous go/no-go target validation criteria.
Translational Biology & Experimental Execution:
• Develop human disease-relevant therapeutic hypotheses that connect target modulation directly to clinically meaningful outcomes.
• Translate therapeutic concepts and target product profiles (TPPs) into biologically rigorous screening cascades for internal and partnered programs.
• Profile novel chemical matter emerging from our in silico generative design pipelines, building comprehensive pre-clinical data packages.
• Embed early translational thinking around target engagement indicators, translational biomarkers, and patient stratification strategies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration with AI/ML Teams:
• Work closely with AI/ML, computational biology, and structural biology teams to design assays and experimental systems that meaningfully benchmark and evaluate AI-designed molecules.
• Provide critical biological domain expertise to ML teams to guide and inform generative models of biological systems and disease pathways.
Scientific Leadership & External Partnerships:
• Serve as the scientific lead for portfolio programs, directing scientific strategy, managing timelines, and ensuring the delivery of decision-quality data.
• Design, oversee, and manage outsourced studies with external Contract Research Organisations (CROs) and academic/co-development collaborators.
• Maintain strong awareness of global scientific advances, competitive clinical landscapes, and emerging translational technologies in neurodegeneration and diseases of aging.
Skills and qualifications
Essential:
• PhD or equivalent industrial/research experience in Neuroscience, Translational Medicine, Pharmacology, Cellular/Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.
• Deep mechanistic understanding of neurodegenerative disease biology, including cellular and molecular drivers of pathology in complex, high-unmet-need indications.
• Expert practical knowledge of translational models (in vitro, ex vivo, and in vivo), patient-derived cellular systems, and the design of robust screening cascades from Target ID through Hit-to-Lead/Lead Optimisation.
• Demonstrated success in advancing therapeutic hypotheses through target validation and profiling novel chemical matter to build decision-quality data packages.
• Proven experience designing, contracting, and managing external research studies with CROs and academic collaborators.
• Experience collaborating closely with bioinformatics, cheminformatics, or computational biology teams, utilising data-driven approaches for target discovery and compound progression.
• Highly collaborative, agile, and driven to thrive in a high-velocity, interdisciplinary team environment.
Nice to have:
• Track record of driving strategic compound de-risking and SAR in close collaboration with medicinal chemistry and DMPK teams.
• Working knowledge of biophysical, biochemical, and cellular screening techniques (e.g., SPR, TR-FRET, mass spectrometry, high-content imaging) and how machine learning models interact with these assay outputs.
• Broad biological experience in diseases of aging or neuroinflammation outside classical neurodegeneration.
• Prior experience in early clinical biomarker discovery or target engagement assay development.
Culture and values
We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it. 
Thoughtful
Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.
Brave
Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.
Determined
Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.
Together
Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.
Creating an extraordinary company
We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.
We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.
Hybrid working
It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.
Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.
ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.
If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.
About you
The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 
Some other things you might be excited about are:
• Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
• ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
• GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
• Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
• ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
• ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
• GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
• Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
• Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
• Fluency in English is required

Kickstarter is the leading crowdfunding platform for creative projects across film, games, music, art, design, and technology. Since our founding in 2009, our mission to help bring creative projects to life has been powered by the people behind the work.
Together, we’ve helped creators around the world launch creative projects that have generated billions of dollars in pledges. That same commitment extends inward. Kickstarter is seeking an experienced Community Manager to join our Marketing team. This role sits at the heart of how Kickstarter shows up and is perceived across the places our community talks: social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the corners of the internet where creators and backers compare notes. Reporting to the Director, Brand and Communications, the Community Manager will listen, respond, and engage, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to route what they hear to the people who can act on it.
As the owner of Kickstarter’s community presence and reputation, they serve as our early-warning system when sentiment shifts or a problem starts to spread. This is not a “schedule posts and check metrics” role. The ideal candidate is already deep in these communities, knows the norms of each one, and gets a little twitchy when a thread starts to turn.
The salary for this role in the United States is $115,905.50.
In This Role, You Will:
Reputation Management and Monitoring
• Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and emerging narratives across social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the broader web, in real time.
• Spot early signals of reputational risk (a viral complaint, a controversial project, a misunderstanding of our policies), assess severity, and lead the response, partnering with Communications, Trust & Safety, Legal, and leadership on sensitive or high-stakes moments.
• Design and own the escalation framework with Communications, Trust & Safety, Support, Product, Legal, and leadership, including severity tiers, owners, and response timelines.
• Build, own, and continuously refine response playbooks for common scenarios (project controversies, creator disputes, outages, policy changes, and press-driven moments), and run post-incident reviews to improve them.
• Define how we measure community sentiment and reputation, and deliver regular reporting to senior stakeholders that connects trends to business and mission impact, with clear recommendations.
Community Engagement
• Show up as Kickstarter in public conversations, in a voice that is human, direct, and well-informed.
• Participate credibly in Reddit and Discord communities, following each community’s rules and culture rather than treating them as broadcast channels.
• Correct misinformation helpfully, de-escalate heated threads, and know when not to respond.
• Support creators and backers by pointing them to the right resources, and handing off to Support when an issue needs a ticket.
• Celebrate creator milestones and engage with backers and make Kickstarter feel present and human beyond our owned social channels.
• Set voice, tone, and engagement guidelines for Kickstarter’s presence in community spaces, and coach teammates who engage on the company’s behalf.
Feedback Loop
• Own a community feedback program that turns unstructured community input into prioritized, evidence-backed insights for Product, Design, Policy, Support, and Creator Success, and track what gets acted on.
• Maintain a living picture of the top recurring pain points, feature requests, and trust issues, with examples.
• Close the loop publicly when we ship something the community asked for.
• Build and run a creator and backer advocacy program, identifying enthusiastic community members for testimonials, campaigns, and storytelling.
Programs and Operations
• Own the strategy and operation of Kickstarter-owned community spaces (e.g., Discord, creator forums), including moderation guidelines, tooling, and volunteer or mod programs.
• Align Social, Comms, and our creator-facing teams on campaigns, launches, and announcements so community context is built in from the start.
• Select, manage, and optimize our social listening and community tooling, including vendor evaluation and measurement.
• Track emerging creator communities, cultural trends, competitor conversations, new platforms and community behaviors.
• Translate community insights into recommendations that inform marketing, acquisition, and product priorities.
About You
• You have 4+ years in community management, social media, reputation management, or a related role, ideally at a platform, marketplace, or consumer tech company.

• You have hands-on experience across the major social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads), including how norms and audiences differ on each.

• You have strong judgment under pressure and ambiguity: you can tell a vocal minority from a real problem and a mistake from a crisis, and you make clear recommendations or calls without waiting to be told what to do.
• You are an excellent writer. You can be warm, plain-spoken, and precise, and you can adapt tone to the platform and the moment.
• You have experience with social listening and community tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater, Mention, or similar).
• You have experience building processes and aligning cross-functional partners, and you communicate clearly and credibly with executives, Legal, and Trust & Safety when stakes are high.
• You have a track record of owning a community, reputation, or voice-of-customer program end to end, with measurable results.
• You are familiar with crowdfunding, creator economy, or maker communities (games, comics, film, music, design, publishing, tech).
• You are familiar with platform-specific communities like BoardGameGeek, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers, or creator-focused Discords.
• You have experience handling public-facing communications during controversies or policy changes.
• You have data skills: you are comfortable building dashboards or pulling insights from large volumes of unstructured text.

job_description:
Kids Planet is an independent, family run group of nurseries providing the highest standard of nursery care across the UK.
Job Title: Commercial Sales Coach
Location: Hybrid / Travel across Nursery Sites
Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer
About the Role
At our nursery group, central marketing drives high volume, high quality parent enquiries - but converting those enquiries requires a sharp, structured, and disciplined sales process. We are seeking a commercial, high performing Sales Coach with a proven track record in consultative B2C or multi-site sales environments to train, mentor, and drive performance across our Nursery Managers.
While our managers are exceptional childcare practitioners, sales and pipeline management are not their core background. Your mission is to embed a high converting sales culture across our sites: sharpening response times, driving tour conversions, closing bookings against tight KPIs, and teaching our teams how to turn enquiries into long-term enrolments. Prior early years experience is preferred but not essential; we need your sales expertise, closing methodology, and coaching capability.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead-to-Booking Sales Discipline: Coach Nursery Managers on rigorous outbound/inbound phone techniques, rapid lead follow-up, objection handling, and securing show-round commitments within strict time-to-contact KPIs.
• Show-Round Closing Techniques: Audit, refine, and coach the show-round process, teaching teams how to uncover parent needs, highlight unique value propositions, and confidently ask for the enrolment booking.
• Pipeline & KPI Management: Work directly with the CMO and marketing team to track lead performance, stage-by-stage conversion rates, and revenue impact, identifying bottleneck sites and running targeted sales intervention plans.
• Structured Sales Training & Mentorship: Design and execute structured sales playbooks, scripts, role-play sessions, and 1-on-1 performance coaching for new and established managers.
• Live Observation & Call Audits: Conduct regular site visits, mystery calls, and live show-round shadows to evaluate pitch quality, enforce sales standards, and provide immediate, actionable feedback.
• Sales Mindset Shift: Help childcare professionals embrace sales as an essential, high-value service to prospective parents, building their commercial confidence without compromising care standards.
About You
• Proven B2C / Multi-Site Sales Success: Extensive background in consultative sales, direct-to-consumer lead conversion, or multi-unit sales coaching (e.g., fitness, hospitality, healthcare, property, retail, or subscription services).
• Mastery of Sales Fundamentals: Deep knowledge of sales funnels, speed-to-lead dynamics, pipeline management, closing strategies, and objection handling.
• Track Record of Driving Conversion Growth: Able to demonstrate how your coaching directly increased sales conversion rates and revenue in previous roles.
• Strong Trainer & Motivator: Exceptional ability to translate commercial sales concepts for non-sales professionals, building confidence and accountability through positive, practical coaching.
• Early Years Experience Preferred But Not Required: We provide the sector knowledge and operational support; you bring the sales execution rigor.
• Willingness to Travel: Comfortable spending time on-site across our nursery locations to conduct live sales shadowing and hands-on coaching.
What We Offer
• Competitive base salary + uncapped performance bonus tied to group conversion KPIs
• Car allowance or travel expense coverage
• Flexible / hybrid working structure
• Generous childcare discount
• Opportunity to shape the commercial strategy of a rapidly growing group

The role
Digitisation and Data Quality Project Assistant Lloyd’s Register Foundation Location: London - UK
Candidates must have valid work authorization for the respective country
This is an office-based role in central London.
Temporary project position – 12-month Fixed Term Contract
Interested in heritage, history and working with data?
We’re looking for enthusiastic people to join our digitisation programme, working with an extraordinary collection of merchant fleet records spanning more than 260 years.
You don’t need previous experience. We’ll support you to develop the skills you need to work with historic collections and build experience in digital heritage. What we’re looking for is curiosity, enthusiasm and excellent attention to detail.
You’ll be joining a friendly, supportive and ambitious team, making this a great opportunity for recent graduates, people considering a career in heritage, or anyone keen to develop their skills in this area.
About the Role:
Working in a team of two the Digitisation and Data Quality Project Assistants, will support a major heritage digitisation project that is processing information from Lloyd’s Register of Ships to obtain accurate, structured and accessible historic vessel data. The role combines careful handling and scanning of archive material with the detailed review of data produced through optical character recognition and automated processing.
You will work within agreed procedures to digitise source material, check digital images, review low-confidence or quality-flagged data, record corrections and escalate genuinely ambiguous cases. The work is methodical and accuracy is more important than speed alone. It requires sustained concentration, confidence working with repetitive tasks and a commitment to maintaining consistent quality across large volumes of material.
The project subject matter expert (SME) will train the role holder across the core activities, and the role holder will report to them on a regular basis.
What we offer you • Fixed term of 12 months
• Working in a global company with the ability to work with different cultures and diverse people
• The opportunity to work for an organization that has a strong sense of purpose, is values-driven and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programs
The Role • Scan historic editions of Lloyd’s Register of Ships using the available digitisation equipment and agreed handling procedures
• Prepare volumes and digital files for processing, including checking sequence, orientation, completeness, legibility and image quality
• Identify pages or volumes requiring further capture, manual intervention or escalation because information is obscured, incomplete or difficult to read
• Apply agreed file naming, folder structures and basic metadata requirements consistently
• Review low-confidence and quality-flagged project outputs against the relevant source images
• Correct clear transcription, formatting or field-allocation errors using agreed interpretation guidance and business rules
• Record corrections, decisions and supporting evidence accurately so that work is traceable and consistent
• Escalate ambiguous, specialist or unusual cases to the appropriate subject matter expert
• Carry out sample quality checks on completed work and raise recurring issues or patterns promptly
• Maintain simple progress records, including volumes or records completed, items requiring rework and outstanding queries
• Work collaboratively with project, library, and archive colleagues and contribute to improvements in guidance and working practices
• Follow archive handling, information governance, health and safety and data security requirements at all times
What you bring
• Good attention to detail and a demonstrable ability to work accurately and consistently with large volumes of information
• Patience and sustained concentration when completing repetitive or highly detailed tasks
• A methodical and organised approach, with the ability to follow documented procedures and maintain clear records
• Confidence using standard digital tools, including Microsoft Excel, Word, file and folder structures and web-based systems
• The ability to compare source images with structured data and identify omissions, inconsistencies or obvious errors
• Good written comprehension and the judgement to distinguish routine corrections from issues that require escalation
• A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from archivists, subject matter experts and project colleagues

We are looking for a Development Manager to lead the Software Development and Quality Engineering teams responsible for our FX Exchange applications across FX Spot, Swaps and NDF. You will have overall accountability for the people, technology, delivery and quality of the product area.
You will work closely with Product to shape the roadmap, assess technical feasibility and turn business and customer priorities into secure, resilient and scalable solutions. Lead the engineering organisation
Lead Software Development and Quality Engineering teams with shared accountability for delivery and product quality.
• Lead Software Development and Quality Engineering teams with shared accountability for delivery and product quality.
• Set clear technical direction, engineering standards and delivery expectations.
• Coach engineers, support career development and build future technical and people leaders.
• Plan the skills, capacity, hiring and organisational structure needed to deliver the product roadmap.
• Create an inclusive environment that values different perspectives, open communication and continuous learning.
• Lead distributed teams and work effectively with external technology partners.
Partner with Product
• Share accountability with Product for translating business strategy, customer needs and market opportunities into an achievable product roadmap.

• Use customer, operational and engineering data to measure outcomes and guide future investment.
Own engineering delivery and quality

• Make quality a shared responsibility across Development and Quality Engineering.
• Lead functional, integration, performance, resilience and security testing for business-critical trading services.
• Improve release confidence by automating repeatable checks, reducing manual hand-offs and addressing defects earlier.
• Ensure technical debt, engineering risks and dependencies are visible, prioritised and managed.
Provide technical leadership
• Guide architecture and design for high-volume, low-latency and highly available trading systems.
• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, observable, supportable and aligned with the wider FX technology strategy.
• Lead technical reviews and challenge designs constructively, while enabling teams to own implementation decisions.
• Drive modernisation of legacy platforms, including modularisation, simplification and the adoption of reusable engineering patterns.
• Maintain a strong understanding of Java, C++, Linux, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, messaging and performance engineering.
• Lead the response to complex production issues and ensure learning is converted into lasting improvements.
Embed AI and automation across engineering
• Set expectations for responsible use of AI throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design to coding, testing, documentation and production support.
• Encourage teams to create and reuse AI skills and agents that automate repeatable engineering activities.
• Use AI-assisted analysis and automation to improve quality, delivery speed and developer experience while protecting security, data and intellectual property.
• Measure adoption and outcomes, share effective patterns and ensure appropriate human review and governance.
Measure and improve performance
• Define meaningful measures for delivery flow, quality, reliability and engineering effectiveness.
• Use measures such as lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, recovery time, escaped defects, automation coverage, service availability and performance trends to identify improvements.

• Experience leading large-scale technology transformation, modernising legacy platforms and improving engineering practices while sustaining live services.
• Experience partnering with Product to shape roadmaps, evaluate options, prioritise investment and deliver customer and business outcomes.
• Experience establishing modern SDLC, automated testing, CI/CD, secure engineering, observability and operational readiness practices.
• Practical experience applying AI-assisted engineering, reusable skills or agents across requirements, development and testing.
• Experience using engineering and operational measures to improve delivery, quality and service reliability.
• Knowledge of FX Spot, Swaps or NDF, matching engines, FIX or comparable electronic trading platforms.
• Ability to communicate clearly, influence senior stakeholders and lead teams through ambiguity and change.
WHY JOIN US:
You will lead a product area at the heart of global financial markets and help shape the next generation of FX trading technology. You will have the opportunity to develop people, influence product and technical direction, and improve how software is designed, built, tested and operated.
We believe different perspectives strengthen our decisions and help us innovate. You will join an environment that values collaboration, learning, responsible experimentation and meaningful engineering outcomes.

About Lunio
Lunio is building a performance marketing platform that helps businesses reduce wasted spend and improve ROI. Our customers are household brands at the cutting edge of digital advertising. Our products directly influence customer performance, retention and growth. We operate with high autonomy, high accountability, and measurable commercial expectations. This team will be working across Data-Science and our Full Stack Engineering team in our Measurement and Data product pillar.
The role
You will own Lunio’s measurement and data platform, including attribution, identity, pipelines and integrations. You will turn complex marketing data into reliable measurement and commercially valuable products. You will be given high autonomy and accountability for business outcomes. You love working in an environment where you can move from ambiguity to a shipped outcome quickly, and test before you build.
What you will be responsible for
Own the measurement and data product strategy and roadmap. Make build, buy and deprecate decisions that balance customer and commercial value, reuse across customers, and ongoing operating cost.
Own the integrations roadmap across advertising platforms, data warehouses, CDPs and CRMs, including partner relationships and API dependencies.
Lead continuous discovery with customers, commercial teams, engineers and designers. Keep customers involved early and test the highest-risk assumptions quickly.
Have worked directly with engineering teams, demonstrating you can build trust across commercial, engineering and design, bringing people with you without formal authority
Write clear, rigorous specifications (PRDs, acceptance criteria, data and integration requirements) that give engineers clarity on what to build.
Own data-quality and reliability outcomes with engineering: agree customer-facing targets, prioritise improvements by customer and commercial impact, and track results.
What we are looking for
Must have:
Strong understanding of digital advertising, performance marketing and conversion measurement. You understand how platforms such as Google Ads and Meta capture, optimise, attribute and report conversions, and how conversion data flows.
Strong understanding of identity, matching and modern marketing data stacks, including first-party identifiers, identity stitching, CDPs, CRMs and data warehouses.
You understand the limits of attribution, when incrementality testing is needed, and how data quality, identity and privacy constrain what can be claimed. You can judge when excluding traffic or audiences cuts waste and when it costs more opportunity than it saves.
You have owned a data-intensive product or platform capability from customer discovery through production use. You can explain the product decisions and technical trade-offs you owned, the measurable outcomes, and where evidence changed your direction.
You can independently read API documentation, interrogate sample data and trace conversion flows. You work directly with engineers on data models, matching logic and failure cases, challenging options and making informed product trade-offs.
Nice to haves:
You have owned a platform, API or integrations product in high-growth B2B SaaS with commercial accountability.
You have worked directly with major advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok or Microsoft Ads, including their APIs and data models.
You prototype with AI tools to test ideas quickly before work enters a sprint.
What success looks like
In your first 6 months, we would expect to see:
An evidence-backed roadmap with clear priorities, success measures and explicit decisions about what not to build.
Shipped capabilities are in production use, with measured impact on an agreed customer or platform outcome and evidence of their commercial contribution.
Data quality and pipeline reliability are measured, reported and improving against a baseline you set.

job_description:
JOB SUMMARY
Shape the Future of Luxury Lifestyle Hospitality in Manchester
A bold new chapter is coming to one of the UK's most dynamic cities. W Manchester, a highly anticipated addition to the iconic W Hotels portfolio, is set to redefine luxury lifestyle hospitality in the heart of Manchester.
Celebrated for its creativity, cultural energy and global reputation for music, sport and innovation, Manchester provides the perfect backdrop for a brand that thrives on originality and contemporary luxury. As a pre-opening property, W Manchester represents a rare opportunity to help bring a new hospitality destination to life, creating extraordinary guest experiences from day one.
We are seeking an exceptional Director of Engineering to join the pre-opening leadership team and play a critical role in establishing the operational foundations, asset integrity and technical excellence that will underpin the hotel's long-term success.
About the Role
As Director of Engineering, you will provide strategic and operational leadership across all aspects of engineering, maintenance, facilities management and asset protection for the hotel.
This role carries overall responsibility for maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant, with particular focus on safety, security, regulatory compliance and the protection of the owner's investment. You will lead the engineering function through the pre-opening phase and beyond, ensuring that every technical system, guest-facing space and back-of-house operation reflects the exceptional standards expected of W Hotels.
Combining technical expertise with commercial acumen, you will oversee budgets, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintenance programmes and energy conservation initiatives while building a high-performing engineering culture that supports both guest satisfaction and financial performance.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead all engineering, maintenance and facilities operations, ensuring the property operates safely, efficiently and in full compliance with brand and regulatory requirements.
• Develop and execute engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives, pre-opening milestones and long-term operational goals.
• Manage the physical plant, including HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical and water treatment systems, ensuring optimum performance and reliability.
• Oversee engineering budgets, capital expenditure projects and preventative maintenance programmes, ensuring effective cost control and asset protection.
• Lead emergency response planning and serve as the senior point of contact for all facility-related incidents and life-safety matters.
• Build, inspire and develop a talented engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Partner with ownership, hotel leadership and regional teams to proactively identify risks, improve efficiencies and maximise return on investment.
• Drive sustainability and energy conservation initiatives while maintaining the elevated guest experience expected within a luxury lifestyle hotel environment.
The Ideal Candidate
The successful candidate will be a forward-thinking engineering leader with experience managing complex hospitality assets and delivering results in fast-paced, high-profile environments.
You will bring a combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking and strong people leadership. Equally comfortable managing major capital projects, operational budgets and team development, you understand how engineering excellence directly influences guest satisfaction, associate engagement and commercial performance.
We are looking for someone who demonstrates:
• A collaborative and empowering leadership style.
• Experience leading engineering operations within luxury hotels, resorts or large-scale hospitality environments.
• Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management and capital planning.
• Deep knowledge of building systems, life-safety compliance and preventative maintenance programmes.
• A passion for developing high-performing teams and fostering a positive workplace culture.
• The ability to balance operational discipline with the bold, innovative spirit that defines W Hotels.
Education & Experience
• High school diploma or GED with a minimum of six years' experience in engineering, maintenance or a related discipline, including technical training in HVAC-R, Electrical and Plumbing;
OR
• A two-year degree in Building & Construction, Engineering, Mechanics or a related field, with a minimum of four years' relevant experience, including technical training in HVAC-R, Electrical and Plumbing.
Why Join Marriott International?
At Marriott International, you will join the world's largest hospitality company and a business committed to helping associates realise their full potential. We offer outstanding opportunities for career progression, leadership development and international mobility across an unrivalled portfolio of brands and destinations.
Joining W Hotels means becoming part of a brand that challenges convention, embraces creativity and celebrates individuality. As part of a pre-opening team, you will have a unique opportunity to influence the culture, standards and success of a landmark hotel from its very beginning.
Your Next Chapter Starts Here
This is more than an engineering leadership role. It is an opportunity to help create one of Manchester's most exciting new hospitality destinations and leave a lasting legacy within one of the world's most distinctive luxury lifestyle brands.
If you are an accomplished engineering leader ready to shape the future of W Manchester, we invite you to explore this exceptional opportunity and become part of the next generation of luxury hospitality with W Hotels and Marriott International.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. job_description:
Food & Beverage Service Expert [Casual]
Aloft London Excel
At AC Hotels, we believe attention to detail is the greatest form of generosity we can offer. From thoughtfully designed spaces to seamless guest experiences, every detail matters. Our associates share a global mindset, a passion for precision, and a natural curiosity to learn, grow, and discover new possibilities. We look for ways to elevate the experience for guests and each other, creating an environment where excellence is both expected and appreciated. As part of the Marriott International family, AC Hotels offers more than a job. It is an opportunity to be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
Position Summary
The Food & Beverage Service Expert is responsible for creating memorable dining experiences by delivering outstanding food and beverage service to guests. This role goes beyond serving food and drinks, ensuring every interaction contributes to a unique and enjoyable guest experience while maintaining Marriott's quality, safety, and service standards. What you'll do

You will manage version control of all formal documents, process RFC/ECO documents against procedure, and keep full records and the technical archive. • Maintain accurate, up-to-date BoMs from engineering drawings in our in-house databases (Avante, SAT, R&D file storage) and the upcoming ERP system

• Catalogue and store documents on the R&D server so they are easy to find
• Process RFC/ECO documents against procedure, chase tasks to completion and keep records accurate
• Verify and quality check technical data and drawings before they are issued, for production in Vietnam, the UK and Hong Kong

Programme structure - your work at MBDA:
Start your career in the digital world by designing, delivering, supporting, maintaining and protecting the digital technology and solutions for the MBDA ecosystem. The Digital Excellence Team are evolving the way our products and services are designed and delivered to our customers, and we need you to help us!
Our solutions are developed and deployed in accordance with the international group business needs, our product partnership initiatives and the national security standards. We need individuals who want to develop their skills across the whole digital information systems and information technology enterprise as well as building a specialism in cyber security.
This programme is a fantastic opportunity for you to join a growing digital systems team and gain hands on experience within the information technology and information systems sector with a major defence contractor. It will give you experience of projects developing or enhancing business solutions as well an understanding of operational and service delivery. We'll support those with the aptitude and passion for all things technology based and allow hands on experience within Infrastructure, AI, Cloud and Application environments.
Solution delivery at MBDA is typically a mix of ‘waterfall' and ‘agile' project methodologies meaning you'll have the opportunity to compare and contrast different styles of solution development and begin to learn how to select the best approach to meet the requirements. Typically you will be involved with and contribute to solution analysis and requirements elicitation; systems and solution design including liaising with technology and service providers; project/task management including release and test management.
Our operational teams cover everything from user engagement through to cyber security threat protection, detection and recovery. We use ITIL standards for our operational management and comply with standards such as the national government Cyber Security Essentials Plus scheme, ISO27001, and you will have the opportunity to develop an understanding of and begin to apply those in practise. In this area you would be involved in the delivery of services for the enterprise covering applications, infrastructure and desktop ecosystem including performance monitoring and capacity management.
In addition to study and experience in each of our main digital domains and disciplines, you will follow the specialist path of Cyber Security Analyst. They will need to analyse and understand the points of vulnerability within IT systems, monitor security performance using tools, undertake statistical reporting and analysis, proactively problem solve and propose improvements and implement changes. They will also collaborate across the international MBDA group.

Programme structure - your work at MBDA:
The academic portion of this apprenticeship consists of predominantly face to face learning one day a week at the University, with some block teaching in each Semester as well as some virtual delivery. The remainder of your working week you'll be onsite in your home function of Seeker and Datalink Systems (S&DS).
The Seeker and Datalink Systems (S&DS) department offers an exciting opportunity to be at the centre of cutting-edge product development at MBDA.
The seeker is the 'eye' of a missile. It is a complicated integrated system which uses either RF radar technology or electro optical (IR) sensors to assist with missile guidance as well as to detect, identify and track targets. The data link system is the communication link of the missile, it typically facilitates communication between the missile and the launching platform, allowing mission critical data to be exchanged. The S&DS department also includes opportunities within RF survivability; they employ cutting edge RF techniques to enhance the probability of a missile reaching its target. From design, to development, integration and production, the S&DS department's contribution is vital to ensure we can deliver the highest quality products to our customers.
As an S&DS engineer, you'll work innovatively and collaboratively amongst teams of motivated individuals to tackle technical challenges. Your work will be integral in helping to advance the capability of radar and communications technology at MBDA.
You'll have a unique opportunity to apply your degree course content to real world problems, supported by colleagues in varied and inclusive teams. You will undertake various placements, working on different aspects of S&DS design and contributing to projects that span the full product lifecycle. Placements typically include:
• Research and development activities
• Hardware and Software Integration and Lab testing
• Simulation, Modelling and Algorithm development
• Systems design and Requirements Specifications
• Data Analysis - Applying analytical techniques to draw conclusions from results
The above placements will develop your practical, technical and communication skills within an industrial environment, raising your awareness of the economic, social, legal, ethical and sustainability considerations of the business and engineering.
You will also have the opportunity to work towards Professional Chartership with the IOP, IMA, IET, IMechE or RAeS, and we will pay 100% of the fees whilst you are on the apprenticeship scheme.
The diversity of expertise working together under one roof makes the S&DS department a unique environment for discovering, exploring and specialising in a wide variety of highly technical areas. We are therefore looking for candidates with diverse backgrounds and interests.
We also work closely with many other teams, giving you exposure to other exciting areas across MBDA. With S&DS being an Anglo-Italian department, multi-national projects are common and can lead to exciting travel or secondment opportunities.
This role would be ideal for someone who enjoys
• Problem solving
• Learning about RF (radio frequency) design fundamentals
• Applying university knowledge in a real world environment
• Developing future defence concepts

A minimum of 5 GCSEs at minimum grade 4.
This must include:

After GCSEs:
Following your GCSE's you must have completed one of the following qualification routes, equivalent to a minimum of 120 UCAS Tariff points:
• A level: Three A levels totalling 120 UCAS Tariff points, including Maths and either a Technology or Engineering subject, with no individual grade below B • BTEC: A single Level 3 Extended Diploma in Engineering at a minimum grade of DDM, including a distinction in a Further Maths module.

The opportunity:
System modelling is a vital tool used to ensure MBDA provides reliable and cost effective weapon systems to our customers!
We build a variety of dynamic system performance models, embedded systems and real time models for MBDA products. Our models are developed and used extensively throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through to in service support. When used internally our performance models allow our system designers to estimate performance, which they can use to guide the product design. For our customer, performance models provide a method of verifying system performance whilst reducing reliance on prohibitively expensive testing and trials. Our real time models contribute to training environments for pilots and provide a variety of engineering testing capabilities. Once the product is in service, the customer continues to use our models to understand system capability and assist with operator training.
Models of modern weapon system are made up of a large number of automated subsystems integrated together to provide the overall capability. This provides unique challenges when: developing accurate system - or system of system level - models that are both large in scale and highly sophisticated with many interdependencies; or when developing lower fidelity models designed to run at real time whilst maintaining an accurate representation of the weapon system. As a model developer this means you'll often encounter new and exciting problems which will require you to apply your intuition and innovation to solve.
You'll learn how to build simulation software in programming languages/environments such as:
• Mathworks (MATLAB, Simulink and Stateflow)
• Fortran
• C/C++
Our teams implement Agile working practices and dynamic working across multiple projects to meet demand, aided by the use of collaborative tools. We also work closely with other departments and companies to integrate subsystem models and design data. From these interactions you'll gain a broad understanding of each subsystem that makes up the weapon and how the system architecture makes these subsystems work together to provide an overall capability.
This role is best suited to those interested in mathematical modelling and programming, are passionate about solving complex problems within highly technical teams and enjoy working in a supportive environment.

It's our job to develop and optimise the algorithms inside weapon systems across the whole of MBDA.

Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. 10 week placement: Starting June 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies

The opportunity:
As an Engineer in the Weapon Systems Design division, you will be part of a rapidly expanding area of the MBDA business - providing specialist technical support at system level to a range of high-profile projects, including Future Combat Air System (FCAS), STRATUS and DragonFire.
The Weapon System Algorithms and Performance (WSAP) department specialises in a broad range of areas: developing cutting-edge algorithms, mathematically evaluating the performance of products, and working with the future business teams to bring technical excellence to our future concepts. We leverage the use of leading technologies and tools such as deep reinforcement learning and test-driven algorithm development to provide optimised weapon system solutions across the whole of the MBDA product line.

Our algorithms team is currently working on:
• Routing algorithms for long-range strike weapons
• Operator decision aids for strike mission planning
• Threat evaluation & weapon assignment algorithms for air defence
• Multi-weapon co-operation
• Application of machine learning techniques to air-to-air combat
Regardless of which project you work on, you'll be part of a team comprising some of the most talented engineers, scientists and technicians in their fields, helping to deliver innovative battle-winning capabilities to MBDA's customers across the globe

Current undergraduate working towards a degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science.

Reporting to the Global Service Owner, the Organizational Effectiveness Manager implements change and project management programs to accelerate delivery, engagement, capability, and adoption of ways of working, systems, processes, and business priorities impacting the Q&R and/or R&D organizations. This role develops, maintains, and audits the skills, requirements, and developmental activities for employees as well as collaborates with stakeholders to identify business needs and resolve performance gaps. Deliver change and project management solutions that enable functional readiness and ensure success through guiding employees and leadership through change, promoting adaptability and resilience. • Program management of technical skills and competencies Leadership of identification, development, and ongoing utilization of professional and functional skills, competencies, behaviors and requirements for Q&R and/or R&D employees, ensuring the organization has identified competencies and plans for successful transformation, current positions and future aspirations, succession, organizational design incorporative of the different levels of competencies, and the strategy for new roles and competencies within the structure. Partner with technical leaders, Communities of Practice, and/or learning organizations to ensure and enable alignment, planning and delivery through appropriate channels. • Leadership and partnership of HR/OE toolkits - cascade tools, playbooks, standards, and strategies set forth by the Organizational Change Management and Project Management Offices.

• Consults with PMO, CMO, SC, and CoE with input from internal and external stakeholders to understand and anticipate the needs of the organization so that change and program initiatives align. • JTE and Quality Culture team to ensure changes, projects, programs, and competencies are aligned and standardized • Classroom based facilitation and/or training, as needed. Bachelor’s degree in relevant Sciences discipline (ChemE, Food Science, IE, Biology); Instructional Systems Design, Organizational Design and Effectiveness
5+ years of experience with change and leading initiatives, including experience and knowledge of change management principles, methodologies, and tools

Pro-actively updating the team’s priorities, plans and resources based on strategy changes and situational needs. Development of a continual learning culture within the team. Ability to rapidly change, adapt, and train employees in response to market, customer, or strategy Professional Excellence: Flexible and adaptable, able to work with objectivity in an ambiguous, high change environment. Excellent business acumen, project management, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. We are seeking an experienced and proactive **Senior Corporate Secretarial & Governance Paralegal** to join our London office. This role is designed for a seasoned professional with substantial expertise in managing global subsidiary governance, corporate compliance, and entity administration across international jurisdictions.
This position is pivotal in ensuring robust governance and compliance for a portfolio of approximately 41 entities in 21 countries. You will serve as the primary gatekeeper for corporate records, managing everything from routine statutory filings to complex capitalization changes and licensing requirements. As a senior member of the team, you will take ownership of entity lifecycle operations, interface with cross-functional leadership and external advisors, and drive strategic subsidiary management initiatives across the global portfolio.
**What You’ll Do:**
#### **1\. Corporate Governance and Program Management**
- **Drafting & Review**: Assist in drafting, reviewing, and maintaining core corporate governance documents, including board resolutions, meeting minutes, and stockholder consents.
- **Portfolio Management:** Directly oversee the ongoing maintenance of the company's 41 subsidiaries across 21 countries, ensuring all global entities remain in good standing and compliant with local regulations.
- **Entity Life Cycle Management & Rationalization**: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of entities, including coordinating new entity formations, business registrations, foreign qualifications (for US entities), dissolutions, and strategic entity rationalization projects across the global portfolio.
- **Subsidiary Program Management:** Manage the global subsidiary management program, including the strategic development and continuous improvement of processes to best manage our 41 subsidiaries across 21 countries.
- **Policies & Procedures**: Support the maintenance of corporate governance policies and procedures.
#### **2\. Subsidiary Administration & Banking Operations Support**
- **Banking Operations**: Support bank account openings for new and existing entities. Manage and track bank account signer changes, ensuring resolutions and banking mandates are updated promptly.
- **KYC Management**: Serve as the lead point of contact for Know Your Customer (KYC) requests. Proactively manage and respond to information requests from banks, financial institutions, and regulators to ensure accounts remain active and compliant.
- **Officer & Director Management**: Manage the election and appointment of directors and officers, ensuring all records reflect current leadership.
- **Mail & Records**: Manage physical and electronic mail intake for the portfolio; ensure physical corporate seals and minute books are securely stored.
#### **3\. External Relationship Management**
- **Outside Counsel & Service Providers**: Act as the primary point of contact for external legal partners. Responsibilities include instructing outside counsel on specific jurisdictional matters and managing the relationship with the centralized corporate secretary service provider to ensure seamless global compliance.
**What We’re Looking For:**
- **Qualifications**: Bachelors degree or equivalent legal qualification (such as ICSA/CGI certification or paralegal qualification).
- **Experience**: Significant prior experience in corporate governance, subsidiary management, or corporate secretarial practice within an in-house legal department or international law firm.
- **Attributes**: High level of discretion, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- **Language**: Full professional fluency in English, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to senior stakeholders and partners.

• Collaborating with client teams.

An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your DevOps engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.

A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We are looking for someone who can take an entrepreneurial approach to building a territory, developing relationships and creating new business opportunities.
You will work closely with Microsoft's public sector sales teams, including Cloud Solutions Architects, Azure Specialists, Global Black Belts, Enterprise Channel Managers and Account Technology Specialists, alongside our strategic channel partners. Together, you will identify opportunities to help public sector organisations modernise their end-user computing environments, leveraging Microsoft technologies including Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, Intune and AVD hybrid.
You will position Nerdio as a strategic enabler of that journey, helping customers simplify management, optimise costs, strengthen resilience and improve operational efficiency. Alignment with Microsoft and our channel ecosystem is essential, but equally important is your ability to engage directly with customers, understand their challenges and demonstrate meaningful business value.
We are looking for a highly skilled, partnership-led seller who builds strong relationships, understands the end-user computing landscape and can navigate complex public sector sales cycles. Public sector buying cycles, frameworks and governance requirements are different from commercial sales, so you will bring experience of navigating them and an ability to engage stakeholders across IT, security, finance and senior leadership.
Integrity means everything to us, so you do what you say you are going to do. You will coordinate with colleagues across the wider team and use your excellent listening, written and verbal communication skills to do it.
Territory and segment focus reflects our current go-to-market structure and may change from time to time as the business evolves.

• Build, manage and close pipeline, maintaining 3x coverage of your assigned quota.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with Microsoft and its public sector sales teams, developing joint account plans and identifying opportunities to grow the partnership and revenue.
• Develop relationships with strategic channel partners, collaborating on account planning, opportunity creation and joint go-to-market activities.
• Use a consultative, partnership-led selling approach to uncover, qualify and close opportunities across AVD, Windows 365 and the wider Nerdio portfolio.
• Navigate public sector procurement routes, including frameworks and partner-led buying, working with channel partners to get deals over the line.

• Communicate Nerdio's value proposition, capabilities and benefits clearly, connecting our technology to the business outcomes that matter most to public sector organisations.
• Work closely with the wider sales, technical, channel and Microsoft alliance teams to develop and execute strategies to meet targets.
• Participate in field events with partners and Microsoft counterparts to nurture relationships, create demand and drive business in your territory.
• Coordinate with other departments to ensure customer needs are met and projects are delivered successfully.
• Demonstrate integrity and follow through on commitments to ensure customer satisfaction.

You will be responsible for leading client workshops, defining Azure cloud strategies, producing technical design documentation and overseeing the delivery of complex cloud migration and infrastructure transformation projects.
The role requires demonstrable experience in Azure architecture, infrastructure engineering and cloud migration, ideally within a complex, multi-disciplinary and multi-supplier environment.

• Act as the senior technical authority for Azure-focused projects and programmes, providing architectural direction and technical leadership.
• Lead client workshops to understand business requirements, identify technical challenges and develop appropriate Azure-based solutions.
• Design and implement Azure cloud architectures, covering IaaS, PaaS, networking, security, identity and infrastructure services.
• Produce end-to-end technical architecture and design documentation, including High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and migration strategies.
• Define current and target-state architectures, develop cloud migration approaches and break down technical requirements into deliverable tasks for engineering teams.
• Lead cloud migration and infrastructure transformation activities, ensuring solutions meet performance, security, availability and scalability requirements.
• Design holistic service solutions that consider not only technology but also service support, operational management, maintenance and ongoing service delivery.
• Provide technical coordination across multiple engineering and delivery teams, ensuring clear ownership, responsibilities and alignment.
• Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Senior Management and Service Acceptance teams to ensure architectural governance and compliance.
• Support the full project lifecycle, from initial discovery and architecture through implementation, transition and decommissioning.
• Work within different delivery methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall, ensuring successful delivery against agreed timelines and quality standards.
Qualifications
• Strong and demonstrable experience working as a Solution Architect or Cloud Architect, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure.
• Extensive experience designing and delivering Azure cloud solutions, including complex cloud migration and infrastructure transformation projects.
• Strong understanding of Azure architecture principles, best practices and the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
• Hands-on experience with Azure infrastructure and platform services, including IaaS, PaaS, networking, storage and compute.
• Extensive experience in infrastructure engineering, with a strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure environments.
• Experience designing and delivering secure, scalable and resilient cloud architectures.
• Strong knowledge of Azure networking, identity and access management, security and monitoring.
• Experience working within multi-vendor and multi-supplier environments, coordinating technical delivery across different teams.
• Experience working closely with application development and infrastructure engineering teams to establish and support cloud platforms.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and client workshops.
• Excellent technical documentation skills, including the production and management of architectural designs and technical specifications.
• Understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

• Uphold high standards of delivery, ensuring a consistent, high-quality attendee experience while adapting events to local needs.
• Guide and support colleagues in our US and Australian offices, remotely from the UK, so that events there meet the same standard as our UK programme.
• Contribute to the redesign of our 2027 events programme, bringing structure and rigour to how our events scale.
Budgets and suppliers
• Take ownership of event budgets, providing evidence-based forecasts and informed recommendations, confidently responding to challenge to support sound commercial decisions and identify opportunities for value and savings.
• Manage relationships with DMCs, agencies and suppliers, planning and delivering successful events in partnership with them.
• Negotiate event contracts, working in partnership with our legal team.
Internal stakeholders
• Work in partnership with internal stakeholders, including the Employee Experience Working Group and our international office leads, to plan and deliver successful events.
Improvement and capability
• Lead post-event evaluation and continuous improvement, using attendee feedback and performance data to strengthen future events, processes and tools as the programme scales.
• Coach and mentor colleagues involved in event planning, building strength and capability within the team and with key stakeholders operating abroad.
Requirements
You are a high-calibre individual with exceptional personal drive and a real passion for creating inclusive, memorable experiences for people. You bring rigour to a fast-paced programme without losing sight of the attendee on the day. Strong communication skills, an analytical mind and a positive attitude are essential to fit into the Newton culture.
Essential skills and experience
• Proven experience leading the delivery of large-scale events for more than 600 attendees, including multi-day or multi-location experiences.
• Demonstrable ownership of significant project budgets, with accountability for evidence-based decisions about how spend is allocated across an event.
• The ability to manage a complex, fast-paced programme with structure, rigour and sound judgement.
• Strong supplier and agency management experience, including working in partnership with destination management companies: front-end briefing and proposal creation, negotiation, ongoing performance management and relationship building.
• The ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of an organisation.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
• A genuine commitment to creating inclusive, people-centred experiences.
• Experience gained in a corporate events team, an events agency or an agency working with corporate clients.
Desirable
• Experience delivering international events or coordinating event delivery across multiple countries.
• Experience managing external partners, including event and brand agencies.

Our core events normally start on a Thursday evening and run throughout Friday, so you must be happy to travel and be away from home at least once a month. Newton seeks to maximise the potential of our people, whether in client-based consulting roles or in Head Office functions. You will have dedicated and consistent development opportunities to support your career progression, and you will receive regular appraisals and annual pay reviews.

NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT) is an integral part of the NHS, collecting and processing 2 million blood donations a year. Our Healthcare Scientists provide crucial support to NHS Hospitals, processing, testing and issuing blood and its components and delivering diagnostic and therapeutic services relating to the transfusion of blood and stem cells, transplantation and tissue banking.
The IBGRL Red Cell Reference department provides an internationally renowned immunohaematology reference service for NHS Blood and Transplant and the international transfusion community. We deal exclusively in complex and interesting red cell immunohaematology problems, often involving rare blood groups. RCR is distinguished by the scientific expertise of its small team of staff and an unparallelled collection of rare cells and sera. In collaboration with colleagues around the world the RCR laboratory continues to make important discoveries in the field of human blood groups. We also compile and maintain the International Rare Donor Panel.

A Biomedical Scientist wishing to develop specialist transfusion skills will be considered for the post, paid as a BMS on a Band 5 whilst achieving the necessary experience and qualifications.
We have two posts to recruit to. One post will be carrying out genetic testing within the laboratory, which is essential to resolve complex immunohaematology investigations for patients and donors. The other post will be carrying out serological testing for complex immunohaematology investigations.

Job Title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist – BioAI Department: BioAI Location: London, UK Your impact begins here The ML Scientist will develop AI methods for biological discovery, focusing on cellular foundation models and complex biological data. The role combines hands-on method development with delivering reproducible tools for scientists. You will guide junior colleagues and share research through presentations and publications. What you’ll do • Develop biological foundation models and predictive methods for target identification and prioritization, disease biology, and mechanism-of-action studies. • Partner with experimental scientists to define biological questions, incorporate biological knowledge into models, and design experiments that test model predictions. • Define project objectives, milestones, and success criteria that connect model performance to research decisions and measurable scientific impact. • Work with data and engineering teams to curate and harmonize biological datasets, addressing metadata quality, batch effects, and reproducible processing. • Develop reusable workflows for model training and inference, support adoption by research teams, and assess improvements in decision quality and research efficiency. • Research model architectures and self-supervised training methods for single-cell, omics, and imaging data, including multimodal approaches where scientifically justified. • Train, fine-tune, and debug models in PyTorch on GPU and high-performance computing infrastructure, balancing performance with computational cost. • Explore generative and agentic AI workflows that support biological hypothesis generation, data interpretation, and experimental planning. • Benchmark against strong baselines using independent datasets and biologically meaningful endpoints; assess data leakage, generalization, uncertainty, and interpretability. • Communicate findings, model limitations, and recommendations clearly to experimental scientists, technical colleagues, and leadership. • Mentor colleagues through scientific guidance and code review, and maintain clear documentation, reproducible experiments, and responsible data and model use. • Contribute to publications, relevant intellectual property, and internal knowledge sharing, and evaluate emerging methods for their value to BioAI priorities. Working with experimental scientists, computational biologists, and engineers across Novo Nordisk and external partners, we translate these insights into better decisions and faster therapeutic discovery. We value a diverse and inclusive culture where colleagues collaborate, share ideas, and help each other grow. Our work starts and ends with the patient, with a focus on chronic diseases such as diabetes and obesity. We encourage ingenuity and innovation in an enjoyable workplace, supported by competitive compensation and a healthy work-life balance. Leading some projects and contributing to others gives you room to grow your skills, take on greater responsibility and make your voice heard, in a team that shares what it learns. • Head of Product Development, who owns the four key delivery metrics this role exists to move.
