Low Voltage Authorising Engineer
Location:Sheffield, UK
Salary:Dependant on experience
Closing Date:17/11/2026 00:00
At Sheffield Forgemasters we have an exciting opportunity for a Site Low Voltage Authorisation Engineer to join our team.
This role is based at our 64-acre site in the heart of Sheffield and will be working as part of our Engineering & Maintenance function, providing technical governance and assurance for low voltage electrical systems across the business while supporting safe, reliable and compliant site operations. As a Site LV Authorisation Engineer, you will act as the site’s technical authority for low voltage electrical safety, ensuring electrical assets, installations and working practices comply with company standards, statutory requirements and electrical safety regulations. You will oversee the electrical authorisation framework, provide technical assurance, and drive continuous improvement in electrical safety, compliance and workforce competence across the site. What you’ll be doing
• Acting as the Site Low Voltage Authorised Person and ensuring compliance with site electrical safety rules and procedures.
• Managing and maintaining the electrical authorisation framework, including assessment and reauthorisation of personnel.
• Leading electrical safety audits, inspections and compliance assessments across the site.
• Planning and overseeing LV electrical inspection, testing and verification programmes.
• Reviewing electrical test results, certification and compliance reports and ensuring corrective actions are completed.
• Providing technical support for LV distribution systems, switchgear, protection systems and motor control centres (MCCs).
• Identifying, assessing and mitigating electrical risks while promoting safe systems of work, isolation procedures and permit-to-work compliance.
• Reviewing contractor competencies, RAMS and electrical safe working arrangements.
• Supporting engineering, maintenance, operational and project teams with specialist electrical expertise.
• Coaching, mentoring and developing electrical personnel to strengthen competence and safety culture across the business.
About You
• Time-served electrician with a recognised electrical apprenticeship.
• Qualified electrician with experience in heavy industrial, manufacturing, utilities, steelmaking or similar environments.
• Approved Electrician status or equivalent level of competence and experience.
• City & Guilds 2391 Inspection & Testing qualification, or equivalent.
• Experience operating within an electrical authorisation framework and acting as an Authorised Person.
• Strong knowledge of LV electrical distribution systems, switchgear, protection systems and industrial power networks.
• Thorough understanding of electrical isolation principles, switching procedures, permit-to-work systems and electrical safety legislation including Electricity at Work Regulations and BS7671.
• Experience carrying out electrical inspections, testing, verification and certification activities.
• Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
• A proactive approach to safety, strong problem-solving ability and the confidence to challenge unsafe practices.
As well as having the skills, knowledge and experience for this role, we are also looking for someone who embodies our core values: Customer Focus; Working Together; Trust & Respect; Quality & Innovation; and Safety & Wellbeing.
The Working Pattern
This is a full-time role working 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday. 0745-4pm.
Why Sheffield Forgemasters?
Sheffield Forgemasters is an iconic steel production and engineering company, with a history that can be traced back to the 1750s, starting life as a small blacksmith forge. We have since gone through many evolutions and gone by several different names and guises, whilst consistently being at the forefront of innovation and new process development in the steel industry.
Recognising Sheffield Forgemasters as a global leader in the designing, manufacturing and delivering of world-class steel forgings and castings, we were acquired by the UK Ministry of Defence in 2021. The acquisition has secured our role as a critical supplier to the next generation of UK defence programmes. As part of this programme of work, £1.3bn is being invested in modernising our plant and equipment, creating new opportunities for the business and our colleagues.
What We Offer • Stability, with large-scale & long-term investment and orders already secured into the 2040s. • A programme of redevelopment that will include state-of-the-art new machinery and facilities on site.

The Finance Specialist Cash Application is a full-time opportunity within the Enterprise Financial Services (EFS) team of Group Finance. The position is responsible for cash application activities for Accounts Receivable (AR) on behalf of Performance Coatings Group (PCG), and Consumer Brands Group (CBG). The successful candidate will have direct contact with our internal and external customers; build relationships with the sales organization and collaborate with finance colleagues of The Sherwin-Williams Company. Preferred location: Witney - UK

• Ensure accurate cash allocation and resolve payment discrepancies to maintain customer account integrity
• Post and apply payments from a variety of sources, including BACS, SWIFT, and credit card receipts
• Liaise with customers and internal stakeholders to obtain remittance information and resolve payment queries
• Reconcile bank statements, cash receipts, and open payment reports across ERP systems
• Investigate and reconcile complex payment transactions and major customer accounts

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
• Basic accounting knowledge and strong numerical aptitude.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused approach.
• Experience in accounting, customer service, Oracle Cash Application, or a similar finance environment would be an advantage.

As a Senior Finance Analyst in our Financial Planning and Analysis team you will act as a key finance partner to business areas, delivering financial planning, reporting, analysis, and cost management support. In this role you will provide actionable insights to drive business performance, supports budgeting and forecasting processes, and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple functions to improve financial outcomes and decision-making. This role is perfect for someone who loves business partnering, understanding the business and driving continuous improvements. • Partner with business areas to provide financial analysis, reporting, and insights that support strategic decision-making.
• Support forecasting, budgeting, compensation planning, and headcount management processes.
• Deliver balance sheet, expense, and P&L reporting, highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities to business stakeholders.
• Collaborate with HR, IT, Sales, Customer Service, R&D, and Marketing teams to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and financial processes.
• Drive expense management initiatives and provide analysis across key cost categories, including payroll, facilities, fleet, marketing, and other overheads.

• Ability to build effective relationships and influence stakeholders at all organisational levels, from operational teams to senior leadership
• Knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS reporting standards
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Dataiku, Python, Copilot, and other business intelligence and data analysis tools, including dashboard development and large dataset analysis
• Experience in financial modelling, reporting automation, analytics, and business intelligence solutions
• A love for continuous improvement and keeping up-to-date with AI developments to drive improvements and effeciencies

This is an exciting role within a forward-thinking business development and marketing team which provides integrated marketing, digital services, client relationship management and business development expertise to the Business. The Events Manager role is part of the firm’s Marketing Operations team and will be responsible for supporting the planning and delivery of a wide range of events that will enhance our brand presence, client relationships and business development initiatives, aligned to the firm’s overarching strategy and business objectives.
You will be working as part of a high-performing events team, supporting the Head of Marketing Operations and the team on the delivery of a range of events designed to foster client loyalty, drive business growth and underpin our position as a market leader.
You are an experienced events professional, able to seamlessly switch between strategic planning and tactical event delivery. You will ensure events are planned and delivered to run smoothly, by providing administrative support to the team, supporting stakeholders with queries and providing on the day support, as well as the end-to-end management of a portfolio of events. As Events Manager you will also provide day-to-day leadership and support to the Events and Property & Workplace teams, including guidance and best practice as agreed in the event strategy.
Standard contracted hours for this role are from 9am - 5:30pm. However, due to the dynamic nature of event management, there will be occasions in the lead-up to and during events when adjustments to these hours may be necessary. Such alterations are considered an integral part of the role, and candidates should be prepared for a degree of flexibility in their working schedule to accommodate the successful execution of events.
Main responsibilities
- Collaborate with the Head of Marketing Operations and the Events team to execute the events strategy and lead key projects that reinforce and elevate our commitment to excellence in our events.
- End-to-end management of a portfolio of key onsite and offsite events, including initial scoping meetings, taking a full event brief and gaining deep understanding of the event objectives and budget, event proposal creation, invitation and guest list management and post event analysis and recommendations to ensure we drive excellence through our events.
- Provide day-to-day leadership and support to the Events team including providing guidance on events planning
- Own the end-to-end event design and stakeholder management.
- Work closely with stakeholders and the wider BD team to define clear event objectives and gain insight into how to measure and report on success post event.
- To lead on the logistical management of complex, large events (a blend of live, hybrid and virtual) with an eye for detail, but also proactively design events to showcase the firm’s expertise and heighten our visibility within key markets whilst tracking event spend against budget.
- Work with the CRM data team to build client-centred mailing lists on the firm’s CRM system.
- Create event invitations in collaboration with the BD team, tracking and reporting as appropriate throughout the invite marketing automation process.
- Work with the Marketing Operations team to produce event collateral and content for the firm’s website and social media channels.
- Collaborate with the PR & Communications team to provide opportunities for external and internal comms activity.
- Research venues, event suppliers and industry trends to maintain knowledge and networks.
- Build and maintain a strong internal network across the firm, ensuring a deep understanding of the BD team, firmwide and practice group strategy to increase engagement.
- Liaise closely with the in-house FOH teams including reception, catering, to ensure smooth running of all client events and that standards are being upheld.
- Create and analyse event ROI data and post event feedback and reporting for key stakeholders.
- Regularly review and update the suite of event ‘self-help’ tools on the intranet and update the central events calendar to increase visibility, awareness and engagement across the firm.
- Review the success of individual external facing seminars/events and feeding back to sectors with suggestions for improvement, where relevant.
**London focus**
- Be a point-person for London focused BD activity, ensuring alignment with the firm’s Chosen Markets strategy.
- Collaborate closely with the Head of Office in your regional areas to proactively spearhead local initiatives. Assist the Head of Office with managing the business development events budget aligned with our strategic goals to ensure optimal allocation and utilisation of resources.
Skills and qualifications
- A minimum of 5 years’ experience of coordinating events, gained in a professional services or similar environment, at manager level or above. An understanding of the legal sector is advantageous.
- A confident communicator with exceptional writing skills and attention to detail.
- Passionate about delivering excellent client experience.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Knowledge of CRM systems. Experience of InterAction+, Vuture and Adobe AEM would be advantageous.
- Good working knowledge of MS Office.
- A proactive team player, able to prioritise and manage several projects concurrently and meet deadlines.
- Experience in hosting live virtual webinars, on any platform.
- Good front of house skills ensuring an easily identifiable Shoosmiths event can be delivered within the relevant market place.
**The firm**
Shoosmiths is the law firm clients choose for excellent service, incisive thinking and above all for our ability to focus on what matters. From offices across the UK and Brussels, we support some of the world’s most exciting and ambitious businesses; amazing clients making an impact. We empower our people to be their authentic selves and deliver together in supportive teams committed to excellence and innovation. The first top 50 law firm to achieve ‘Platinum Standard’ Investors in People, our values and culture are not just words on our website but are the heartbeat of the firm.
We have an outstanding benefits package to complement our competitive remuneration system. In addition to the competitive salaries, great working environment and high-quality work, we believe that all staff should be rewarded for their commitment to the continued success of the firm through a comprehensive and flexible range of benefits.
To discover more about our benefits, please visit: Benefits Package

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

We want someone who understands Microsoft 365 and Azure – including Business Premium, E3, E5, E7 and relevant add-ons – and has a strong commercial understanding of Azure consumption. You’ll be able to articulate what a customer’s licensing, Azure usage and wider Microsoft estate mean for their security posture, capability and investment.
You’ll sell our secure365® Security Managed Services, Microsoft Security solutions and consultancy to net-new customers, supported by our BDR, Marketing and technical teams.
Key Responsibilities:
• Win net-new mid-market customers and deliver against revenue targets.
• Build your own pipeline alongside BDR and Marketing-generated opportunities.
• Lead credible discovery conversations with IT Managers, IT Directors, CISOs and other senior stakeholders.
• Understand customers’ Microsoft environments, licensing position, Azure consumption and security priorities, identifying opportunities to optimise their Microsoft investment while strengthening their security posture.
• Identify opportunities across Microsoft Security, managed services and consultancy.
• Translate technical requirements into clear business value and commercial outcomes.
• Own the sales cycle from first conversation through to negotiation and close.
• Bring our security specialists into opportunities at the right time.
Essential Experience:
You’ll be a proven new-business hunter with 3+ years’ experience selling Microsoft, cybersecurity, MSP, cloud or IT services.
• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Azure.
• A good understanding of Microsoft licensing across Business Premium, E3, E5, E7 and relevant add-ons, including the security capabilities available across different licence levels.
• A working understanding of Azure consumption and the Azure commercial model, with the ability to discuss a customer’s Azure usage and recognise opportunities for optimisation, security and additional services.
• Confidence discussing Defender, Sentinel, Entra and the wider Microsoft Security ecosystem.
• Experience selling solutions, managed services and consultancy, not just licences or transactional products.
• The ability to run effective discovery with both commercial and technical stakeholders.
• A track record of creating pipeline and winning new customers.
• The credibility to explore a customer’s Microsoft licensing and Azure estate in an initial discovery conversation, identify gaps and opportunities, and know when to bring in a technical specialist.

Softwerx is a member of the Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), reflecting our focus on Microsoft Security and our position within the wider Microsoft security ecosystem. Softwerx's MISA accreditation was highlighted internally as an important part of the company's position as an independent Microsoft security specialist.
For our Account Executives, that means joining a business where Microsoft Security is at the heart of the proposition.
You’ll work alongside experienced technical and security specialists, helping customers connect their Microsoft licensing, Azure estate and security priorities to the right combination of Microsoft Security technology, secure365® managed services and consultancy.
You’ll be expected to understand the value of our relationship with Microsoft and use our specialist capabilities, credentials and expertise to build credibility with customers.

• Dedicated BDR and Marketing support.
• Experienced security consultants and technical specialists to support you.
• The opportunity to build a significant net-new customer base.
• The chance to work in a business where Microsoft Security, managed services and consultancy are central to the growth strategy.

**These roles are available in our General Investigations Team.**
We receive thousands of reports every year raising allegations of misconduct and regulatory breaches against those we regulate.
**Assessment and Early Resolution Team (AERT)**
AERT consider these reports first and decide whether the SRA should investigate further. They make enquiries and gather any further information we need for our assessment, identify any potential breach of our rules and prioritise high-risk matters. They then consider the strength and quality of the evidence so far and whether the matter is capable of being evidenced. Sometimes we can guide the firm/solicitor to become compliant or change their processes for the future. Taking everything into account, AERT will decide to close the matter or pass it on for a full investigation.
**General Investigations Team**
Matters assessed as serious are passed to our Investigation teams. The Investigation teams manage caseloads of varying complexity, across various areas of law. They will analyse detailed information to get to the heart of the matter and identify and promptly obtain a range of documentary evidence, which will usually include legal and financial documents, transactional correspondence and witness statements. The Investigation teams will make use of formal powers to control risk and impose sanctions where the conduct is serious. The most serious cases will result in enforcement action being taken to the Solicitors Disciplinary Tribunal.
At the heart of what we do through this important work is:
- upholding public trust and confidence in legal services and
- delivering work that is timely, efficient, high quality and customer focused.
You can read more about our approach to enforcement
[here](https://www.sra.org.uk/sra/corporate-strategy/sra-enforcement-strategy/).

- Provide quality technical advice, investigation strategy and case direction on a variety of investigations about alleged breaches of our Standards and Regulations.

- Be part of the Investigations leadership team working with other managers and senior management to develop and implement changes and improvements to the way we work.
- Work collaboratively with other areas of our organisation to take action to protect the public.
**Your role**
As an Investigation Manager, you will have an integral role in leading and managing a team of Investigation Officers, playing a vital role in helping to deliver high professional standards in the legal profession. Investigation Officers investigate reports about alleged misconduct and breaches of our Standards and Regulations.
As part of a team of around fifteen Investigation Managers, you will provide support, development, technical expertise and case direction to a team of five Investigation Officers. Importantly, you will be a role model of our values and a leading figure in our journey to operational excellence within a high\-performing team.
This is a leadership position which will require you to inspire and develop people to deliver high performance, in line with our values which shape everything we do.
You will give support and guidance to your team to focus on the big issues that impact public trust and confidence in legal services, making sure investigations are of the highest quality, delivered in a timely way and to stretching performance objectives.
Working with senior management, you will successfully deliver organisational change programmes within your team and proactively pursue improvements to the way we work.
**Your team**
Working closely with your team, you will develop an understanding of their individual needs. You will have a strategic yet pragmatic input into your team’s work, demonstrating excellent performance and management skills to inspire the best from your team.
You will have accountability for and oversight of the progression and quality of investigations handled by your team and you will make sure that cases are managed on time and that quality standards are consistently high.
Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to challenge and influence key stakeholders at every level are key to being successful in this role.
**What we’re looking for**

job_description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. Kubernetes helped give enterprises more freedom over where and how they run software. Now we're bringing that same open approach to AI agents.
As AI agents take on more autonomous, long-running work, enterprises need infrastructure to run them securely and reliably at scale, without giving up control of their data, systems, or models. We're building open, Kubernetes-native infrastructure that brings together agent execution, secure access to tools and systems, and centralized controls for identity, permissions, and policy. This is an opportunity to help shape a foundational layer for enterprise AI while the architecture is still being defined.
We build in the open alongside the community. Our open source projects include ToolHive, an MCP platform that secures more than 20 million tool calls each month, and Mecatl, a cloud-native agent harness. Our commercial offering, Stacklok Enterprise, extends these capabilities with an AI gateway, centralized identity, policy enforcement, and observability.
Location
This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone. The Opportunity
AI agents are moving into production, and the harness that runs them is becoming critical infrastructure. Enterprises need that harness to be secure, auditable, and portable across models, clients, and deployment environments. Mecatl is Stacklok's open source, cloud-native agent harness. It provides the agent loop, tools, permissions, hooks, delegation, and durable sessions for running agents as production workloads on infrastructure you operate.
As a Software Engineer II on the Mecatl team, you will build the platform that agents run on, and you will build it with agents. This is a hands-on role with real independence. You will deliver features and fixes across the engine, the Kubernetes-native runtime, the client surfaces (gRPC, HTTP/SSE, the TypeScript SDK, and the terminal client), and the permission and governance layers that make agent behavior safe to trust. You will go deep in one area while developing a system-wide understanding of how the harness fits together.
We are also an AI-first engineering team. We use agents throughout our own development lifecycle, and we are still working out what good looks like. Your own experiments, and what you learn from them, will feed directly into how the team works.
What Success Looks Like: First 3-6 Months
Ramped quickly on the Mecatl codebase and its development process, and began contributing independently without needing close guidance.
Shipped your first features and fixes within the first few months, then delivered core harness work consistently thereafter.
Owned a product-minded improvement end to end, from understanding how people use Mecatl to shipping a change and learning from the result.
Contributed a concrete improvement to how the team uses AI in development, such as a workflow, evaluation, guardrail, or measurement approach that the team adopted.
Strengthened the team and community by reviewing pull requests thoughtfully, including AI-assisted changes, and helping open source users get more from Mecatl.
In This Role, You Will
Build and deliver features in the open across Mecatl, including the agent loop, tool and permission systems, session and state management, the Kubernetes runtime, and client SDKs.
Fix bugs and harden the harness for production use, improving reliability, security, and observability.
Write testable, readable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, produce clear design docs for the work you take on, and review pull requests, including AI-assisted changes.
Understand outcomes and partner with the team anchor to break down the work. Escalate decisions to product or staff engineers as needed. Use AI agents as a core part of your own workflow, and bring a critical eye to what they produce: review it, test it, and own it.
Find where your AI workflow breaks down on Mecatl work, experiment to fix it, and bring structured findings back so the team gets faster and better, not just busier.
Apply security judgment to AI-assisted development, including permissions, secrets handling, untrusted content, and the limits of what an agent should be trusted to do.
Desired Skill & Experience
We do not expect every candidate to meet every point below. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we encourage you to apply.
Proficiency in Go, writing clean, testable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, plus clear design docs and thoughtful code reviews.
Demonstrated ability to deliver features independently across a backend or platform codebase, from implementation through testing and into a release.
Working knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-native infrastructure, such as Kubernetes, containers, and service APIs (gRPC or HTTP). Experience with durable state, concurrency, or streaming is a plus.
A personal AI-assisted development workflow you can walk through, with a clear sense of where it helps, where it breaks, and its risks, such as prompt injection and excessive agent permissions.
Interest in agent infrastructure, such as agent loops, tool use, MCP, model providers, or evaluation. Prior experience building on or contributing to an AI platform or open source project is a plus.
Ideally, a product engineering mindset: curious about users and their problems, comfortable questioning requirements, and motivated by shipping something people use.
AI-first mindset: builds AI into the development workflow to accelerate delivery, improve the quality of what ships, and rethink how problems get solved.
Communication: excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain complex technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Startup mentality and intrinsic motivation: self-directed and hands-on, thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, and drives clarity through action.

The Opportunity
Investment Strategy & Fund Design sits at the heart of how we research, design and evolve long-term investment solutions for our policyholders.
We're looking for a Senior Quantitative Investment Strategist to bring deep quantitative and investment expertise into the team, combining sophisticated investment research with hands-on modelling and development capability.
This is a unique role at the intersection of investment strategy, portfolio construction, quantitative research and technology. You'll explore some of the most important questions facing long-term investors: how markets and investment factors could evolve, how portfolios may behave across different environments, how retirement spending and future risks influence investment needs, and ultimately, what that evidence tells us about how we should invest.
Crucially, you won't just commission or interpret the analysis. You'll have the technical capability to build the models and tools that test the thinking, turning investment hypotheses into robust quantitative evidence and ultimately into better investment strategies and customer outcomes.
Reporting to the Head of Investment Strategy & Fund Design, you'll have significant scope to shape our quantitative research agenda, modelling capability and approach to portfolio construction.
What you'll be doing
Quantitative Investment Research
• Lead sophisticated quantitative research across investment strategy, portfolio construction and long-term fund design.
• Develop and challenge capital market assumptions, strategic asset allocation frameworks and investment methodologies.
• Research how economic, market and investment factors could influence future portfolio behaviour and long-term investment outcomes.
• Use historical market, portfolio and investment data to understand previous outcomes, test assumptions and inform future strategy.
• Apply statistical analysis, optimisation, stochastic modelling and scenario techniques to complex investment problems.
• Build research around long-term customer needs, including retirement spending, sequencing risk, changing spending patterns and future investment risk.
• Turn quantitative findings into clear, evidence-led investment recommendations.
Portfolio Construction & Investment Strategy
• Develop quantitative frameworks for strategic asset allocation, portfolio optimisation and long-term portfolio construction.
• Evaluate potential investment strategies across different economic, market and customer scenarios.
• Investigate the interaction between asset classes, investment factors, diversification, risk and expected returns.
• Challenge existing portfolio design and use quantitative evidence to identify where alternative approaches may improve outcomes.
• Translate complex quantitative analysis into practical investment strategies and fund design decisions.
Model Development & Engineering
• Design, build and maintain sophisticated Python-based investment models and analytical tools.
• Take investment research from initial hypothesis and prototype through to robust, repeatable and well-governed modelling capability.
• Build scalable frameworks for portfolio optimisation, scenario modelling, strategic asset allocation and long-term outcome analysis.
• Enhance the team's quantitative infrastructure, automation and analytical capabilities.
• Ensure models are transparent, appropriately documented, validated and capable of standing up to technical and investment challenge.
Technical Leadership
• Act as a senior technical authority across quantitative investment research, modelling and portfolio construction.
• Bring intellectual challenge to existing methodologies and identify where new approaches, techniques or tools could improve investment decision-making.
• Help define and shape the team's longer-term quantitative research agenda.
• Coach colleagues and raise quantitative capability across the wider team.
• Communicate sophisticated investment and quantitative concepts clearly to technical specialists, investment professionals and senior stakeholders.
What we're looking for
At its heart, we're looking for someone who is equally comfortable thinking like an investor and building like a quant.
You'll ideally bring:
• Significant experience within asset management, investment solutions, multi-asset investing, quantitative investment research or a closely related investment environment.
• Deep understanding of portfolio construction, asset allocation, optimisation and investment risk.
• A highly quantitative background, with strong applied mathematics, statistics and modelling capability.
• Strong programming skills, particularly Python, with experience building sophisticated financial models and analytical tools.
• Experience applying techniques such as portfolio optimisation, stochastic modelling, Monte Carlo simulation, statistical modelling, factor analysis and scenario analysis to real investment problems.
• The ability to take an investment question through the complete journey from hypothesis → research → model → evidence → investment recommendation.
• Strong investment judgement, including an appreciation of the assumptions and limitations behind quantitative models rather than treating model outputs as the answer.
• The credibility to challenge thinking and communicate highly technical concepts to both investment specialists and senior non-technical stakeholders.
Experience particularly relevant to us
Experience in one or more of the following would be especially valuable:
• Strategic asset allocation and capital market assumptions
• Multi-asset investing or investment solutions
• Quantitative portfolio construction and optimisation
• Systematic or factor-based investment research
• Retirement, decumulation or customer outcome modelling
• Scenario and stochastic modelling
• Production-quality investment research tools
• Long-term fund or investment proposition design
Qualifications
A postgraduate qualification in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, computer science, quantitative finance or financial engineering would be valuable, although equivalent expertise developed through a highly quantitative investment career is equally relevant.

Who are we?
Telana is a technology partner that helps tech functions rebalance the run/drive ratio. We believe ambitious tech functions have two jobs: run the technology that keeps the business moving, and drive the innovation that takes it forward. But, most tech teams are struggling to do both jobs effectively; and when tech gets stuck, the business pays the price. Delivered as a self-funding journey from Get Control to Get Moving to Get Ahead, we systematically optimise, modernise, build and manage platforms so tech teams can spend more time on active business innovation and less on firefighting.
As a top-tier partner of Microsoft and Google Cloud, and market leaders for AI, data, cloud, and managed services, Telana partners with some of the UK’s most ambitious organisations to reduce toil, modernise platforms, and deliver secure, scalable AI and innovation solutions. 
Telana is recognised as a Leader for Data, Analytics, and Machine Learning in the ISG Provider™ Lens; we are an accredited Azure Expert MSP provider, and have also been awarded a Partner of the Year award from Google Cloud.
 
What will your role be? 
As the design authority for Telana’s managed service solutions, the Managed Service Architect reports to the Head of Solutions and owns the Managed Service product catalogue. In this role, you will maintain and expand the catalogue as new services are introduced, analyse live delivery data and costs to refine offerings and commercial models, and prepare contracts for renewal.
You will also lead the pre-sales shaping of new complex, non-standard managed service requirements—guiding opportunities from discovery and architecture through pricing, bid submissions, and internal approvals. You will ensure every custom solution seamlessly aligns with operational capabilities, maintains target profitability, and successfully transitions into live delivery.
What will you be doing?
• Designing non-standard services. Leading the requirements gathering and design of managed services where customer needs fall outside our standard catalogue, across Azure, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Google Cloud: scope, inclusions and exclusions, service levels, operating model, staffing and tooling.
• Partnering with presales solution architects. Working alongside our presales solution architects on each opportunity: they shape the technical solution, you shape how it will be run as a managed service, so the customer gets one joined-up proposal.
• Owning the cost model. Maintaining and, through the analysis of live data from existing services, continually improving our managed service cost model, including building costs for new, non-standard and renewal services, and working with commercial leads to set pricing and margin.
• Transforming renewals. Assessing existing contracts ahead of renewal (what was scoped, what is actually delivered, what the actual effort is, where the gaps and risks sit, whether the customer requirements have evolved) and redesigning them onto our standard model with a clear transition path and new pricing.
• Growing the catalogue. Owning our standard service catalogue, including service definitions, tiers, add-ons and SLAs, and designing and launching new services as our offering evolves.
• Bridging sales and delivery. Validating designs with our Managed Services team before we commit, leading the handover into service transition, and feeding lessons from live services back into the catalogue.
• Sharing what you know. Coaching presales and account teams so more opportunities can be scoped against the standard model without needing you.
 
This may be you:
• You have significant experience in IT managed services, including time in service delivery or service management roles running live operational services. You know how services work in practice, not just on paper.
• You have a track record of writing high-quality RFP and tender responses, ideally including public sector procurement frameworks.
• You have designed managed services end to end and have experience of owning or contributing to  a service catalogue or product portfolio, including lifecycle management from introduction through to retirement.
• You are confident building bottom-up effort and cost models and turning them into commercially viable pricing.
• You have reviewed and restructured existing service contracts, including reconciling scope and repricing at renewal.
• You have a working knowledge of ITIL 4 service management practices.
• You have an understanding of service transition and onboarding, and of what delivery and project teams need from pre-sales to transition successfully.
• You understand cloud and workplace platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. Google Cloud or Google Workspace experience is a strong plus.
• You write clearly, producing service descriptions that customers, commercial teams and delivery teams all understand.
• You are comfortable presenting designs and pricing to customers, and challenging internal stakeholders when a design isn’t deliverable.
• You are commercially minded and pragmatic: you favour a standard answer and depart from it only for good reason.
• You are calm in ambiguity and enjoy sharing knowledge rather than becoming a bottleneck.
• Nice to have: experience at an Azure Expert MSP or Google Cloud partner; building a productised service catalogue; security services such as SOC or vCISO and frameworks like ISO 27001 or Cyber Essentials; public sector or regulated-industry bids; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader.

We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer - Agentic to join our Agentic Service. Our ambition is for agents to take on somewhere between 50% and 99% of the manual work people across tem do today. Teams across the company want far more agentic delivery than we can currently provide.

• Design for reliability: Own the architecture across concurrent workstreams, with evaluation, access controls, recovery and human approval designed in from the start.

• Raise the bar across tem: Codify recurring business logic into reusable building blocks, and help teams build and run their own agents well through design reviews, shared patterns and clear handovers.

• You own the problem as well as the solution: you've worked directly with business stakeholders to define what gets built, perhaps as a technical product lead, tech lead or engineering manager, and you don't expect a spec.

Works with Tessera Labs' Forward Deployed Engineers, offshore Oracle data conversion consultants and Mosaic AI agents, and is the primary Oracle voice with the client's finance team and its systems integrator.
About Tessera Labs
Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world-class founding team, we combine deep enterprise ERP expertise with autonomous AI agents to deliver transformation outcomes at a fraction of the traditional time and cost.
Our mission is to bring real AI automation to the enterprise, delivering speed, precision, and measurable impact. We operate with extreme ownership, move fast, and hold ourselves to the same rigor as the best traditional system integrators while working at AI-native speed.
Role Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Oracle Data Migration Architect to own the architecture and end-to-end execution of a multi-release finance data conversion from PeopleSoft and other legacy systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud. This person is the functional and data authority for the conversion: they speak the language of Oracle Fusion Financials, Procurement and Projects, and they understand PeopleSoft source data well enough to explain what every legacy value becomes in Fusion.
This is not a configuration role. Oracle configuration is owned by the client's systems integrator. This role owns the data: mapping, business rules, FBDI load files, mock conversion cycles and reconciliation, with Tessera's platform and AI agents doing the extraction, transformation and loading at scale.
Key Responsibilities
1. Conversion Architecture and Mapping (30%)
• Own the conversion blueprint across releases: objects in scope, dependencies, load sequence and mock cycle plan, aligned to the client's entry and exit criteria.
• Lead source-to-target mapping from PeopleSoft and other sources (for example Coda, Advantage, Basware, Clarity, Workday) to Oracle Fusion, including chart of accounts crosswalks and EDMCS hierarchies.
• Define business rules, value mappings and data quality rules, and review the mappings and rules drafted by Mosaic AI agents before they are used.
• Decide cutover treatment for open items and in-flight transactions, and the approach for interim-state and reverse mapping where needed.
2. FBDI Loads and Reconciliation (30%)
• Own FBDI and HDL template usage per object, and work with the systems integrator on load sequencing, environments and load error resolution.
• Run mock conversion cycles end to end and diagnose load failures in Oracle Fusion terms.
• Set reconciliation controls (counts, balances, aging, subledger to GL) and drive reconciliation to the client's exit criteria, including 100% reconciliation for Fixed Assets and Projects.
• Secure business validation and sign-off for each release.
3. Client and Partner Leadership (25%)
• Act as the senior Oracle point of contact on site with the client's finance SMEs, data conversion lead and systems integrator.
• Lead mapping reviews, exception decisions and sign-off sessions, and explain differences in accounting language.
• Flag scope, risk and readiness issues early, including source system access, environment readiness and SME availability.
4. Team and AI Agent Oversight (15%)
• Guide offshore Oracle data conversion consultants and Forward Deployed Engineers on functional data questions.
• Act as the final quality gate for AI-generated mappings, transformations and load files before they reach the client.

• Strong functional understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets) and working knowledge of Procurement and Projects (PPM).
• Hands-on experience with PeopleSoft Financials data structures as a conversion source.
• Deep experience with FBDI (and HDL where relevant), load error resolution and mock conversion cycles.
• Proven financial reconciliation experience, including subledger to GL and balance reconciliation with finance users.
• Experience working alongside a systems integrator on a large Oracle Cloud program.
• Strong SQL for data analysis and validation.
• Excellent communication with finance stakeholders and executives.
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) or EDMCS.
• Financial services or asset management industry experience.
• Experience with Oracle Fusion Time and Labor or contingent worker data.
• Experience working with AI, RPA or automated data conversion tooling.
• Oracle Cloud certification in Financials or Implementation.

Strong client communication is not a nice-to-have in this role; it is half of it. Exposure to Cost Accounting is a strong plus, because many of our customers are manufacturers and distributors where finance and costing cannot be designed apart.
You will do this work with Tessera’s AI agents, not instead of them. The platform analyses the legacy configuration and data, drafts process models and fit-gap, generates configuration and test scripts. What it cannot do is decide how many ledgers a customer really needs, or whether a legacy intercompany process is a requirement or a workaround. That judgment is the role, and every time you exercise it we expect it to go back into the platform.
Two outcomes define the job. The first is a finance solution the customer’s controller signs off and closes the books on — reconciled, auditable and simpler than what it replaced. The second is that we win and deliver the next one faster, because what you learned is captured in the platform and in our pre-sales material rather than in your head.
Key Responsibilities
1. Discovery and Solution Architecture (25%)
• Lead finance discovery with the controller, accounting, AP, AR and treasury teams: read the legacy configuration, reports and close checklists, and separate real requirements from habits and workarounds.

2. Hands-On Configuration and Testing in EBS and Fusion (35%)
• Configure General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets and Cash Management yourself, in both EBS and Fusion — from journal sources, allocations and period close to payment processing, AutoInvoice, receipts and bank reconciliation.
• In Fusion, work through Functional Setup Manager, the Enterprise Structures Configurator and rapid-implementation spreadsheets, move configuration between environments, and keep designs current with the quarterly updates.
• In EBS, configure through setup forms, FNDLOAD and iSetup, and design responsibilities and roles with segregation of duties in mind.
• Lead testing end to end — conference room pilots, system integration testing, UAT and defect triage — including mock month-end closes, subledger-to-GL reconciliation and trial balance comparison against the legacy system.
• Where Cost Accounting is in scope, design and configure how inventory and work-in-process costs flow to the ledger: EBS Cost Management (standard, average and FIFO/LIFO costing) or Fusion Cost Management (cost organisations, cost books, cost profiles, receipt accounting and landed cost).
3. Pre-Sales and Client Leadership (25%)

• Be the counterpart the client partner and Technical Program Managers come to first on finance, and give them a straight answer — including when something cannot be done in the time or budget asked.
4. Platform Enablement and Team Leadership (15%)
• Contribute your Oracle finance know-how back into the Tessera platform, so the agents get better at finance discovery, configuration and testing with every engagement.
• Turn field findings into reusable assets — reference chart-of-accounts designs, fit-gap libraries, configuration templates, close test scripts and pre-sales material.
• Guide and review the work of Oracle finance SMEs, including offshore team members, and hold them to a consistent standard.
Required Qualifications
• 15+ years in Oracle Financials, including at least three full-lifecycle implementations as finance lead or solution architect, covering both Oracle E-Business Suite (R12.x) and Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials — at least one of each.
• At least one implementation where the customer moved to Oracle from a different ERP family — for example PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, NetSuite, SAP ECC or Infor — not only an upgrade from one Oracle version to another.
• Deep, hands-on configuration experience in General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets and Cash Management in both EBS and Fusion. You configure the system yourself rather than only writing the design.
• Strong accounting and enterprise-structure design: chart of accounts, ledgers and legal entities, Subledger Accounting / Accounting Hub, intercompany, multi-currency and the period-end close.
• Proven pre-sales experience on Oracle opportunities: discovery calls, solution demos, orals, estimates, and contributions to proposals, RFP responses and statements of work.
• Excellent client communication: able to lead workshops with finance teams, present to a CFO or controller, and hold difficult conversations in a way that keeps the relationship.
• Experience leading testing for finance — CRPs, SIT, UAT and mock closes with reconciliation — through to go-live and the first closes after it.
• Proven ability to work on several engagements at once without losing control of any of them.
• Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months.
• Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences.
• Experience working with distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline.
• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Who This Role Is Not For
If your experience is configuring one module to a design someone else agreed, this is not the role — the work here starts with discovery and ends with a closed period. If you are an architect who no longer configures or tests yourself, you will find the hands-on share of this role uncomfortable. If you have only ever moved customers from one Oracle release to another, you will under-estimate how much of a different ERP’s finance model has to be understood before it can be replaced. And if you would rather not be in front of prospects, or see pre-sales as somebody else’s job, this role will not suit you.
Preferred Qualifications
• Cost Accounting experience in EBS Cost Management or Fusion Cost Management — standard and actual costing, cost elements, receipt accounting, landed cost and the cost-to-ledger flow — and exposure to Profitability and Cost Management.
• Fusion Revenue Management (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and Advanced Collections.

• Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must-have.
First-Year Measures of Success

• Month 3: Finance design signed off and configuration underway on that engagement, a mock close completed or planned, finance pre-sales material and estimating inputs in place, and reusable finance content live in the Tessera platform.

How will you make an impact?
As a member of the European Fisher Scientific Leadership Team, you will lead the deployment and maturation of the PPI Business System across the Customer Channels Group (CCG), embedding a culture of continuous improvement that delivers sustainable business results.
You will also serve as the business-side leader for AI-enabled process improvement and the adoption of automation. In this role, you will partner with IT, Digital, Data, Analytics, and AI teams to translate business priorities into prioritized use cases, redesigned workflows, adoption plans, and measurable outcomes across productivity, customer experience, operational excellence, and profitable growth.
This role does not own technical architecture, application and platform delivery, systems engineering, model development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or production technology support. Success will be measured by the business value realized, process adoption, capability building, and disciplined governance of AI, automation, and digital productivity opportunities.
Location: This role can be hybrid based from our Loughborough, UK office or our Illkirch, France office.
What will you do?
• Partner with the European Leadership Team (ELT) to embed the PPI Business System, build leadership capability, and enable achievement of strategic and operational objectives.
• Lead the division's business-side AI, automation, and digital productivity agenda by identifying business problems, prioritizing use cases, defining value cases, and sponsoring adoption in partnership with IT, Digital, Data, Analytics, and AI delivery teams.
• Champion role base mastery of the PPI Business System to build organizational capability. Coach, train and develop; leaders to own the chain of execution, managers to lead accountability - connecting strategy to the daily work and everyone to become everyday problem solvers. Support this by integrating AI and digital concepts into application of PPI methodologies and tools.
• Drive deployment and continuous maturity of the PPI Business System across commercial, customer-facing, SG&A, and operational functions.

• Lead cross-functional business transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, operational performance, productivity, quality, and financial outcomes.

• Master's degree or MBA preferred.
• Certification or advanced expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, PPI Business System, Agile, Business Transformation, Process Reengineering, or equivalent continuous improvement methodologies preferred.

• 10+ years leading operational excellence, continuous improvement, business transformation, or related functions in complex, matrixed organizations.
• Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide Lean (TPS, HBS or DBS) or PPI deployments and delivering measurable business results.
• Experience leading business-led AI, automation, digital transformation, analytics, or technology-enabled productivity initiatives, including use-case prioritization, process redesign, adoption, governance, and value realization.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior leaders in a global matrix environment.
• Strong understanding of business operations, financial management, enterprise transformation, change adoption, and productivity measurement.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
• Executive-level leadership, coaching, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to influence and engage audiences at all organizational levels.
• Working knowledge of AI, automation, workflow redesign, process mining, digital productivity platforms, and emerging technologies, with emphasis on business application, adoption, responsible use, and value realization.

• Advanced therapeutic area knowledge and clinical development guidelines and directives
• Strong understanding of the key principles of project management (time, quality, cost), including solid financial acumen

## About the team
Events for London delivers some of the capital's most significant and high-profile events on behalf of the Mayor of London. From major public celebrations and cultural programmes to international summits, the team brings together partners from across London, the UK and around the world to showcase the capital, support Mayoral priorities and create lasting economic, social and cultural impact.
As part of the External Relations unit, the team leads the planning and delivery of events that strengthen London's global reputation, convene influential leaders and organisations, celebrate the capital's diversity, and create opportunities for meaningful engagement on the issues that matter most to Londoners and cities around the world.
## About the role
This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in the delivery of the Urban20 (U20) London Summit 2027, one of the Mayor of London's most significant international engagements. As Events and Communications Manager, you will lead the development and delivery of an integrated marketing, communications and audience engagement programme that promotes London’s role as Chair and host city of the U20 network.
Working across communications, events and stakeholder engagement, you will help shape how London presents itself to a global audience, ensuring the Summit and associated programme achieve maximum profile, influence and impact. You will work closely with colleagues across the GLA, international city networks, commercial partners and delivery suppliers to coordinate communications activity, support event delivery and create a compelling experience for delegates and stakeholders.
This role combines strategic communications expertise with practical event delivery, offering the opportunity to work on a high-profile international programme that will strengthen London’s position as a leading global city.
**What your day will look like**
You'll work across a broad range of communications, engagement and event delivery activities, helping to ensure the Urban20 London Summit reaches audiences locally, nationally and internationally.
A typical day could involve coordinating campaign activity with communications teams from partner organisations, developing content and engagement plans, reviewing media opportunities, briefing senior stakeholders or leading meetings with suppliers and agencies responsible for creative, digital or communications delivery. You may also be working closely with event delivery colleagues to integrate communications activity into operational plans, delegate management and programme delivery.
You'll collaborate with teams across External Relations, Marketing, Digital, International Relations and Policy to ensure messaging is aligned, audiences are engaged and communications activity supports wider Mayoral priorities. Alongside managing budgets and project plans, you'll use insight and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve campaign activity.
As the Summit approaches, you'll play a key role in coordinating communications, stakeholder engagement and event operations, ensuring delegates, partners and audiences experience a well-managed and impactful programme that enhances London's global reputation and contributes to the success of the U20 Chair year.
In this role, you will:
- Lead the development and delivery of the marketing, communications and audience engagement strategy for the Urban20 London Summit 2027 and associated programme.
- Coordinate communications activity across partner organisations to ensure consistent messaging, branding and audience engagement.
- Manage relationships with communications agencies, creative suppliers, media partners and key stakeholders.
- Lead the Urban20 Marketing and Communications Working Group, bringing together partners to deliver an integrated communications programme.
- Deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns across media, digital, social, email and visual communications platforms.
- Create and coordinate content, campaigns and stakeholder communications that maximise the profile and impact of London's U20 Chair year.
- Work closely with event delivery teams to integrate communications activity into event operations, delegate experience and programme delivery.
- Support the planning and delivery of Summit activity, including stakeholder engagement, logistics and delegate management.
- Manage marketing and communications budgets, procurement activity and supplier performance to ensure value for money.
- Monitor and evaluate communications performance, using data and insight to improve campaign effectiveness and audience reach.
- Prepare high-quality briefings, reports and presentation materials for senior leaders, the Mayor and other stakeholders.
- Support Mayoral visits, stakeholder engagement activity and high-profile events associated with the Urban20 programme.
- Build strong relationships across the GLA, international city networks and external partners to support successful programme delivery.
- Work occasional evenings and weekends to support the planning and delivery of the Urban20 London Summit 2027 and associated events.
## Skills, knowledge and experience
**To be considered for the role you must meet the following essential criteria:**
- Experience of developing and delivering high-profile, multi-channel communications and stakeholder engagement campaigns for complex programmes, events or international initiatives.
- Knowledge of the structure of London Government, particularly the respective roles of Local Authorities, the Mayor and GLA and National Government; and a good understanding of how political events are managed and administered in London and nationally.
- Experience of planning and supporting event operations, logistics and delegate management for complex events involving multiple stakeholders and delivery partners.
- Experience of operating in a politically sensitive environment and handling communications in this environment.
- Managing a large budget to deliver a high-profile campaign, working with multiple stakeholders.
- Experience of using data, insight and evaluation to inform marketing and communications strategy.
- Experience of planning and delivering operational comms for a major event.
**This role is based at City Hall, Royal Docks (Kamal Chunchie Way, London, E16 1ZE).**

ABOUT TRILITECH
Trilitech is the London-based R&D and entrepreneurship hub for the Tezos blockchain. Founded in 2021, it brings together developers, entrepreneurs and institutions working across the Tezos ecosystem, from core protocol development (including Nomadic Labs) and DeFi through to real-world asset (RWA) tokenisation.
 
RWAs are a growing focus. Trilitech is behind Uranium.io http://Uranium.io, a tokenised uranium marketplace launched in December 2024 on Etherlink, Tezos' EVM-compatible Layer 2, and Metals.io http://Metals.io, a platform for trading tokenised commodities such as gold and uranium. Alongside building its own products, Trilitech invests in third-party tokenised RWAs, typically with ticket sizes of roughly $1M to $10M.
 
THE ROLE
We are looking for an experienced investment funds lawyer to support our in-house legal team on a flexible, as-needed basis. This is a freelance engagement paid hourly, not a permanent or full-time role.
 
When we are considering an investment in a tokenised RWA, you will review the issuer's documentation and tell us, clearly and quickly, two things: how we get our money out, and what we can do if something goes wrong. You will work closely with Giti, who leads investment legal in-house.
 
HOW IT WORKS
- When an opportunity reaches legal due diligence, Giti shares the document pack along with context on the deal and any specific concerns
- You review the documents and return a short red-flag report, typically within a few days
- Where needed, you speak directly with the issuer's lawyers to clarify provisions or negotiate side letters
- Volume follows our deal flow, so the workload will vary from month to month
 
DOCUMENTS YOU WILL REVIEW
- Offering memoranda and prospectuses: the core terms and disclosure for the issuance, including the issuer structure, reserve arrangements and risk factors
- Token terms and conditions: the rights attached to the token, including how redemption works
- Subscription agreements: our contractual entry point, including the representations, warranties and waivers we are asked to give
- Protocol and whitelisted-user agreements: the terms governing who can hold, transfer and redeem the token
- Tripartite or assurance letters with custodians and auditors: the third-party comfort over how the reserve assets are held and verified
 
For each opportunity you will deliver a short, prioritised report focused on our exit and our recourse. It is not a full due diligence report: it should tell us what matters, why it matters in practice, and what we might ask for to fix it. It will cover:
 
- Redemption rights: whether and how we can redeem, on what terms, and how much discretion the issuer keeps to refuse, delay or suspend redemptions
- Extraordinary-event and termination clauses: what events allow the issuer to change terms, suspend or wind down the token, and what happens to holders if they do
- Reserve assets: whether the reserves are segregated from the issuer's own assets and bankruptcy-remote, so they are protected for token holders if the issuer fails
- Limitation of liability and reliance waivers: how far the issuer and other parties limit their liability, and what we are asked to waive
- Transfer restrictions: limits on transferring or selling the token, and how they affect our ability to exit other than through redemption
- Governing law and dispute resolution: the applicable law and forum, often offshore arbitration (BVI, Cayman), and what that means for enforcing our rights in practice
 
ISSUER NEGOTIATIONS
From time to time you will hold counsel-to-counsel calls with issuers' lawyers to:
 
- Negotiate side letters, for example a binding redemption commitment, most favoured nation (MFN) rights or information rights
- Get clarification on ambiguous provisions before we commit
 
ABOUT YOU
ESSENTIAL
- An associate or counsel from a fund formation, asset management or financial regulatory practice
- Hands-on exposure to digital assets and tokenisation
- Exposure to offshore fund structures
- Able to turn a review around within a few days
NICE TO HAVE
- Experience reviewing tokenised funds, commodities or other RWA structures from the investor side
- Experience negotiating side letters
- A concise, practical writing style suited to short red-flag reports rather than long-form memos
What You Can Expect From Us

- Generous long-term incentive plan (LTIP) tez token scheme
- Hybrid working environment
- Daily lunch budget provided in-office
- Commuter costs reimbursement (up to £3,300 annually)
- 20-day policy for working abroad
- 25 days paid holiday plus your birthday off
- Enhanced parental & adoption leave
- Pension contributions double matched (up to 10%)
- Private medical and travel insurance with mental health support
- Learning and development programs
- Life assurance (5x base salary)
Why You'll Love It
Join a fast-paced environment where you'll lead impactful initiatives. You’ll have autonomy to deliver results, supported by passionate colleagues in a focused but fun environment. We value ambition, creativity, and continuous learning—providing the ideal setting for career growth.
 
Our Principles:

About You
You are a confident and commercially driven business development professional who thrives on creating new opportunities and turning them into long-term customer relationships. You enjoy taking ownership of the entire sales journey, from identifying target organisations and opening conversations with senior decision-makers through to negotiating contracts and securing new business. Ideally you have experience in a business development, sales, account management or commercial role where you have been responsible for generating new revenue and managing complex sales opportunities. ****Key Responsibilities****
****1\. Financial Planning & Forecasting****
- Support the preparation of ****annual budgets, rolling forecasts and long-term financial plans**** across European entities.
- Maintain and improve financial models covering ****revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount and cash flow****.
- Work with business stakeholders to collect, validate and consolidate forecast assumptions.
- Analyse actual performance against budget and forecast and identify key ****risks, opportunities and trends****.
- Support scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis to assess the financial impact of business decisions.
- Assist in developing ****multi-year strategic financial plans**** for the European business.
****2\. Management Reporting & Performance Analysis****
- Prepare monthly management reporting packs, including ****P&L, KPIs, budget vs. actual and forecast variance analysis****.
- Provide clear commentary explaining key business and financial performance movements.
- Develop and maintain ****standardised and scalable reporting templates and dashboards**** across Europe.
- Monitor key financial and operational KPIs and highlight areas requiring management attention.
- Support month-end performance reviews by ensuring financial data is accurate, reconciled and delivered on time.
- Work with Finance and business teams to improve the quality and consistency of management information.
****3\. Business & Commercial Analysis****
- Support the EU Finance Business Partner with financial analysis for key commercial and operational decisions.
- Perform ****customer, product, project and deal profitability analysis****.
- Support business case preparation, ROI analysis and investment evaluations.
- Assist with financial analysis for pricing, tenders and commercial proposals.
- Analyse revenue, margin and cost drivers to identify opportunities for ****revenue growth, margin improvement and cost optimisation****.
- Support ad-hoc strategic projects and management requests.
****4\. Cash Flow & Working Capital****
- Support cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis across European entities.
- Monitor ****accounts receivable, collections, DSO, accounts payable and other working capital indicators****.
- Identify cash flow risks and support actions to improve cash conversion and working capital efficiency.
- Assist with regular cash collection forecasting and reporting.
****5\. Financial Control & Governance****
- Support month-end and year-end processes by ensuring alignment between management reporting and accounting data.
- Assist with balance sheet and P&L analysis where required.
- Support compliance with ****IFRS, local accounting requirements, internal controls and financial policies****.
- Assist with internal and external audit requirements by preparing financial analysis and supporting documentation.
- Identify opportunities to strengthen financial controls, reporting quality and data accuracy.
****6\. Systems, Data & Process Improvement****
- Improve the efficiency and automation of FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.
- Maintain high standards of financial data quality across finance and business systems.
- Work with Finance and other teams to improve integration between ****CRM, ERP and management reporting processes****.
- Support the development of dashboards and automated reporting using tools such as ****Excel and Power BI****.
- Document and standardise FP&A processes to support a scalable European finance organisation.
****7\. Cross-border Finance Support****
- Support consistent FP&A processes and reporting across the ****European entities****.
- Assist with financial planning and reporting for new European markets as the business expands.
- Work with local and Group Finance teams to ensure consistent definitions, assumptions, timelines and reporting standards.

- Working knowledge of ****IFRS**** and management accounting principles.

As a Staff Product Manager for vMetal at vCluster Labs, you’ll help own the systems that discover, provision, configure, and manage physical hardware, turning racks of bare metal into a programmable platform for AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers to build tenant clusters on top of. You’ll work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership on the tradeoffs that shape where vMetal goes next.
As a Staff Product Manager, your role will include:
- Infrastructure Direction: Align on business priorities and technical direction for vMetal across compute and networking, and translate that into specs engineering can execute against..
- Networking: Own vMetal’s networking layer. Define how vMetal provisions and isolates tenant networks across InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics, from tenant VPCs to rail-optimized GPU fabrics, and how it works with fabric controllers and NVIDIA’s networking tools.

- Networking Fluency: You understand InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, and the NVIDIA networking stack (Spectrum and Quantum switches, UFM, Cumulus Linux, NVUE), well enough to make informed product tradeoffs.

Clients range from multinational and specialist insurers to insurance brokers and aggregators.

In coordination with LHT’s Medical Director, the Veterinary Risk, Underwriting & Product Lead will be responsible for maintaining and developing the medical datasets that underpin Verisk’s Risk Rating Tools.
Working as the dedicated veterinary specialist within Verisk's Medical Team, the successful candidate will take ownership of the veterinary datasets that underpin Verisk's Pet Insurance Risk Rating Tool.
The role combines clinical veterinary expertise with insurance knowledge to ensure our pet insurance products remain medically accurate, commercially relevant and technically innovative.
Unlike a traditional veterinary nursing role, this position sits at the intersection of veterinary medicine, insurance, technology and product development. The successful candidate will work independently as the recognised veterinary subject matter expert, collaborating with Product, Analytics, Client Services and Business Development to shape the future direction of Verisk's pet insurance solutions.

• Veterinary Risk Assessment – Develop and maintain evidence-based veterinary risk assessments across canine and feline conditions, ensuring consistency, clinical accuracy and commercial relevance.
• Product Ownership – Act as the veterinary owner of the Pet Risk Rating Tool, identifying opportunities to improve content, functionality and customer value.
• Dataset Management – Maintain and continuously improve the veterinary datasets through literature reviews, insurer feedback, claims analysis and emerging veterinary evidence.
• Product Innovation – Help develop the next generation of veterinary risk assessment methodologies and support new product initiatives across pet insurance.
• Sales & Client Engagement – Provide veterinary expertise during client demonstrations, implementation projects and strategic discussions with insurers.
• Technology & AI – Work alongside Product and Technology teams to develop AI-enabled capabilities, improve user experience and support future automation initiatives.
• Market Intelligence – Monitor developments across veterinary medicine, pet insurance and regulatory environments to ensure Verisk remains at the forefront of veterinary underwriting.

POSITION SUMMARY
• The Capacity Planning & Analysis Manager translates business demand, operational data and workforce information into actionable capacity plans that support customer commitments, resource optimisation and business growth.
